content:
Fundraiser by Uyghur Anthology : Support the Contemporary Uyghur Anthology
This anthology funds Uyghur writers and artists, translation, events, and community growth
Uyghur Anthology is organizing this fundraiser.
The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a publication that platforms Uyghur (and anyone drawing their roots from East Turkistan) artists and writers in the diaspora by providing a space that is often inaccessible to those in our community. There are no other projects of its kind in the English language, and with two volumes already published, we hope to take this project to the next level. It's a rare look at Uyghur expression in an environment where all our stories are told by people pushing their own narratives without the intimate knowledge of our lived experiences.
<"Manifesto" by Sumayah Jurad from Vol. II>
We asked ourselves these questions - why wait for others to invite us to the table when we can pull up a chair and introduce ourselves? Why let others speak for us without trying first to speak? Our broken English can only be improved with audacity, and world literature is only enriched by the presence of new voices.
All-in-all, our efforts have been met with support from our community and pleasant surprise from those who did not know what they did not know.
Somewhat unprecedented is that we publish the authors' original language alongside the translation. Our book is filled with Uyghur, Latin, Cyrillic, and Chinese script to encapsulate as much of our community's experience as we can.
There are many publications in diaspora communities that platform East and South Asians, SEA, MENA, and more. Central Asia is often underrepresented in world literature or Asia-specific publications, and occupied territories even less so. Uyghurs themselves have been a relatively new diaspora community in English-speaking countries, and haven't had the opportunities to grow their literary or artistic communities. Many don't have the tools to nurture their talents, or knowledge of creative networks or opportunities, even when many journals seek work from underrepresented groups. In instances where they are aware, it's difficult to be published in this competitive field without the education and styles that publications look for. There are only a handful of literary translators translating from Uyghur to English, and not many Uyghurs who have had the chances to develop their creative language when learning English.
To sum up, the issues were:
No spaces for Uyghur writers and artists to develop their skills
A disconnect from artist communities, be it local or online
No bridge between our native tongue and English, and in turn, world literature
So, we put together a small group at the Tarim Network to take on this challenge. Completely volunteer-run; the very essence of a passion project. We did a call-out for anything and all. New writers, established writers, any language, any genre, whatever we could print in a book. And here we were, the first book of its kind, created to speak for ourselves without outsider voices, without a publishing house, raw and straight from the source.
<From the launch of Vol. I at Harvard University>
"The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a collection of Uyghur reflections in diaspora. Weaving together memories of the homeland, experiences of displacement, and transitions of identities, this anthology is a creative reflection of the beauty and complexities of the Uyghur experience.
By centering Uyghur voices at the forefront, this anthology serves as a form of living memory in a pivotal moment of Uyghur history. The title Under the Mulberry Tree refers to a story from the Uyghur literary classic Ana Yurt, where youthful Nuri faces terrible injustices, separation, and turmoil; but for one moment in the Charbagh, his love for Sebihe and his own family is full, ripe, and sweet, like the mulberries from the ancient tree. In a similar way that the mulberry tree offered comforts in Nuri’s time of need, we hope this volume offers a place of reflection and celebration of Uyghur culture."
We'd partnered with a member from a Jewish organisation to run writing workshops and explain editorial processes, as we had never worked on something like this before. After that collaboration, we decided to publish a revised edition on our own. This time, we added editors' notes to the pages to explain certain terms and historical and cultural contexts - mainly for our own youth, who don't always have access to cultural education. We translated more pieces from Uyghur and Chinese. Our contributors spanned 13 countries, at all levels of experience.
Was this work sustainable? Equipped with the tools, experience, and outpouring of support from our first volume, we spent the next two years saying yes. Our first book was now in libraries, there were articles and academic papers that mentioned it, and most of all, we reaffirmed the need for this sort of work. Not only were we accepting submissions, we worked one-on-one with emerging writers and artists to edit their pieces. We also helped first-time translators have their first publications with help from more experienced translators, as well as connecting them with the original authors.
Our second volume was even better than the last. From the blurb:
"How do we respond to the unexpected, and how does it influence perceptions of ourselves or the environments in which we exist? As a diaspora population, unexpected encounters can shape and transform what it means to be Uyghur as we build a new life outside of the homeland. Encounters Under the Mulberry Tree takes on the literal, abstract, and expanded renditions of these moments. We feature contemporary and historical works, including art, poetry, and prose in five languages with contributors based in a dozen countries, from established writers like award-winning author and filmmaker Tahir Hamut Izgil, to emerging artists, writers and translators of all ages. This book is a library of vignettes that grapple with intersections and how we make sense of it all."
Five languages (Uyghur, English, Chinese, Russian, Turkish)
<Vol. II showcased at a college hosted by Rawan Mentorship>
Now we embark on our third volume. The three of us do this while maintaining full time jobs, academic careers, and other side projects. We all live in different countries and have only met in person once. But it's something that we need to do, for our community and for ourselves. Our contributors have gained so much from this experience and we want to extend this opportunity to more people. This needs to survive in order for similar initiatives to be born.
Supporting the editors - all expenses so far have been paid out-of-pocket or through book sales. We do not have any donors or sponsors (yet!).
Supporting our contributors - we cannot afford to pay any of our contributors. Despite this, we have given free copies of the book to contributors, but this is definitely leaving a dent in our pockets.
Recruiting more people - paid internships or remuneration for one-off work would help volunteers spend more time on this project in this economy.
Enhance our level of expertise - we want to improve. Workshops or courses for our editors and contributors, professional feedback, the works. Unfortunately there is no one who speaks Uyghur and who is involved in Western publishing or English literature on a professional or academic level. We would appreciate connections with professionals from any language background, or the funding to level up.
Expand our network - we'd love to promote our work at literary festivals, go to conferences, do book events, establish ourselves in the public eye, provide reader copies to reviewers, and so on. However, there is a funding barrier to overcome to be able to attend these events, organise, or pre-order books.
<Vol. I on display at the Mosquers Film Festival, 2025>
Munawwar Abdulla is an Uyghur advocate, poet, and scientist born on unceded Kaurna land (Australia) and based in Massachusetts. She co-founded The Tarim Network, runs Uyghur Collective, and collaborates on projects with Uyghur rights organisations around the world. Her writings and literary translations have been published in places such as Modern Poetry in Translation, Asymptote, the Margins, the Georgia Review, and others.
Sonya Imin is a mixed Uyghur American scholar and multi-disciplinary creative who has worked on art and film projects across the US, Europe, and Central Asia. Growing up between the borderlands of the Uyghur homeland, broader Central Asia, and the midwestern United States, interrogations of belonging, home, and displacement influence the nature of her work. Currently based in Brussels, she is working on her doctoral research on Uyghur artistic production in the diaspora.
Maidina Kadeer is a mixed Uyghur-Hui writer and editor, born in Ghulja and currently based in Montreal (Tiohtià:ke), Canada. She holds a BA in English Literature and Law and Society from Concordia University, with a focus on post- and neo-colonial literature. Her work explores Uyghur identity, history, and culture through cuisine, agriculture, and neo-colonialism. She has contributed to projects such as a poem, NinetySix, in Slavs and Tatars’ Contest of the Fruits (2021) and participates in panels and interviews on Agriculture and Food History to raise awareness about Uyghur culture.

title: Commanders rally past Bengals with last-minute drive
zh_title: 指挥官们在最后一刻冲过猛虎队
summary: 指挥官们在最后一刻突破猛虎队 - 《日本时报》 指挥官们在最后一刻突破猛虎队 周一，指挥官四分卫杰登·丹尼尔斯（中）在马里兰州兰多弗的西北体育场对阵孟加拉虎队。 |图片/来自路透社 X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接 新秀德鲁·史蒂文斯 (Drew Stevens) 踢出了赛季最高的 5 个射门得分，其中包括在比赛结束时投进致胜的 26 码进球，帮助华盛顿指挥官队于周一晚上在马萨诸塞州兰多弗以 22-20 戏剧性地战胜辛辛那提猛虎队
content:
指挥官们在最后一刻冲过猛虎队 - 日本时报
指挥官们在最后一刻冲过猛虎队
周一，指挥官四分卫杰登·丹尼尔斯（中）在马里兰州兰多弗西北体育场对阵孟加拉虎队时带球奔跑。 |图片来源：路透社
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
周一晚上，新秀德鲁·史蒂文斯在马里兰州兰多弗打出了赛季新高的 5 粒进球，其中包括在比赛结束时投进的 26 码制胜球，帮助华盛顿指挥官队以 22-20 戏剧性地战胜了辛辛那提猛虎队。
杰登·丹尼尔斯 (Jayden Daniels) 与安东尼奥·威廉姆斯 (Antonio Williams) 联手，分别推进 22 码和 42 码，发起决定性的一球。后者将球移至辛辛那提队 8 码线，指挥官们在比赛还剩 4 秒时冲向开球线，将球扣进。
比赛还剩 46 秒时，埃文·麦克弗森 (Evan McPherson) 射门 56 码，猛虎队以 20-19 领先。辛辛那提队（7-3）五连胜被终止。
丹尼尔斯 35 次传球完成 23 次，推进 289 码，并为华盛顿队 6 次冲球冲球 55 码 (4-5-1)。贾科里·克罗斯基-梅里特冲球达阵，指挥官队在过去四场比赛中第三次获胜。
新秀威廉姆斯取得了赛季最高的 9 次接球和 122 码。华盛顿队的蒂姆·塞特尔 (Tim Settle) 完成 1.5 次擒杀。
辛辛那提队的乔·伯罗 (Joe Burrow) 40 次传球 28 次，传球 300 码并达阵 2 次。蒂·希金斯（Tee Higgins）和科尔比·杨（Colbie Young）接到传球得分，博耶·马菲（Boye Mafe）创下了职业生涯最好的三次擒杀。
辛辛那提队连续五场比赛拿下 30 分的球队纪录被打破。
伯罗向迈克·格西基的 32 码传球是为麦克弗森最后时刻反超的关键一球。
史蒂文斯在比赛还剩 2 分 26 秒时打进 41 码的第四个射门，帮助华盛顿队在比赛中首次取得领先。
第三节还剩 7 分 04 秒时，伯罗向杨传出 4 码达阵传球，孟加拉队以 17-10 领先。
史蒂文斯踢出一记 40 码射门，指挥官队在比赛还剩 2 分 36 秒时将分差缩小到 4 分。
第四节，华盛顿到达辛辛那提8码线，但进攻陷入停滞。比赛还剩 10 分 32 秒时，史蒂文斯上场并投进一记 25 码射门，将指挥官队的比分追至 17-16。
比赛一直没有得分，直到上半场还剩 6 分 17 秒时麦克弗森踢出一脚 38 码射门。
四分多分钟后，猛虎队找到达阵区，布罗将一记 31 码传球传给希金斯，将比分改写为 10-0。
半场还剩 12 秒时，克罗斯基-梅里特 (Croskey-Merritt) 投进一球，中场休息时指挥官队以 10-7 落后。
第三节还剩 11 分 47 秒时，史蒂文斯在 36 码外射门，华盛顿将比分追成 10 平。

Commanders rally past Bengals with last-minute drive - The Japan Times
Commanders rally past Bengals with last-minute drive
Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels (center) runs with the ball against the Bengals at Northwest Stadium in Landover, Maryland, on Monday. | Imagn Images / via Reuters
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
Rookie Drew Stevens kicked a season-high five field goals, including the winning 26-yarder as time expired, to give the Washington Commanders a dramatic 22-20 victory over the Cincinnati Bengals on Monday night in Landover, Maryland.
Jayden Daniels connected with Antonio Williams on gains of 22 and 42 yards to set up the decisive kick. The latter gain moved the ball to the Cincinnati 8-yard line, and the Commanders hustled to the line of scrimmage to spike the ball with four seconds left.
The Bengals had taken a 20-19 lead when Evan McPherson kicked a 56-yard field goal with 46 seconds left. Cincinnati (7-3) had its five-game winning streak come to a halt.
Daniels completed 23 of 35 passes for 289 yards and rushed for 55 on six attempts for Washington (4-5-1). Jacory Croskey-Merritt ran for a touchdown as the Commanders won for the third time in the last four games.
Williams, a rookie, had season highs of nine receptions and 122 yards. Washington’s Tim Settle registered 1.5 sacks.
Cincinnati’s Joe Burrow threw for 300 yards and two touchdowns on 28-of-40 passing. Tee Higgins and Colbie Young caught scoring passes, and Boye Mafe recorded a career-best three sacks.
Cincinnati’s franchise-record streak of scoring 30 points in five straight games was snapped.
Burrow’s 32-yard pass to Mike Gesicki was the key play to set up McPherson’s late go-ahead kick.
Stevens’ fourth field goal, a 41-yarder with 2:26 remaining, gave Washington its first lead of the game.
The Bengals took a 17-10 lead when Burrow threw a 4-yard touchdown pass to Young with 7:04 left in the third quarter.
Stevens kicked a 40-yard field goal as the Commanders moved within four points with 2:36 remaining in the period.
In the fourth quarter, Washington reached the Cincinnati 8-yard line before the drive stalled. Stevens entered and made a 25-yard field goal to bring the Commanders within 17-16 with 10:32 left in the game.
The contest was scoreless until McPherson kicked a 38-yard field goal with 6:17 left in the first half.
The Bengals found the end zone four-plus minutes later when Burrow tossed a 31-yard scoring pass to Higgins to make it 10-0.
Croskey-Merritt scored from the 1 with 12 seconds left in the half as the Commanders trailed 10-7 at the break.
Washington knotted the score at 10 when Stevens booted a 36-yard field goal with 11:47 remaining in the third quarter.

title: President Trump says Nvidia board rehiring Jensen Huang would be best for the company and US
zh_title: 特朗普总统表示，英伟达董事会重新聘用黄仁勋对公司和美国来说都是最好的选择
summary: 几天前，在黄仁勋承认与一名所谓的中国间谍有染后辞职后，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特表示，任何新的英伟达首席执行官都应该“来自公司外部”，但现在美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特又说黄仁勋是外部人士，这似乎为他的回归铺平了道路。当时，贝森特的主张与美国总统的主张形成鲜明对比，特朗普呼吁黄仁勋复职。今天早些时候，特朗普在他的 Truth Social 账户上发表了一篇文章，表示他“希望”英伟达董事会重新聘用黄仁勋。
content:
几天前，在黄仁勋承认与一名所谓的中国间谍有染后辞职后，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特表示，任何新的英伟达首席执行官都应该“来自公司外部”，但现在美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特又说黄仁勋是外部人士，这似乎为他的回归铺平了道路。当时，贝森特的主张与美国总统的主张形成鲜明对比，特朗普呼吁黄仁勋复职。今天早些时候，特朗普在他的 Truth Social 账户上发表了一篇文章，表示他“希望”英伟达董事会重新聘用黄仁勋。现在，贝森特已经同意了，尽管他之前曾呼吁英伟达进行“戏剧性的改组”。贝森特的最新评论是在哥伦比亚广播公司的“面对国家”节目中发表的。当被问及英伟达在寻找新首席执行官而不是让黄仁勋回来时是否应该考虑目前的薪资之外时，贝森特辩称，他“说他们应该去外面，但他现在在外面。”贝森特还表示，他“假设[黄]不知道[爱丽丝黄]是一名所谓的间谍”。迄今为止，这一点尚未得到公开证实。 *BESSENT：我们已经与 $NVDA 临时管理层、主要董事及其律师取得了联系，我们确实需要答案*BESSENT：我说他们应该到外面去，JENSEN 现在在外面。我们将看看企业的哪个级别知道，它是否一直到最高层*贝森特：我们将看看他们要说什么。
对于这种规模的交易，不存在无法追踪的握手交易*BESSENT：我假设他不知道她是一名被指控的间谍 2026 年 11 月 22 日 Bessent 的最新声明可能是与特朗普重新结盟的语义，但目前尚不清楚他们中的任何一个是否会影响已经表示无意的 Nvidia 董事会尽管同一董事会的一些成员仍在寻求允许黄重返公司，但他还是与黄双双受惠。不出所料，黄已经表示他将“荣幸”回归，但现在的情况已经超出了与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 的简单恋情。事实上，现在可能已经揭露了多项事务，这对他的案件没有任何帮助，也不会在 12 月初被拖到众议院外交事务、情报和中国特别委员会面前。在有消息称，针对 Nvidia 的前客户、Alice Huang 工作的公司 Megaspeed 是否参与绕过 AI 芯片出口管制的消息展开刑事调查后，Nvidia 的顶级律师也必须露面。 Megaspeed 长期以来一直被指控参与芯片走私活动。 2025 年 10 月的一项调查发现，该公司通过进口和再出口流程帮助将价值约 20 亿美元的 Nvidia 芯片转移到中国。
被指控的中国间谍 Alice Huang 是 Megaspeed 的一名高管，据报道，在与时任 Nvidia 首席执行官 Jensen Huang 的三年关系期间，她在进口价值超过 75 亿美元的 Nvidia AI GPU 方面发挥了重要作用。

【原文 English Original】
After saying just days ago that any new Nvidia CEO should "come from outside the company" following the resignation of Jensen Huang after he admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy , U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has now backtracked by saying that Huang is on the outside, seemingly paving the way for his return. At the time, Bessent's assertion was in stark contrast with that of the U.S. President, with Trump calling for Huang to be reinstated . Trump earlier today doubled down, writing of his "hope" that Nvidia's board would rehire Huang in a post on his Truth Social account. Now, Bessent has fallen in line despite having previously called for a "dramatic shake-up" at Nvidia. Bessent's latest comments came on CBS' Face the Nation show. When asked about whether Nvidia should look beyond its current payroll when looking for a new CEO instead of bringing Huang back, Bessent argued that he "said they should go to the outside, but he's on the outside now." Bessent also said that he would "assume [Huang] didn't know that [Alice Huang] was an alleged spy." That has, to date, not been publicly confirmed. *BESSENT: WE'VE BEEN IN TOUCH WITH $NVDA TEMPORARY MANAGEMENT, THE LEAD DIRECTORS AND THEIR LAWYERS, AND WE DO NEED ANSWERS*BESSENT: I SAID THEY SHOULD GO TO THE OUTSIDE, JENSEN IS ON THE OUTSIDE NOW. WE WILL SEE WHICH LEVEL OF THE BUSINESS KNEW, DID IT GO ALL THE WAY TO THE TOP*BESSENT: WE'LL SEE WHAT THEY HAVE TO SAY. FOR DEALS THAT SIZE THERE'S NO SUCH THING AS AN UNTRACEABLE HANDSHAKE DEAL*BESSENT: I ASSUME HE DIDN'T KNOW THAT SHE WAS AN ALLEGED SPY November 22, 2026 Bessent's latest statement may be semantics to realign himself with Trump, but it's unclear whether either of them will sway an Nvidia board that has already said it has no intention of double-dipping with Huang. That's despite some members of the same board angling for Huang to be allowed back into the company. Predictably, Huang has made it known that he would be "honored" to return , but the situation has now moved beyond a simple affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang. The fact that multiple affairs may now have been uncovered won't help his case, nor will being dragged before the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence, and China Select Committees in early December. Nvidia's top lawyer will also have to make an appearance following the news that a criminal investigation has been launched into whether Megaspeed — a previous client of Nvidia, and the company where Alice Huang worked — was involved in the bypassing of AI chip export controls. Megaspeed has long been accused of being involved in a chip smuggling operation. An investigation found in October 2025 that it had helped move around $2 billion worth of Nvidia chips into China via an import and re-export process. The alleged Chinese spy, Alice Huang, was a Megaspeed executive and was reportedly instrumental in the import of more than $7.5 billion worth of Nvidia AI GPU imports during a three-year relationship with the then Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

title: China’s Naval Developments Set For The Spotlight At Zhuhai Airshow
zh_title: 中国海军发展成为珠海航展的焦点
summary: 中国人民解放军海军表示，正在准备在即将于珠海举行的第十六届中国国际航空航天博览会上进行重要亮相，军舰、舰载机、先进武器系统和无人平台将成为重点展示。扩大后的海军部分将包括在海湾另一边的高栏港设立一个新的海事装备展区，这标志着解放军海军首次在此次活动中设立这样的专门展示区。珠海已成为国际防务、航空领域最重要的赛事之一
content:
中国人民解放军海军表示，正在准备在即将于珠海举行的第十六届中国国际航空航天博览会上进行重要亮相，军舰、舰载机、先进武器系统和无人平台将成为重点展示。扩大后的海军部分将包括在海湾另一边的高栏港设立一个新的海事装备展区，这标志着解放军海军首次在此次活动中设立这样的专门展示区。珠海已成为国际国防和航空航天史上最重要的活动之一，成为中国快速发展的航空和军事工业的主要公开展示地。两年一度的中国国际航空航天展览会（俗称中国航展）于 1996 年首次举办，为展示中国一些最先进的军事硬件提供了难得的机会，其中包括在其他地方很少如此详细展示的飞机和系统。虽然该活动也是中国航空航天工业向潜在国际客户推广其产品的主要平台，但它日益成为展示新军事能力和提供难以评估的项目的重要场所。
第十五届中国国际航空航天展览会（又称 2024 年中国航展）于 2024 年 11 月 15 日在中国广东省珠海市中国国际航空航天展览中心举行。摄影：VCG/VCG via Getty Images 前几届已经取得了一些特别重大的进展。 2016 年的展会上，J-20 隐形战斗机首次公开飞行亮相，而 2018 年的展会则以不同寻常的方式展示了这架飞机，包括展示其装载空对空导弹的内部武器舱。 2022年的展会上，歼20首次在珠海进行静态展示，同时还有运20重型运输机、直20直升机以及在展会上进行首次飞行演示的运20空中加油机。最近，2024 年的展会特别引人注目的是 J-35A 隐形战斗机的公开亮相和具有弹射能力的 J-15T 舰​​载战斗机的出现。一架 J-15T 舰​​载战斗机在 2024 年中国航展上进行飞行表演。CFOTO/Future Publishing via Getty Images 今年的展览定于 12 月 7 日至 13 日举行，除其他外，将展示中国海军的广泛能力，特别强调其舰载航空能力的快速发展，这一点我们过去已经详细讨论过。
预计将亮相的最引人注目的飞机包括 J-15T 舰载战斗机、作战型 J-35 隐形战斗机、KJ-600 舰载机载预警和控制 (AEW&C) 飞机、Z-20 直升机的几种海军型号，也许最重要的是新型 JL-15 舰载教练机，它是陆基 JL-10 的发展型。JL-15 舰载教练机的照片突出显示了制动钩和弹射器发射杆。虽然我们之前在珠海见过 J-15T，但如果它配备国产 WS-10H2 发动机，将会引起特别的兴趣。这样的配置将让人们更仔细地了解中国舰载侧卫衍生产品的最新演变

【原文 English Original】
China’s People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) says it’s preparing a major presence at the upcoming 16th China International Aviation & Aerospace Exhibition in Zhuhai, with warships , carrier-based aircraft , advanced weapons systems, and uncrewed platforms set to feature prominently. The expanded naval component will include a new maritime equipment exhibition area at Gaolan Port, located just on the other side of the bay, marking the first time the PLAN has established such a dedicated display at the event. Zhuhai has become one of the most important events on the international defence and aerospace calendar, serving as China’s principal public showcase for its rapidly developing aviation and military industries. First held in 1996, the biennial China International Aviation & Aerospace Exhibition, commonly known as Airshow China, provides an unusual opportunity to see some of the country’s most advanced military hardware, including aircraft and systems that are rarely shown in such detail elsewhere. While the event also serves as a major platform for China’s aerospace industry to promote its products to potential international customers , it has increasingly become an important venue for revealing new military capabilities and offering glimpses of programs that are otherwise difficult to assess. A general view of the 15th China International Aviation & Aerospace Exhibition, or Airshow China 2024, at the China International Aviation & Aerospace Exhibition Center on November 15, 2024, in Zhuhai, Guangdong Province of China. Photo by VCG/VCG via Getty Images Previous editions have produced some particularly significant developments. The 2016 show saw the J-20 stealth fighter make its first public flying appearance , while the 2018 edition provided an unusually revealing look at the aircraft, including a demonstration of its internal weapons bays, loaded with air-to-air missiles . The 2022 exhibition featured the J-20 on static display for the first time at Zhuhai, alongside the Y-20 heavy transport aircraft, Z-20 helicopter, and YY-20 aerial refueling tanker, which made its first flying demonstration at the event. More recently, the 2024 exhibition was particularly notable for the public debut of the J-35A stealth fighter and the appearance of the catapult-capable J-15T carrier-based fighter. A J-15T carrier-based fighter conducts a flight demonstration at Airshow China 2024. CFOTO/Future Publishing via Getty Images This year’s exhibition, scheduled to take place from December 7 to 13, will showcase, among others, a broad range of the PLAN’s capabilities, with a particularly notable emphasis on the rapid evolution of its carrier aviation capabilities, something we have addressed in detail in the past . Among the most noteworthy aircraft expected to feature are the J-15T carrier-based fighter, the operational J-35 stealth fighter, the KJ-600 carrier-based airborne early warning and control (AEW&C) aircraft, several naval variants of the Z-20 helicopter, and, perhaps most significantly, the new JL-15 carrier-capable trainer, a development of the land-based JL-10 . A photo of the JL-15 carrier-capable trainer with the arrestor hook and catapult launch bar highlighted. Chinese internet via X While we have seen the J-15T at Zhuhai before, the aircraft will be of particular interest if it is shown with the indigenous WS-10H2 engine. Such a configuration would offer a closer look at the latest evolution of China’s carrier-based Flanker derivative and its ongoing transition toward a more domestically supported carrier aviation ecosystem. The appearance of the J-35 would be another major highlight. The aircraft represents a significant step in the PLAN’s carrier aviation ambitions, bringing a fifth-generation stealth fighter capability into the carrier air wing. Its presence would provide another opportunity to examine the progress of China’s next-generation naval fighter program. Back in 2014, Zhuhai saw the public debut of the FC-31 fighter demonstrator. At the time, it was still a land-based concept, and export was the main talking point, although there was already speculation about a naval variant, today’s J-35. A People’s Liberation Army Navy J-35 fighter during trials from the carrier Fujian last year. Chinese internet via X Meanwhile, the KJ-600 is arguably one of the most important developments in the PLAN’s carrier aviation ecosystem. The twin-engine turboprop aircraft is designed to provide airborne early warning and battle management capabilities, something that would transform the situational awareness and coordination available to China’s carrier strike groups. One of the first high-definition photos of the KJ-600 carrier-based airborne early warning and control (AEW&C) aircraft. Chinese internet via X Several variants of the Z-20 family are also expected to feature, reflecting the growing importance of helicopters in carrier operations, including airborne anti-submarine warfare, utility, and other maritime support missions. You can read more about the Z-20 family and other Chinese rotary-wing developments in this previous TWZ deep-dive on the topic . A Z-20F, the anti-submarine warfare variant of the naval Z-20 family. Three more naval Z-20s are seen in the hangar behind, including a Z-20J shipborne transport and assault variant. Chinese internet via X Perhaps the most intriguing aircraft on the list, however, is the JL-15. The JL-15 is derived from the Hongdu JL-10, also exported as the L-15 Falcon, a twin-engine advanced jet trainer and lead-in fighter trainer. The navalized development was initially reported to be designated JL-10J, but is now confirmed as being the JL-15. A tailhook-equipped mockup was spotted alongside the aircraft carrier Fujian in 2024. However, its operational status remains unclear, and China is known to have encountered difficulties with its earlier JL-9G naval trainer, whose tailhook was reportedly deleted following structural problems. Regarding the rumoured JL-10J carrier-capable jet trainer, another hint was spotted next to the carrier Fujian: It appears to be an unfinished JL-10J mockup stored on the dockside . So question is: Two tails as shown in the latest CG or just one like the regular JL-10? pic.twitter.com/BM8W8MRGWK — @Rupprecht_A (@RupprechtDeino) March 19, 2024 Its appearance would provide a particularly interesting indication of how China is thinking about training its next generation of carrier-based pilots. A carrier-capable development of the JL-10 would be an important addition to the emerging carrier aviation ecosystem, bridging the gap between conventional jet training and the demanding requirements of operating from an aircraft carrier. The JL-15 also makes an interesting comparison with the U.S. Navy’s somewhat stuttering efforts to introduce a new training jet for its carrier pilots. The U.S. Navy’s Undergraduate Jet Training System (UJTS) program is intended to replace its aging fleet of T-45 Goshawk trainers, but the acquisition effort has encountered considerable difficulties. Earlier this month, we described how Sierra Nevada Corporation (SNC) withdrew its proposed clean-sheet Freedom Jet from the competition, citing concerns over the Navy’s insistence on firm-fixed-price production commitments before the aircraft’s design had sufficiently matured. This leaves the Beechcraft M-346N , based on Leonardo’s established M-346 Master , as the only publicly known remaining contender . The program has also experienced schedule slippage, with the initial contract award now expected in the fourth quarter of Fiscal Year 2027. Perhaps more significant is the difference in the two services’ approaches to carrier aviation training. The U.S. Navy has removed the requirement for its next-generation jet trainer to be capable of operating from an actual aircraft carrier, including carrier qualification and simulated carrier touch-and-goes at land-based facilities. Instead, it increasingly relies on advanced simulation, virtualized training, and assisted carrier landing technologies to prepare pilots for the demands of carrier operations. The JL-15, by contrast, is intended to support carrier-based pilot training. A dedicated carrier-capable trainer could offer China a more direct pathway for preparing pilots for operations aboard its increasingly sophisticated — and expanding — carrier fleet. Taken together, the PLAN aircraft being lined up for Zhuhai this year illustrate the increasingly sophisticated and integrated nature of China’s carrier aviation ambitions . As well as the aircraft carriers and their embarked aircraft, these ambitions also require other surface and subsurface vessels to operate effectively. Uncrewed systems will form another important part of the display. The exhibition will include aerial drones, uncrewed underwater vehicles, and other autonomous platforms, reflecting the PLAN’s growing interest in the potential of uncrewed warfare. Chinese media reports suggest that the WZ-2 uncrewed helicopter will receive its public debut at Zhuhai, while the PLAN may well also want to capitalize on its recent announcement that it had successfully launched and recovered a GJ-21 stealthy flying-wing uncrewed combat air vehicle (UCAV) aboard the Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan . GJ-21. Chinese internet via X A chance to see the GJ-21 up close would be a huge deal, but there are many other naval drone options that could be revealed in more detail. There are likely to be more navalized collaborative combat aircraft (CCA) concepts and developments, especially since the adoption of the electromagnetic aircraft launch system (EMALS) catapult opens up a huge range of possibilities for uncrewed aircraft operating as part of a carrier air wing. Potentially, these could include the mysterious MQ-25-like drone that we recently discussed , the role of which remains unclear. On top of that, constant CCA testing at locations such as Malan suggests there could be much more to discuss than just the systems officially highlighted. Many other naval drones will surely be on display as well, including lower-end attritable concepts. Beyond static displays, China’s navy plans to organize flight demonstrations, formation flights, and simulated operational exercises. Its stated aim is to highlight not only the capabilities of individual platforms but also their ability to operate together in complex maritime environments. Photos have emerged showing apparent rehearsals for the display, presenting examples of the J-15, J-35, and KJ-600 to represent Beijing’s broader carrier air wing ecosystem. Two J-15s, two J-35s, and a KJ-600 purportedly taking part in a rehearsal for a formation fly-over at Zhuhai. Chinese internet via X It is not immediately clear which versions of the J-15 are participating in this formation flight: they could be J-15Ts, but another possibility is the electronic warfare version, the J-15DT , that we have profiled in the past. Regardless, they highlight how China’s carrier aviation ambitions are increasingly focused on catapult-assisted takeoff but arrested recovery (CATOBAR) operations, which offer many advantages . The J-15DT electronic warfare version of the Chinese carrier Flanker is outfitted for operations aboard catapult-equipped flattops like the Fujian . Chinese internet via X For the first time, the exhibition will also include a substantial surface fleet component, making use of the docks at the nearby Gaolan Port. Among the vessels expected to be featured are the Type 075 amphibious assault ship, the Type 055 guided-missile destroyer, and the Type 054A guided-missile frigate. Their presence will offer a public-facing showcase of China’s increasingly sophisticated surface fleet and its expanding range of maritime capabilities. It should also be recalled that it was at Gaolan Port where at least one Chinese uncrewed surface vessel , a distinctive trimaran craft, was first spotted. The Type 055 guided-missile destroyer Nanchang sails during the naval exercise Joint Sea-2021 on October 19, 2021, in the Western part of the Pacific Ocean. Photo by Sun Zifa/China News Service via Getty Images The broader messaging surrounding the exhibition is also notable. According to the PLAN, this year’s displays will place greater emphasis on operational readiness and training, with active-duty equipment that regularly participates in exercises and maritime security missions taking precedence over purely exhibition-oriented displays. This should underscore how Beijing has rapidly spun up its naval capabilities, introducing new and more capable equipment that is increasingly capable of more sustained out-of-area operations. The expanded naval presence at Zhuhai looks set to provide a substantial public showcase of China’s ongoing naval modernization. As well as the combination of the J-15T, J-35, KJ-600, and Z-20 variants, the JL-15 points to an increasingly comprehensive carrier aviation enterprise. And, judging by previous editions of the show, there will almost certainly be more novelties on display as well. Contact the author: thomas@thewarzone.com The post China’s Naval Developments Set For The Spotlight At Zhuhai Airshow appeared first on TWZ .

content:
香港举办亚洲申诉专员协会30周年论坛|中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 24 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港将举办亚洲申诉专员协会30周年论坛
香港将于2026年12月1日举办亚洲申诉专员协会30周年国际论坛暨第27届理事会周年会议，行政长官李家超将出席开幕礼。此次活动将聚集来自20个国家和地区的约130名参与者。
香港申诉专员将于 2026 年 12 月 1 日星期二在香港柏丽酒店主办亚洲申诉专员协会 30 周年国际论坛暨第 27 届理事会周年会议。此次活动标志着该协会的一个里程碑，国际监察员齐聚该市。
香港行政长官李家港、中央人民政府驻香港联络办公室主任周济、中华人民共和国外交部驻香港特别行政区特派员公署副特派员张长伟将作为主礼嘉宾出席开幕式。中央纪委、国家监委对此次活动给予支持。中央纪委副书记、国家监委副主任张忠也将作为主宾出席开幕式并发表主旨演讲。
论坛以“亚洲监察员协会引领道路30年：加强问责、协作进步、促进善治”为主题，将促进监察员、专业人士和学者交流关于促进善治的见解和经验。活动吸引了来自五大洲约20个国家和地区的约130名海内外人士参加，其中包括监察员、高级官员和国际组织代表。行政会议成员、立法会议员、政府高级官员以及本地专业人士和学者也已登记出席。
申诉专员表示，亦会借此机会与亚洲八个国家和地区的申诉专员机构签署双边谅解备忘录，扩大与亚洲伙伴机构的交流和联系，凸显香港作为“超级联系人”和“超级增值者”的角色。

Hong Kong to host Asian Ombudsman Association 30th anniversary forum | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 24 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong to host Asian Ombudsman Association 30th anniversary forum
Hong Kong will host the Asian Ombudsman Association's 30th anniversary international forum and 27th annual council meeting on 1 December 2026. Chief Executive John Lee will attend the opening ceremony. The event will gather about 130 participants from 20 countries and regions.
The Ombudsman of Hong Kong will host the Asian Ombudsman Association’s 30th anniversary international forum and 27th annual council meeting on Tuesday, 1 December 2026, at the Park Lane Hotel in Hong Kong. The event marks a milestone for the association, with international ombudsmen gathering in the city.
Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee, Director of the Central People’s Government Liaison Office in Hong Kong Zhou Ji, and Deputy Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People’s Republic of China in Hong Kong Zhang Changwei will attend the opening ceremony as honorary guests of honour. The Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervision Commission are supporting the event. Zhang Zhong, deputy secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and deputy director of the National Supervision Commission, will also attend the opening ceremony as an honorary guest and deliver a keynote speech.
The forum, with the theme “Asian Ombudsman Association Leading the Way for 30 Years: Strengthening Accountability, Collaborative Progress and Promoting Good Governance”, will facilitate exchanges of insights and experiences on promoting good governance among ombudsmen, professionals and scholars. The event has attracted about 130 overseas and mainland participants from around 20 countries and regions across five continents, including ombudsmen, senior officials and representatives of international organisations. Members of the Executive Council, Legislative Council members, senior government officials, and local professionals and academics have also registered to attend.
The Ombudsman said it will also take the opportunity to sign bilateral memoranda of understanding with ombudsman institutions from eight Asian countries and regions, to expand exchanges and ties with partner institutions in Asia and highlight Hong Kong’s role as a “super connector” and “super value-adder”.

title: 台灣警政署選前4波掃黑 守護民主法治國安

content:
2026年11月24日，中華民國內政部警政署舉行「鐵腕淨化選前治安 警組合拳重擊犯罪黑幫！掃蕩依附營生行業、斬斷在地協力黑手、守護民主法治國安」記者會。（警政署提供）
【大紀元2026年11月24日訊】（大紀元記者鍾元台灣報導）中華民國九合一地方選舉將於28日舉行，為維護選前治安，警政署近3個月共發動4波全國掃黑專案行動，共查獲包括以治平專案模式緝獲的幫派背景犯嫌1,420人次、查扣不法利得折合2,472萬餘元（新台幣，以下同）。警政署重擊犯罪黑幫，掃蕩幫派依附營生的行業，斬斷在地協力黑手，守護民主法治與國家安全。
中華民國警政署刑事局今天（24日）舉行記者會說明，近期警方在偵辦多起重大案件時發現，部分國內幫派分子涉嫌跨區串連，形成協力掩護、接應要犯藏匿與偷渡的地下網絡，例如立委高金素梅前辦公室主任張俊傑因涉貪污與國安法案件，於9月6日破壞電子手環棄保潛逃偷渡出境，專案小組迄今已查獲數十名涉嫌協助其逃亡的共犯。
此外，刑事局指出，亦有不法組織涉嫌受國外勢力遠端指揮，甚至委託不肖徵信業者，針對特定公眾人物進行跟監、恐嚇、傷害等跨國鎮壓滋擾行為，例如新北地方檢察署偵結起訴的前徵信業者鄭博軒等5人跟監並以製造假車禍方式衝撞曾發表政治言論的相聲演員黃逸豪，企圖製造寒蟬效應。以上協力犯罪行為，已嚴重戕害國家安全及民主法治。
為防範黑道幫派與境外勢力合流，進而淪為外部滲透之在地協力者，同時維護2026年地方公職人員選舉期間的社會秩序、防範外部勢力干預民主法治，警政署統合全國各警察機關，自9月中旬起，運用系統性掃黑的打核心、追金流、斷生計策略，以堅壁清野的方式動員優勢警力，針對幫派犯罪組織與跨國鎮壓的不法協力分子，以組合拳方式接連規劃實施數個全國同步掃黑專案。
其中包含4波「全國同步掃蕩黑幫活動處所行動」（打行業、斷生計）、治平專案「全國同步打擊黑幫行動」（打人打核心、打錢追金流），累計動員警力2萬2,734人次、執行專案臨檢處所5,666處次，並查獲包括以治平專案模式緝獲之幫派背景犯嫌1,420人次、查扣不法利得折合2,472萬1,742元，展現政府捍衛治安與國安的堅定決心。
刑事局指出，9月中旬起，針對協助、接應、掩護要犯逃亡所串連的北、中、南涉案幫派勢力以及近來數起勾結境外勢力對台灣民眾實施鎮壓案件的協力組織、人員與據點進行4波堅壁清野掃蕩行動；其中包含特定幫派組合圍事、依附行業與宮廟據點。
一、第1波（9月18日至9月23日）：動員警力5,597人次、臨檢幫派經常活動處所計1,462處次，查獲含治平專案成果之幫派犯嫌410人次。
二、第2波（10月12日至10月18日）：動員警力5,138人次、臨檢幫派經常活動處所計1,429處次，查獲含治平專案成果之幫派犯嫌305人次。
三、第3波（10月27日至11月4日）：動員警力4,420人次、臨檢幫派經常活動處所計1,259處次，查獲含治平專案成果之幫派犯嫌451人次。
四、第4波（11月13日至11月20日）：動員警力7,579人次、搜索及臨檢幫派經常活動處所計1,516處次，查獲含治平專案成果之幫派犯嫌254人次。
台灣選前的4波專案掃蕩中，以治平專案模式查獲包括涉及前揭在地協力黑幫組織之案件計35件171人，涉案組織包括竹聯幫、四海幫、天道盟、太陽聯盟及北聯幫等其它幫派組合、犯罪組織的重要幹部與成員。例如刑事警察局分別查獲太陽聯盟副會長洪男、隊長楊男共2案20人，涉嫌組成暴力及詐欺犯罪集團，共查扣現金155萬餘元、幫派匾額、服飾徽章、毒品、槍械、規章守則等證物。
警政署重申，治安維護沒有休假日，掃蕩幫派永無截止日。台灣是民主法治國家，絕不容許黑道幫派或其它犯罪組織挑釁公權力，更不容許任何國外勢力利用犯罪組織實施不法行為以及妨害各級選舉公正。警方將秉持「零容忍」之態度強力掃黑，從人流、金流到行業據點全面截斷；不分黨派、不問身分，只要涉及犯罪，一律依法究辦，絕不寬貸。呼籲民眾如發現任何可疑不法情事或幫派滋擾行為，請立即撥打110或向各地警察機關檢舉，警民攜手共同守護乾淨、安全的選舉環境。

黄重返英伟达后，美国不会放松对中国的出口管制——专家
总部位于悉尼的 Moomoo ANZ 首席市场策略师 Tapas Strickland 指出，芯片出口管制正在收紧，“国会正在讨论下个月快速通过芯片出口管制法案”
纽约，11 月 24 日。/塔斯社/。路透社援引专家的话说，黄仁勋重新担任英伟达总裁兼首席执行官不会导致美国放松对中国芯片出口的限制。
北京巨石基金管理公司基金经理曾万平表示，“黄仁勋的回归将有利于其供应链中的中国股票。但美国不会放松对中国的芯片管制。”
盛宝驻新加坡首席投资策略师查鲁·查纳纳 (Charu Chanana) 表示，“鉴于台积电在英伟达芯片生产和更广泛的半导体供应商生态系统中的核心作用，台湾可以说是最大的受益者。”这位专家补充道，对于中国来说，“情况更为复杂”。总部位于悉尼的 Moomoo ANZ 首席市场策略师 Tapas Strickland 指出，芯片出口管制正在收紧，“国会将在下个月快速通过芯片出口管制法案。”
11 月 12 日，黄仁勋因与一名涉嫌为中国从事间谍活动的女性关系丑闻，辞去英伟达首席执行官兼总裁职务，并辞去公司董事会职务。中国外交部驳斥了有关她为中国情报部门工作的指控，称其为诽谤。 11月23日，英伟达宣布重新任命黄仁勋为公司总裁兼首席执行官。该决定是由董事会一致做出的。该公司指出，它已收到美国政府的信息，表明此举不会对国家安全构成威胁。彭博社援引消息人士的话报道称，公司于 11 月 22 日晚间在未咨询公司管理层的情况下做出了复职决定。

US will not ease export controls on China following Huang’s return to Nvidia — experts
Tapas Strickland, Chief Market Strategist at Sydney-based Moomoo ANZ, pointed to chip export controls tightening, "with talk of Congress fast-tracking a chip export control bill next month"
NEW YORK, November 24. /TASS/. Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as president and CEO of Nvidia will not lead to any easing of US restrictions on chip exports to China, Reuters reported, citing experts.
"Jensen Huang’s return will benefit Chinese stocks in its supply chain. But the US will not relax chip controls against China," said Zeng Wanping, fund manager of Beijing Monolith Fund Management.
According to Charu Chanana, Chief Investment Strategist at Saxo, based in Singapore, "Taiwan is arguably the biggest beneficiary, given TSMC’s central role in Nvidia’s chip production and the broader ecosystem of semiconductor suppliers." For China, "the picture is more complicated," the expert added. Tapas Strickland, Chief Market Strategist at Sydney-based Moomoo ANZ, pointed to chip export controls tightening, "with talk of Congress fast-tracking a chip export control bill next month."
On November 12, Huang stepped down as CEO and president of Nvidia and resigned from the company’s board of directors amid a scandal over his relationship with a woman suspected of spying for China. The Chinese Foreign Ministry dismissed allegations that she worked for Chinese intelligence as slander. On November 23, Nvidia announced that Huang had been reappointed as president and CEO of the company. The decision was made by the board unanimously. The company noted that it had received information from the US administration indicating that such a move would not pose a threat to national security. The decision on reinstatement was made on the evening of November 22 without consulting the company’s management, Bloomberg reported, citing sources.

是的，不，也许？能够（或不能）交付乌克兰要求的 40 架 F-16 的国家 - Breaking Defense
2025 年 8 月 21 日，南达科他州乔福斯机场，第 114 战斗机联队的一架 F-16 战斗机在加力启动的情况下开始夜间飞行行动。（美国空军国民警卫队军士长卢克·奥尔森摄）
米兰和贝尔法斯特——上周，当俄罗斯无人机和导弹如雨点般袭击乌克兰领土时，总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基恳求欧洲国家元首提供更多 F-16 来保卫国家——并给出了非常具体的数量。
“我们现在拥有的 F-16 ......花了很多时间进行维修而不是飞行。所以我们需要更多的战斗机。更多的 F-16 ......我感谢我们空军联盟中的每个国家。已经做了很多工作，但我们需要做得更多。具体来说，我们还需要 40 架 F-16，”泽连斯基周二在第 37 次乌克兰国防联络小组 (UDCG) 会议上以 Ramstein 格式表示。
这就提出了两个问题：首先，为什么是 40？其次，哪些国家能够现实地交付这么多飞机？
虽然乌克兰政府没有公布其航空武器库的官方清单，但航空出版物 AeroCorner 援引开源数据库估计，截至 2026 年 9 月，乌克兰拥有 39 架 F-16AM 战斗机。据报道，到 2025 年底，这些飞机执行了该国空军约 80% 的出动架次，包括所有任务类型。 （FlightGlobal 的 World Air Force 2026 目录显示乌克兰拥有 35 架较旧的 F-16A 型号；鉴于乌克兰信息的不透明性，两个数据集之间的微小差异是有道理的）。
对于泽连斯基的观点，总部位于伦敦的皇家联合军种研究所最近发​​布的一份报告强调了包括 F-16 在内的西方战斗机在击落俄罗斯无人机方面的作用。如果这些飞机被迫执行该任务，则意味着乌克兰可能在其他地方使用的昂贵和稀有资产会受到严重磨损。因此，基辅寻求将其机队规模扩大一倍是有道理的——尽管这可能并不容易。
乌克兰国防部没有回应就为何 40 架喷气式飞机成为目标的置评请求。欧洲政策分析中心的国防分析师费德里科·博尔萨里 (Federico Borsari) 告诉 Breaking Defense，虽然 40 架飞机是一个“合法的要求”，但这也是一个“雄心勃勃的庞大数字，而且在乌克兰获得它们绝对不容易，尤其是在短时间内”。
那么，它们从哪里来呢？显而易见的答案是首先关注 F-16 最大运营商（也是唯一生产商）的美国。然而，除了一些无法使用的机身外，华盛顿一直不愿意向乌克兰提供自己机队中的战斗机。因此，基辅将再次关注其欧洲支持者。
欧洲的军事优势取决于对事实真相的主权指挥
随着北约和欧洲各国政府加速对天基情报的投资，决策优势将取决于主权和商业能力能够多快地融入可信的作战图景。
据无处不在的追踪器 F-16.net 称，截至撰写本文时，八个欧洲国家（乌克兰除外）正在使用或正在将这些战斗机投入现役，另外三个国家——挪威、荷兰和丹麦——已经退役了这些战斗机。
周二的会议结束后，只有比利时被正式列为愿意在年底前提供 F-16-10 的国家。布鲁斯

Yes, no, maybe? The countries that can (or can't) deliver Ukraine's 40 requested F-16s - Breaking Defense
An F-16 Fighting Falcon from the 114th Fighter Wing launches into night flying operations with the afterburner engaged at Joe Foss Field, S.D., Aug. 21, 2025. (U.S. Air National Guard photo by Master Sgt. Luke Olson)
MILAN and BELFAST — Last week, as Russian drones and missiles rained down on Ukrainian territory, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy pleaded with European heads of state for more F-16s to defend the country — with a very specific number.
“The F-16s we have now… spend a lot of time being repaired instead of flying. So we need more fighter jets. More F-16s… I’m grateful to every country in our Air Force Coalition. A lot has already been done, but we need to do more. Specifically, we need 40 more F-16s,” Zelenskyy said at the 37th Ukraine Defense Contact Group (UDCG) meeting on Tuesday in the Ramstein format.
That raises two questions: First, why 40? Second, which countries could realistically deliver this many aircraft?
While the Ukrainian government does not publish an official inventory of its aerial arsenal, the aviation publication AeroCorner, citing open-source databases, estimated that as of Sept. 2026, Ukraine possesses 39 F-16AM Fighting Falcons. It reported that by the end of 2025, these aircraft were flying around 80 percent of all the country’s Air Force sorties, including all mission types. (FlightGlobal’s World Air Force 2026 directory says Ukraine has 35 of the older F-16A models; a small discrepancy between the two datasets makes sense given the opaque nature of information out of Ukraine).
To Zelenskyy’s point, a recent report published by the London-based Royal United Services Institute emphasized the role of Western fighter jets, including the F-16s, to shoot down Russian drones. If the jets are forced into service for that mission, it means heavy wear and tear on expensive and rare assets that Ukraine could be using elsewhere. Hence, Kyiv seeking to roughly double its fleet makes sense — though likely won’t be easy.
The Ukrainian Ministry of Defense did not respond to a request for comment on why 40 jets is the target. Federico Borsari, a defense analyst with the Center for European Policy Analysis, told Breaking Defense that while 40 planes were a “legitimate request,” it was also “an ambitious, big number and definitely not easy to get them in Ukraine, especially in a short period of time.”
So, where could they come from? The obvious answer would be to look first to the United States, the largest operator (and sole producer) of the F-16. However, aside from some non-operational airframes, Washington has been unwilling to provide Ukraine with fighter aircraft from its own fleet. So Kyiv will instead look once more to its European supporters.
Europe’s military advantage depends on sovereign command of the ground truth
As NATO and European governments accelerate investment in space-based intelligence, decision advantage will depend on how quickly sovereign and commercial capabilities can be fused into a trusted operational picture.
According to the ubiquitous tracker F-16.net, at the time of writing, eight European countries (outside Ukraine) operate or are introducing the fighter jets into active military service, and three others — Norway, the Netherlands, and Denmark — have retired them.
After Tuesday’s meeting, only Belgium was officially listed as willing to provide F-16s—10 by the end of the year. Brussels announced back in 2024 that it would eventually give Ukraine 30 F-16s as the military transitions its fighter fleet to the F-35, also made by Lockheed Martin. According to FlightGlobal’s directory, Belgium has 52 F-16s (44 F-16AMs and 8 F-16BMs) and is expected to reach full operational readiness of its F-35 fleet in 2030 (ordered 34 F-35As and plans to acquire 11 more).
As for any additional F-16s, Bosari said that even if European countries agree to send planes to Ukraine, several factors would make such deliveries complex in the short term, from the need to modernize some jets to reactivate retired ones, secure third-party transfer authorization (as with Belgian F-16s), and complete lengthy maintenance work.
There may also be a time crunch for Zelenskyy, Borsari said, thanks to upcoming elections in some European nations are another factor likely to affect or complicate potential fighter deliveries.
“In some countries, such as France, [which pledged at the UDCG meeting to send two Mirage 2000-5F to Ukraine by the end of 2026], where elections are coming up, it might be more complex to justify these transfers in the eyes of the population. I’m not saying it won’t happen, but there is a political dimension to these agreements that are also politically sensitive in some nations,” the expert said.
Three European countries operating F-16 fighter jets — Greece, Slovakia, and Poland — have scheduled national parliamentary elections in 2027.
Here is what to know about the state of the rest of Europe’s F-16 fleets.
Nearly five years after Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, several European nations appear to be at a crossroads, asking themselves whether they can release any operational fighter jets without weakening or altogether putting at risk their own air forces.
While most countries didn’t immediately respond to Zelenskyy’s 40-plane request, Portugal went ahead and ruled out sending F-16 jets to Ukraine, with Portuguese Foreign Minister Paulo Ranger calling such a transfer “essentially impossible” during a press conference in Kyiv last week because the country needs its existing aircraft to protect its own territory.
Greece, one of Europe’s largest F-16 operators, received about 170 fighter jets in different configurations between the 1990s and 2010 and has since undergone a major modernization program. But it has maintained its decision not to transfer any aircraft to Kyiv, opting instead to focus on helping to train Ukrainian pilots and technicians.
Norway retired its F-16 fleet in 2022 after more than 40 years of service, sold 32 to Romania and has already donated six to Ukraine. But the Norwegian Ministry of Defense told Breaking Defense no other F-16s will be forthcoming.
“The remaining [F-16] airframes are not assessed as viable to return to operational service and will be used for purposes such as maintenance training and museum display,” the ministry said.
The Undeclared, And The Unlikely
At this week’s Ramstein meeting, Denmark committed €200 million ($218 million) for air defense and a €645 million package of drones and F-16 ammunition, but did not say whether it would send more F-16s to Kyiv than it already promised. The Scandinavian country has previously said it would transfer up to 19, with the first deliveries made in 2024.
Romania has spent significant effort building its F-16 fleet, which represents the only combat-ready jets the country has, relied on for air policing across the Black Sea. At the same time, it waits for its own F-35 deliveries, expected to start in the early 2030s. As such, it is not likely to be in a position to transfer a significant number of fighters. Romania’s defense ministry did not respond to a request for comment at press time.
Since the onset of the war, Turkey, which possesses the second-largest F-16 fleet in all of NATO, has not publicly committed to send any of its aircraft to Ukraine, focusing rather on drone and armored vehicle donations. The Turkish MoD did not provide comments on the matter at the time of writing.
Slovakia received its full fleet of new F-16 Block 70 fighters this year and ordered four additional ones in September to replace the aging MiG-29s it sent to Ukraine in 2023. But since then, Slovakia’s stance has hardened as the current government has halted most military assistance to Kyiv. The Slovak Ministry of Defense did not respond to a request for comment at press time on whether this remains its position.
Similarly, Poland has previously opted to transfer MiG-29s rather than its F-16s to Ukraine. In 2023, Wojciech Skurkiewicz, Secretary of State at the Ministry of National Defense, told the Polish Parliament that “there was no discussion about handing over F-16 aircraft to the Ukrainian side.” It remains unclear whether this decision has changed. The Polish MoD did not respond to a request for comment at press time.
The Netherlands retired its F-16 in 2024 and completed deliveries of its 24 pledged jets to Ukraine a year later. The country has also supported Kyiv by providing retired aircraft for training and, in February, announced plans to supply F-16 simulators. However, it appears the Dutch have no F-16s left to send to Kyiv, having handed 18 to a training center in Romania for a symbolic one-euro sum in November 2025. The Dutch defense ministry did not respond to a request for comment at press time.
Bulgaria has ordered F-16 Block 70 jets, but local reports note that a delay to a second batch of eight aircraft has led Sofia to explore options for a second-hand fighter jet. The Eastern European country’s political support for military aid supplies to Ukraine is waning, with Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev reportedly stopping weapons and ammunition transfers because of budgetary issues. The country’s MoD did not respond to a request for comment at press time.

The U.K. Foreign and Commonwealth Office in London.
Credit: Wikimedia Commons/Anthony O’Neil
The United Kingdom yesterday announced a new round of sanctions on Myanmar, in response to last week’s ruling by the International Court of Justice (ICJ) that the country committed genocide against the Rohingya Muslim population in 2017.
In a statement, the U.K. government said that it had “formally recognized the genocide committed against the Rohingya” and announced a “major package of measures against the Myanmar military in response to ongoing atrocities in Myanmar.”
The U.K. said that it was imposing sanctions against five senior Myanmar military officers whom Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said were “suspected of involvement in repression of the civilian population and other serious abuses of human rights in Myanmar.” The five – Brig. Myo Htut Hlaing, Maj. Gen. Myo Min Tun, Maj. Gen. Myat Thet Oo, Maj. Gen. Kyaw Soe, and Maj. Gen. Kyaw Swar Oo – will now be subject to asset freezes and travel bans, and will be barred from serving as directors of U.K.-based companies.
London also announced plans for legislation targeting aviation fuel supplies to Myanmar and further humanitarian assistance funding “to support survivors and justice.”
In its ruling on November 19, the ICJ found that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya during a military “clearance operation” in northern Rakhine State in 2017. During the operation, it found that Myanmar’s security forces “killed thousands ​of Rohingya civilians, perpetrated widespread ‌acts ⁠of sexual violence as well as acts of extreme violence ​against children ​and ⁠attacked fleeing Rohingya as they ​sought to flee ​in ⁠large numbers to Bangladesh,” judges found. The case was the first time that a state was held responsible for genocide, and only the fourth time since the Holocaust that an international court ruled that the legal threshold to prove genocide had been met.
“There can be no impunity for these atrocities and the gravest violations of international law,” Miliband said in the statement. “We will stand with the Rohingya and remain committed to supporting a stable future for the people of Myanmar.”
The U.K. has already designated 42 individuals and 39 entities from Myanmar since the coup of 2021, including coup leader-turned-president Min Aung Hlaing, who headed the Myanmar military at the time of the 2017 assaults.
The U.K.’s response has been the most significant taken by any country since the ICJ verdict. In its immediate aftermath, Miliband said that his government had ordered the expulsion of the Myanmar defense attaché from the U.K. and called “urgently” for a U.N. Security Council (UNSC) session to discuss the judgment. France has since joined the call for a UNSC meeting. In yesterday’s statement, the U.K. said that it plans to “work urgently with international partners to ensure that this judgment leads to meaningful action and renewed international pressure.”
While the outcome of the case was a huge success for the Rohingya community, which has finally achieved a measure of recognition for its treatment at the hands of the Myanmar military, the immediate future is uncertain. The ICJ judges declared that Myanmar now has an obligation to compensate the Rohingya for the violations it had committed. It also said that Myanmar must also ​allow the “safe and dignified return to their place of residence and the reunification of families for the Rohingya displaced as a result of Myanmar’s wrongful acts.”
However, with Myanmar’s military-backed government having since rejected the ruling, much depends on whether supportive nations can muster a political and diplomatic response. The U.K. was also among 14 nations that signed a joint statement that acknowledged the November 19 ruling, underscoring its “binding” nature and calling on Myanmar to comply fully with its obligations under international law, including the Court’s decision.” The other nations were Australia, Belgium, Canada, Cyprus, the Czech Republic, Estonia, Iceland, Latvia, Luxembourg, New Zealand, Portugal, Spain, and The Gambia, the latter of which brought the case against Myanmar in 2019.
However, the fact that the statement included only 14 nations (and only eight of the 27 European Union member states), and did not outline a series of actions by which Myanmar could plausibly be forced into compliance with the ruling, does not bode well for either the Rohingya or the trajectory of international justice as a whole.

香港将设立楼宇维修支援局、修订《建筑物条例》中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 24 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港将设立楼宇维修支援局及修订《建筑物条例》
香港发展局局长于 2026 年 11 月 24 日向立法委员会表示，政府将在 2026 年底前成立楼宇维修支援局，并修订《建筑物条例》以改善安全和执法。这些变化是在公共住房火灾报告之后进行的，旨在帮助
发展局局长于2026年11月24日向立法会发展事务委员会表示，政府将于2026年底前成立楼宇维修支援及服务局，并修订《建筑物条例》（第123章），以改善楼宇安全和执法。独立委员会上个月发布了有关大埔宏福苑火灾的报告，推动了全面的系统性改革。
国务卿将这两项提案描述为相辅相成的“组合拳”。新局将为业主提供楼宇维修的全流程支持，包括从2027年1月起委任楼宇检验顾问，以及协助监理顾问和承包商招标。政府将从下个月开始推出三份资格预审名单：一份用于建筑检查顾问，一份用于起草招标文件和监督工程的顾问，一份用于承包商。
该局将优先处理现有“招标合规”计划下积压的案件。到2027年第一季度，将开始针对业主进行项目招标。在施工过程中，该局还将监控业主聘请的顾问和承包商是否提供合同服务。
监管方面，《建筑物条例》修正案将大型建筑物维修纳入新的工程类别，从行业自律转向政府主动监管。该修正案还将对违规行为实行更严厉的处罚。秘书指出，一些建议已于 2024 年底向委员会提交，并于 2025 年初进行了为期两个月的公众咨询，包括要求及时进行建筑物检查和维修、简化对违例建筑物的处理以及加大对违规行为的处罚力度。
根据立法者、业界和公众的反馈，政府调整了部分规定。例如，严重违例建筑物将会被明确界定，并对部分此类建筑物的处理给予宽限期，让业主有时间准备。该修正案还旨在提高屋宇署打击非法建筑工程的执法效率，并加大对违法者的处罚力度。
部长表示，政府的目标是在下一个议程项目中听取委员会对《建筑物条例》修正案的意见后敲定细节，并将于 2027 年初当前任期结束前将该法案提交立法机关。该局预计将于下月底正式成立。

Hong Kong to set up building maintenance support bureau, amend Buildings Ordinance
Hong Kong’s development secretary told a legislative panel on 24 November 2026 that the government will set up a building maintenance support bureau by the end of 2026 and amend the Buildings Ordinance to improve safety and enforcement. The changes follow a public housing fire report and aim to assi
The Secretary for Development told the Legislative Council’s Development Affairs Committee on 24 November 2026 that the government will establish the Building Maintenance Support and Services Bureau by the end of 2026 and amend the Buildings Ordinance (Chapter 123) to improve building safety and enforcement. The announcements follow the release of the independent committee report on the fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po last month, which prompted a comprehensive systemic reform.
The secretary described the two proposals as a “combination punch” that complement each other. The new bureau will provide owners with full-process support for building maintenance, including appointing building inspection consultants from January 2027 and helping with tendering for supervisory consultants and contractors. The government will roll out three pre-qualified lists starting next month: one for building inspection consultants, one for consultants to draft tender documents and supervise works, and one for contractors.
The bureau will prioritise cases backlogged under the existing “Tender Compliance” scheme. By the first quarter of 2027, it will begin project tendering for owners. During construction, the bureau will also monitor whether the consultants and contractors hired by owners deliver contracted services.
On the regulatory side, the Buildings Ordinance amendment will classify large-scale building maintenance as a new category of works, shifting from industry self-regulation to proactive government oversight. The amendment will also introduce heavier penalties for violations. The secretary noted that some proposals, including mandating timely building inspections and repairs, streamlining the handling of unauthorised structures, and raising penalties for non-compliance, were presented to the committee in late 2024 and followed by a two-month public consultation in early 2025.
In response to feedback from lawmakers, the industry and the public, the government has adjusted certain provisions. For example, serious unauthorised structures will be clearly defined, and a grace period will be granted for dealing with some such structures to allow owners time to prepare. The amendment also aims to enhance the Buildings Department’s enforcement effectiveness against illegal building works and increase penalties for offenders.
The secretary said the government aims to finalise details after hearing committee views on the Buildings Ordinance amendment in the next agenda item and will table the bill in the legislature in early 2027, before the current term ends. The bureau is expected to be formally established by the end of next month.

APEC宴会歌单引发网络阴谋论|中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 24 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
APEC宴会歌单引发网络阴谋论
深圳APEC峰会的欢迎宴会上，每位领导人都聆听了一首本国经济的经典歌曲，引发了网上对隐藏外交攻击的猜测。批评者将政治信息纳入菲律宾、日本和台湾的选择中，尽管大多数代表表示欢迎
深圳APEC峰会的一份欢迎宴会曲目在网上引发了一波猜测，网民们对每位来访领导人的歌曲选择进行了所谓的外交攻击。据《标准报》报道，主持人本意将这些选择作为一种热情好客和文化尊重的姿态，但社交媒体上的批评者过度解读了这些选择。
菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯演奏了经典民谣《Anak》（“孩子”），歌词讲述了一个任性的孩子迷失方向并悔改的故事。菲律宾网友解读为“浪子回头”，是对南海争端的间接攻击。然而，马科斯本人公开称赞《阿纳克》是菲律宾的标志性经典，并表示北京的选择让人感到温暖和体贴，而不是冒犯。
日本首相高市早苗受到“Ue o Muite Aruko”（“走路时抬头”，国际上称为“寿喜烧”）的欢迎。尽管这首歌最初表达了20世纪60年代普通民众的情感，但批评者挖掘了它与抗议美日安保条约的历史联系，称其是对美日同盟内部摩擦的蓄意攻击。
台湾代表施振荣进入“高山青”。由于它出现在电影《阿里山风云》中，批评者声称它反映了汉人对当时原住民的刻板印象，并强调了“大中华叙事”和文化统一战线思维。
近期APEC峰会的记录显示，东道主此前并未采用“每位领导人一首歌”的欢迎方式，这使得深圳的做法成为一种创新。其他入选作品包括香港的《狮子山下》、澳大利亚的《Click Go the Shears》、印度尼西亚的《Bengawan Solo》、韩国的《阿里郎》和加拿大的《红河谷》——为每个经济体选择的广为人知的代表性作品。
值得注意的是，大部分播放列表都没有引起轰动。报告称，由于中国与这些经济体的关系近来紧张，一些观察家用有色眼镜看待例行礼节，将政治操纵解读为普通的招待。峰会期间，哪些经济体与北京关系密切，哪些经济体受到冷遇，这些都可以从公共礼节中一目了然——例如机场欢迎级别以及是否举行双边会议——几乎不需要在宴会播放列表中寻找隐藏的答案。

APEC banquet playlist sparks online conspiracy theories | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 24 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
APEC banquet playlist sparks online conspiracy theories
A welcome banquet at the Shenzhen APEC summit, where each leader was greeted with a classic song from their home economy, has triggered online speculation of hidden diplomatic jabs. Critics read political messages into selections for the Philippines, Japan and Taiwan, though most delegates welcomed
A welcome banquet playlist at the Shenzhen APEC summit has triggered a wave of online speculation, with netizens reading supposed diplomatic jabs into the song choices for each visiting leader. The host intended the selections as a gesture of hospitality and cultural respect, but critics on social media have over-interpreted the choices, according to The Standard.
Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr entered to the classic ballad “Anak” (“Child”), whose lyrics tell of a wayward child who loses his way and repents. Filipino netizens read it as urging a “prodigal son to return” and an oblique swipe over South China Sea disputes. However, Marcos himself publicly praised “Anak” as an iconic Filipino classic, saying Beijing’s selection felt warm and thoughtful rather than offensive.
Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi was welcomed with “Ue o Muite Aruko” (“I Look Up as I Walk,” known internationally as “Sukiyaki”). Although the song originally voiced the sentiments of ordinary people in the 1960s, critics dug up its historical link to protests against the US-Japan Security Treaty, alleging it was a deliberate jab at frictions within the US-Japan alliance.
Taiwan representative Stan Shih entered to “Gao Shan Qing” (“High Mountain Green”). Because it was featured in the film Alishan Fengyun, detractors claimed it reflected Han Chinese stereotypes of indigenous peoples at the time and underscored a “Greater China narrative” and cultural united-front mindset.
Records from recent APEC summits show hosts had not previously adopted a “one song per leader” welcome format, making Shenzhen’s approach an innovation. Other selections included Hong Kong’s “Below the Lion Rock,” Australia’s “Click Go the Shears,” Indonesia’s “Bengawan Solo,” South Korea’s “Arirang” and Canada’s “Red River Valley”—widely familiar, representative works chosen for each economy.
Notably, most of the playlist caused no stir. With China’s relations with these economies strained of late, some observers have viewed routine protocol through a tinted lens, reading political maneuvering into ordinary hospitality, the report said. During the summit, which economies enjoyed warm ties with Beijing and which faced a chillier reception was already clear from public protocol—such as airport welcome tiers and whether bilateral meetings were held—leaving little need to search for hidden answers in a banquet playlist.

zh_title: 韩国电力巨头 KEPCO 确认数据泄露影响 150 万人
summary: 韩国电力巨头 KEPCO 确认数据泄露影响了 150 万人 韩国电力巨头 KEPCO 确认数据泄露影响了 150 万人 韩国电力巨头 KEPCO 确认数据泄露影响了 150 万人 威胁行为者入侵了韩国电力公司 (KEPCO) 的内部网络，并访问了包含客户、员工和承包商数据的两个系统。此次攻击暴露了超过 150 万人的详细信息，随后该公司阻止了外部 IP 地址的访问并暂停了受影响的服务。 KEPCO 是韩国主要电力公司
content:
韩国电力巨头 KEPCO 确认数据泄露影响 150 万人
韩国电力巨头 KEPCO 确认数据泄露影响 150 万人
韩国电力巨头 KEPCO 确认数据泄露影响 150 万人
威胁行为者入侵了韩国电力公司 (KEPCO) 的内部网络，并访问了包含客户、员工和承包商数据的两个系统。
此次攻击暴露了超过 150 万人的详细信息，随后该公司阻止了外部 IP 地址的访问并暂停了受影响的服务。
韩国电力是韩国主要的电力公司，也是国家控股的韩国关键基础设施的主要运营商。
该组织于 11 月 20 日发现了这次攻击，当时它确认其 KEPCO ON 电力计费平台及其电子采购系统 (SRM) 受到未经授权的访问。
“11 月 20 日星期五，韩国电力公司（以下简称 KEPCO）在总裁金东哲 (Kim Dong-cheol) 的领导下确认，其 IT 系统中保存的一些客户信息已被泄露，”该电力公司表示。
“公司正在尽一切努力防止伤害。”
ON是一个综合客户平台，允许客户查看和支付电费。 SRM是公司的承包服务采购系统。
根据周日发布的公告，曝光了以下内容：
650,487 KEPCO ON 客户：姓名、身份证信息、电话号码、地址、银行名称、银行账号、账户持有人姓名、发卡行、卡号、持卡人姓名以及电费和账单信息。
426,827 名公司代表：姓名、身份信息、电子邮件地址和公司地址。
442,934 名 KEPCO 员工：姓名、所属单位、员工 ID 号、手机号码、电子邮件地址、公司电话号码。
该公司表示，数据泄露是由“人工智能等先进技术”造成的，但没有透露有关初始访问方法或攻击链的具体细节。
韩国电力正在直接通知暴露的个人，已向数据保护机构提交报告，并正在与政府和金融机构协调，以阻止未经授权的交易等滥用行为。
潜在暴露的个人会被警告，暴露的信息可能会被用于有针对性的网络钓鱼和冒充。建议他们向警方或韩国互联网安全局报告任何企图。
还建议避免安装未知应用程序、在可疑表单中输入信息以及通过电话或短信共享敏感数据或验证码。
一名使用“Noiem”别名的威胁行为者声称发动了此次攻击，并于 11 月 19 日在黑客论坛上宣传了此次泄露事件，称他们拥有 KEPCO 用户数据、供应商记录以及投标和合同文件。
韩国个人信息保护委员会另外证实，韩国电力公司于 11 月 19 日收到黑客发来的一封电子邮件，声称数据被盗。
虽然这些说法与现有证据相符，但是否属于诺伊姆仍未得到证实。

South Korea’s power giant KEPCO confirms data breach impacting 1.5 million
South Korea’s power giant KEPCO confirms data breach impacting 1.5 million
South Korea’s power giant KEPCO confirms data breach impacting 1.5 million
A threat actor breached the internal network of Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO) and accessed two systems containing customer, employee, and contractor data.
The attack exposed details of more than 1.5 million individuals before the company blocked access from external IP addresses and suspended the affected services.
KEPCO is South Korea’s main electric power company and a state-controlled, major operator of the country’s critical infrastructure.
The organization detected the attack on November 20, when it confirmed unauthorized access to its KEPCO ON electricity billing platform and its electronic procurement system (SRM).
“On Friday, November 20, Korea Electric Power Corporation (hereafter KEPCO), led by President Kim Dong-cheol, confirmed that some customer information held in its IT systems had been exposed,” the power company states.
“The company is making every effort to prevent harm.”
ON is an integrated customer platform that allows customers to view and pay electricity bills. SRM is the company’s procurement system for contracting services.
According to the announcement, published on Sunday, the following was exposed:
for 650,487 KEPCO ON customers: names, ID information, phone numbers, addresses, bank names, bank account numbers, account holder names, card issuers, card numbers, cardholder names, and electricity charge and billing information.
for 426,827 company representatives: names, ID information, email addresses, and company addresses.
for 442,934 KEPCO employees: names, affiliation, employee ID number, mobile phone number, email address, company phone number.
The company says the data breach resulted from “advanced technologies such as AI,” but it shared no specific details about the initial access method or the attack chain.
KEPCO is notifying exposed individuals directly, has filed a report with the data protection authorities, and is coordinating with government and financial authorities to block abuse such as unauthorized transactions.
Potentially exposed individuals are warned that the exposed information could be used for targeted phishing and impersonation. They are advised to report any attempts to the police or Korea’s Internet and Security Agency.
It is also recommended to avoid installing unknown apps, entering information into suspicious forms, and sharing sensitive data or verification codes over calls or texts.
A threat actor using the “Noiem” alias has claimed the attack and advertised the breach on a hacker forum on November 19, saying that they had KEPCO user data, supplier records, and bidding and contract documents.
South Korea’s Personal Information Protection Commission separately confirmed that KEPCO received an email from a hacker claiming data theft on November 19.
While these claims match the available evidence, attribution to Noiem remains unconfirmed.

content:
陆军出版了保护当地关键基础设施的指南 - Breaking Defense
2025 年 3 月 4 日星期二，美国华盛顿州塔科马港上空出现彩虹。（David Ryder/Bloomberg via Getty Images）
华盛顿——陆军出版了首个此类“手册”，帮助各部队制定计划并与利益相关者协调，以保护其关键基础设施系统。
《国防关键基础设施社区协调指南》于上周与陆军、网络安全和基础设施安全局、联邦调查局、环境保护局、交通部、能源部和联邦紧急事务管理局协调发布。
该指南意义重大且必要，因为驻扎在美国大陆的军事单位必须能够自由地将其人员和资源运送到港口、铁路和机场，以便在危机期间在全球范围内部署。为这些装置提供动力并支持设备运输的关键基础设施系统越来越多地受到对手的攻击。
更糟糕的是，其中许多系统由私营公司和地方政府拥有和运营，而不是联邦政府或军方。
“当敌人或自然灾害破坏市政电网、供水系统或光纤干线时，任务会立即感受到。这就是为什么今天的峰会和新的 DCI 社区协调指南在作战层面至关重要，”上周在刘易斯-麦科德联合基地举行的第二次陆军主导的关键基础设施防御峰会后，第一军团指挥官马修·麦克法兰中将告诉记者。 “今天下午，我们与州、地方、公用事业和港口合作伙伴并肩坐下来演练太平洋西北地区的部署场景，绘制我们共同的依赖关系图，并在危机发生之前确定运营障碍。”
五月份在布拉格堡举行的第一次峰会上提出了制定剧本的想法，目标是创建一个可重复的流程，在全国范围内复制，以便在事件发生时做好更充分的准备。
美国陆军部长首席网络顾问布兰登·皮尤（Brandon Pugh）对记者表示，“我们非常高兴能够获得社区协调指南。我们希望该指南能够继续在整个陆军范围内推广，甚至可以在整个战争部的同事中推广。”

Army publishes guidebook for defending critical infrastructure at local installations - Breaking Defense
A rainbow over the Port of Tacoma in Tacoma, Washington, US, on Tuesday, March 4, 2025. (David Ryder/Bloomberg via Getty Images)
WASHINGTON — The Army has published a first-of-its-kind “playbook” to help installations develop plans and coordinate with stakeholders for the defense of their critical infrastructure systems.
The Defense Critical Infrastructure Community Coordination Guide was published last week, in coordination with the Army, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, FBI, Environmental Protection Agency, Department of Transportation, Department of Energy, and the Federal Emergency Management Agency.
The guide is significant and needed because military units based in the continental United States must be able to freely get their people and resources to ports, rails and airports in order to deploy around the globe during a crisis. Increasingly, the critical infrastructure systems that power these installations and enable the ferrying of equipment are under attack by adversaries.
To make matters worse, many of those systems are owned and operated by private companies and local municipalities, not the federal government or the military.
“When an adversary or natural disaster disrupts a municipal power grid, a water system, or a fiber trunk, the mission feels it immediately. That is why today’s summit and the new DCI community coordination guide are vital at the operational level,” Lt. Gen. Matthew McFarlane, commander of I Corps, told reporters following the second Army-led Defense of Critical Infrastructure summit at Joint Base Lewis-McChord last week. “This afternoon, we sat shoulder to shoulder with our state, local, utility, and port partners to walk through a Pacific Northwest deployment scenario, map our shared dependencies, and identify operational barriers before a crisis ever hits.”
The idea of developing a playbook was teased at the first summit at Fort Bragg in May, with the goal of creating a repeatable process to replicate across the country in order to be more prepared when an incident occurs.
We’re “very excited to have the community coordination guide. That’s something we’re hoping will continue to be scaled across the Army footprint and arguably among our colleagues across the Department of War,” Brandon Pugh, principal cyber advisor to the Secretary of the Army, told reporters.
AUSA 2026: The ground truth on the Army’s next chapter
From autonomous warfare and drone innovation to acquisition reform and defense industrial base challenges, Breaking Defense examines the key developments and strategic priorities shaping the US Army’s future at AUSA 2026.
The guide is broken into five main portions:
A quick start guide with simplified key actions;
Two chapters on the importance of coordination and descriptions of the threat landscape;
A chapter outlining why the military needs to learn about this community and vice versa;
A chapter providing the “how-to” of building relationships and agreements necessary, and;
Annexes with federal, state, local and Army resources that also include vignettes.

summary: 日本富士通寻求美国和中国芯片替代品的需求 - 日本时报 日本富士通寻求美国和中国芯片替代品的需求 富士通首席技术官 Vivek Mahajan 周二在东京接受采访时表示。 |彭博社 作者：Takashi Mochizuki、Mari Kiyohara 和 Avril Hong X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接 据富士通首席技术官称，由于客户寻求美国和中国供应商的替代品，对富士通新型 Monaka 服务器芯片的最初需求超出了预期。短的
content:
日本富士通寻求美国和中国芯片替代品的需求 - 日本时报
日本富士通寻求美国和中国芯片替代品的需求
富士通首席技术官 Vivek Mahajan 周二在东京接受采访。 |彭博社
作者：望月贵、清原麻里、洪艾薇
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
该公司首席技术官表示，由于客户寻求美国和中国供应商的替代品，该公司对新型 Monaka 服务器芯片的最初需求超出了预期。
Vivek Mahajan 表示，在本月这家总部位于东京的公司开始商业销售其最新 2 纳米中央处理器后不久，富士通已经在与其制造商台积电讨论如何确保足够的产能。
他表示，国防、金融、制造和公共部门等领域对主权数据安全的需求正在提高日本、美国和欧洲客户的兴趣。
“最大的挑战是——如果需求真的起飞，我们能否确保供应跟上？”马哈詹周二在接受采访时说道。他说，8 月份收到 Monaka 产品样品的 45 家公司中，大多数都可能下订单。
Mahajan 表示，如果订单超过该公司目前两年内销售量约 50 万台的预估，Fujitsu-Monaka 处理器（以传统日本糖果命名）可能会面临供应限制。他表示，一家生产约 30,000 台服务器的制造商将需要超过 200,000 个 Monaka 芯片。
富士通为日本政府提供计算、人工智能、网络和安全产品，该公司大多将其处理器的使用限制在自己的系统中，例如在富岳超级计算机中使用。富士通希望通过 Monaka 将其采用 Arm Holdings 架构的处理器出售给其他服务器制造商，并将该业务转变为新的收入驱动力。
富士通预计 Monaka 芯片在下一财年将实现 350 亿日元（2.2 亿美元）的销售额，到 2035 年年销售额将达到 5000 亿日元。Mahajan 表示，富士通可能会提前几年实现长期目标。分析师平均预计，截至 3 月份的本财年，富士通的收入将持平于 3.6 万亿日元，并且到 2030 年，该公司每年将实现 5% 左右的增长。
人工智能数据中心需要更多的 CPU 来处理用户现在对代理的需求不断增加的日常任务和通用计算量。英特尔和 Advanced Micro Devices 目前在服务器 CPU 市场占据主导地位，但这两家公司面临着来自基于 Arm 的芯片以及宣扬能效的 Nvidia 的压力。
Mahajan 表示，Monaka 的目标是满足公司和政府对更好性能、内存访问、安全性以及能源效率的需求。
“我们是当今日本唯一一家生产 CPU 的公司，而且可能也是美国以外唯一一家生产如此尖端 CPU 的公司，”他说。 “这是我们为客户提供的另一种选择。”

Japan’s Fujitsu woos demand for alternatives to U.S. and China chips - The Japan Times
Japan’s Fujitsu woos demand for alternatives to U.S. and China chips
Vivek Mahajan, chief technology officer of Fujitsu, during an interview in Tokyo on Tuesday. | BLOOMBERG
By Takashi Mochizuki, Mari Kiyohara and Avril Hong
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
Initial demand for Fujitsu’s new Monaka server chips is exceeding expectations, fueled by clients seeking alternatives to U.S. and Chinese suppliers, according to the company’s chief technology officer.
Shortly after the Tokyo-based company began commercial sales of its latest 2-nanometer central processing units this month, Fujitsu already is in discussions with its manufacturer Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing about securing enough production capacity, Vivek Mahajan said.
Demand for sovereign data security in areas including defense, finance, manufacturing and the public sector is boosting interest from customers in Japan, the U.S. and Europe, he said.
“The biggest challenge is — if the demand really takes off, can we make sure that the supply keeps up?” Mahajan said in an interview on Tuesday. Most of the 45 companies that received Monaka product samples in August are likely to place orders, he said.
The Fujitsu-Monaka processors — named after a traditional Japanese confectionary — may face supply constraints if orders exceed the company’s current topline estimates of sales of about 500,000 units over two years, Mahajan said. A single manufacturer shipping about 30,000 servers would need more than 200,000 Monaka chips, he said.
Fujitsu, which supplies the Japanese government with computing, artificial intelligence, networking and security products, has mostly restricted use of its processors to its own systems, such as for use in the Fugaku supercomputer. With Monaka, Fujitsu seeks to sell its processors — which use Arm Holdings architecture — to other server makers and turn the business into a new revenue driver.
Fujitsu expects Monaka chips to generate ¥35 billion ($220 million) in sales in the next fiscal year, with annual sales reaching ¥500 billion by 2035. Fujitsu may hit the longer-term target a couple years earlier, Mahajan said. Analysts on average expect Fujitsu’s revenue to stay flat this fiscal year to March at ¥3.6 trillion, and for the company to clock about 5% growth each year through 2030.
AI data centers need more CPUs to deal with the rising volume of everyday tasks and general-purpose computing that users now demand of agents. Intel and Advanced Micro Devices now dominate the server CPU market but the two face pressure from Arm-based chips as well as from Nvidia that tout energy efficiency.
Monaka is targeting companies and governments’ need for better performance, memory access and security as well as energy efficiency, Mahajan said.
“We are the only ones in Japan that make a CPU today and probably only ones outside the U.S. that make such a cutting-edge CPU,” he said. “That’s an alternative that we give to our customers.”

content:
Uber 对年底前香港网约车牌照决定充满信心中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 24 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
Uber 对年底前香港网约车牌照决定充满信心
Uber 总经理表示，有信心其香港网约车牌照申请将在 2026 年底前获得批准。该公司强调了 2026 年的扩张，包括跨境乘车和收购当地出租车平台。它欢迎竞争对手滴滴和A的竞争
网约车巨头优步希望在今年年底前对其香港服务牌照申请做出有利决定，该公司正在等待新监管制度下政府评估的结果。
优步台湾、香港和澳门地区总经理钟志廷周二表示，该公司仍在与政府进行建设性对话，并对其申请充满信心。 “我们希望这个消息是好消息，”钟在年终媒体招待会上说。根据香港网约车平台新规，Uber 在 10 月 30 日截止日期之前提交了申请。
Chung还强调了该公司2026年的扩张计划，包括推出香港和澳门之间的跨境乘车服务、收购当地出租车平台FlyTaxi以及在香港推出优质预订服务Uber Elite。他表示，收购当地公司是将当地市场专业知识与 Uber 全球技术和运营经验相结合的一种方式。
当被问及来自滴滴和高德地图等平台的竞争是否会分割市场时，钟表示，Uber欢迎竞争，理由是其在香港的悠久运营历史和海外市场的经验。 “竞争使我们做得更好，”他说。
Chung 表示，Uber 的重点是改善司机的体验，为他们提供一系列赚钱机会，并确保乘客获得可靠的服务。他说，该公司有一个专门的支持团队来协助司机完成申请流程，并组织了信息发布会。钟补充说，优步将继续监控市场状况，并通过审查机制与政府交换信息，包括是否需要更多司机。

Uber confident of Hong Kong ride-hailing license decision by year-end
Uber is confident its Hong Kong ride-hailing license application will be decided favourably by the end of 2026, its general manager said. The company highlighted 2026 expansion, including cross-border rides and a local taxi-hailing platform acquisition. It welcomed competition from rivals Didi and A
Ride-hailing giant Uber is hoping for a favourable decision on its Hong Kong service license application by the end of the year, as the company awaits the outcome of a government assessment under a new regulatory regime.
Estyn Chung Chi-ting, general manager of Uber for Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau, said on Tuesday that the company remained in constructive dialogue with the government and was confident about its application. “We hope the news will be good,” Chung said at a year-end media reception. Uber submitted its application ahead of the 30 October deadline under Hong Kong’s new rules for ride-hailing platforms.
Chung also highlighted the company’s expansion in 2026, including the launch of cross-border rides between Hong Kong and Macau, its acquisition of local taxi-hailing platform FlyTaxi and the introduction of Uber Elite, a premium pre-booked service in Hong Kong. He said acquiring local companies was one way of combining local market expertise with Uber’s global technology and operating experience.
Asked whether competition from platforms including Didi and Amap could fragment the market, Chung said Uber welcomed competition, citing its long operating history in Hong Kong and experience in overseas markets. “Competition makes us do a better job,” he said.
Chung said Uber’s focus was on improving the experience for drivers, providing them with a range of earning opportunities and ensuring riders had access to reliable services. He said the company had a dedicated support team to assist drivers with the application process and had also organised information sessions. Uber would continue to monitor market conditions and exchange information with the government through review mechanisms, including on whether more drivers were needed, Chung added.

黑客窃取价值 7 万美元的礼品卡，GlobeTopper 损失 250 万美元
黑客窃取价值 7 万美元的礼品卡，GlobeTopper 损失 250 万美元
黑客窃取价值 7 万美元的礼品卡，GlobeTopper 损失 250 万美元
一次网络攻击中断了 B2B 充值解决方案提供商 GlobeTopper 的运营，估计造成 250 万美元的收入损失，而攻击者兑换了价值 70,000 美元的数字礼品卡。
母公司 iQSTEL 表示，10 月 22 日检测到入侵行为，GlobeTopper 做出回应，暂停其平台并开始调查。
GlobeTopper 是一家企业对企业数字礼品卡分销商。各种零售商、金融科技应用程序和奖励平台都使用其 API。据该平台网站称，65 个国家的 4000 多个品牌使用该平台，包括宜家、阿迪达斯、Spotify、Target 和 Roblox。
iQSTEL 在向美国证券交易委员会 (SEC) 提交的一份文件中表示，GlobeTopper 在发现攻击的第二天就检测到了更多未经授权的活动。对此，该公司于 10 月 23 日凌晨“让平台和所有受影响的服务器下线”，以调查并修复问题。
该公司于10月31日在AWS上部署了完全重建的平台，同时从11月1日开始分阶段恢复商业运营。
GlobeTopper 表示，攻击者获得了某些客户端 API 凭证和集成密钥，这些凭证和密钥已被撤销和替换，并且尚未发现未经授权的使用。
iQSTEL 表示：“在调查过程中，公司确定未经授权的一方获取了某些 GlobeTopper 商业客户的 API 凭证和集成密钥。”
“所有受影响的凭据和集成密钥均已被撤销和轮换，受影响的企业客户已获得新的凭据，但须遵守额外的访问限制。”
该公司进一步表示，正在进行调查以确定其他客户、个人、支付或提供商数据是否被访问或获取。
对于攻击者兑换的数字礼品卡，该公司表示无法阻止、恢复或收回它们，并将承担损失。
iQSTEL 表示，该事件损害了 GlobeTopper 第四季度的交易量和经营业绩，但截至提交文件时，尚未确定该事件是否重大。
BleepingComputer 已通过电子邮件向 iQSTEL 发送有关该事件的其他问题，但该公司拒绝透露更多信息。
截至撰写本文时，还没有勒索软件组织在其勒索门户网站上将 iQSTEL 或 GlobeTopper 列为受害者。
