【原文 English Original】
Asean warns on Thai-Cambodian conflict, backs Singapore | The Straits Times
ASEAN sec-gen warns of renewed Thai-Cambodian clashes, upbeat on finalising South China Sea pact
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
ASEAN Secretary-General Kao Kim Hourn expressed strong optimism that Singapore could help conclude long-running negotiations between ASEAN and China on a South China Sea Code of Conduct.
Published Nov 24, 2026, 02:00 PM
Updated Nov 24, 2026, 06:31 PM
Kao Kim Hourn warned the fragile Thailand-Cambodia ceasefire could fail unless talks speed up. He said Singapore, as 2027 chair, could help prevent “another possible eruption of fighting”.
Kao said Singapore may also help finish the South China Sea Code of Conduct talks with China. He said about 80% of the draft is agreed, but legal form and enforcement still need work.
He said ASEAN will keep engaging Myanmar while pressing for less violence, aid, and an inclusive political process. He also backed major economic plans, including the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement and the ASEAN Power Grid.
JAKARTA – The fragile ceasefire between Thailand and Cambodia could collapse into renewed fighting unless both countries intensify negotiations, ASEAN Secretary-General Kao Kim Hourn has warned, as Singapore prepares to assume the regional grouping’s chairmanship in 2027.
In an exclusive interview with The Straits Times, Kao said little progress has been made in talks between the two neighbours despite efforts by successive ASEAN chairs to end the conflict, leaving the border situation vulnerable to fresh hostilities.
He expressed confidence that Singapore could help bring both sides back to the negotiating table, describing the Republic as a “small country, but big diplomacy”.
“We should not allow the third round to take place. I think we must prevent another possible eruption of fighting,” he said, referring to two rounds of border clashes in 2025.
Kao expressed strong optimism that Singapore could help conclude long-running negotiations between ASEAN and China on a South China Sea Code of Conduct (COC), despite difficult questions over its legal nature and implementation.
His remarks come after the Philippines formally handed over the ASEAN chairmanship to Singapore at the grouping’s summit in Manila on Nov 17. Singapore will assume the role on Jan 1, 2027, the year ASEAN marks its 60th anniversary.
Singapore has announced “Deeper Integration, Wider Partnerships” as the theme of its chairmanship, which will also focus on strengthening economic cooperation and implementing major regional initiatives.
Thailand and Cambodia’s longstanding territorial dispute along their 800km border erupted into fighting in July and December 2025, killing at least 150 people and displacing roughly one million, according to the Brussels-based International Crisis Group.
A ceasefire reached on Dec 27 that year has largely held, though both sides have accused each other of violations.
Malaysia helped broker peace efforts as ASEAN chair in 2025, and the Philippines continued those efforts in 2026. In 2027, Singapore will take over leadership of the ASEAN Observer Team, which monitors the ceasefire.
Kao said bilateral mechanisms involving the two countries’ foreign and defence ministries, armed forces and border authorities should be put to work, but “until now... not much is happening”.
“We have a ceasefire, but the ceasefire remains. I will be very frank – fragile, because since the ceasefire was in place. We have not seen a lot of negotiations yet between the two conflicting parties,” he said.
He urged both countries to use the breathing space provided by the ceasefire to intensify negotiations rather than risk another outbreak of fighting.
While ASEAN had helped contain the conflict, Kao noted that the grouping already has dispute-settlement mechanisms under its Charter and the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in South-east Asia. These include provisions for mediation and arbitration, as well as the treaty’s High Council, which is intended to help resolve disputes but has never been activated.
Kao acknowledged diplomatic support from the United States and China, but stressed that a lasting settlement depended on ASEAN and the two countries themselves.
“Peace must be from within,” he said.
Singapore could help advance talks through its leadership of the observer team and diplomatic engagement with both sides, he added.
Kao also expressed confidence in Singapore’s Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan, describing him as “very strategic, very smart”, and said he would have a role to play in advancing peace efforts.
Asean’s quiet diplomacy helped halt Cambodia-Thailand clashes: Sec-Gen Kao
Cambodia, Thailand agree on Asean observers monitoring truce, but fundamental differences remain
Kao was similarly optimistic about Singapore’s ability to conclude long-running negotiations on the South China Sea COC.
“I have every reason to believe that Singapore will lead ASEAN to finalise the COC negotiations,” he said.
Kao, who represented Cambodia in negotiations on the Asean Charter in 2007, recalled how Singapore took over the talks from the Philippines and brought them to a conclusion. He said the the Republic could similarly narrow the remaining differences over the COC as ASEAN chair.
The COC, which builds on a 2002 declaration between ASEAN and China, seeks to manage disputes and prevent conflict in the contested waters.
On Nov 15, Philippine Foreign Secretary Theresa Lazaro said provisional agreement had been reached on about 80% of the paragraphs in the draft COC.
Kao said outstanding issues included the agreement’s legal nature and how its provisions would be implemented, but stressed that both sides were committed to concluding negotiations.
“We need to have a code of conduct that is agreeable, workable and acceptable by both sides,” he said.
Unresolved issues could be referred to senior officials and, if necessary, foreign ministers, he said, adding that a breakthrough would ultimately require compromise from both ASEAN and China.
Who was here first? Why maps, old compasses and history classes matter in South China Sea dispute
Beijing-Manila row over collision of Chinese ships chasing Filipino boat a reminder of geopolitical risk
On Myanmar, Kao acknowledged that ASEAN’s efforts to resolve the conflict had fallen short of expectations, but said the grouping’s approach had evolved towards what he described as “calibrated engagement”.
“We cannot disengage from Myanmar,” he said, pointing to visits by Myanmar’s leader Min Aung Hlaing to five ASEAN countries in 2026 as evidence of continued engagement. Since assuming the presidency in April, Min Aung Hlaing visited Laos in July, Thailand in August, Vietnam and Cambodia in September, and Malaysia in October.
Kao called ASEAN leaders’ decision to stay engaged a “wise decision”, saying Myanmar had to be engaged “regularly, consistently and constructively”.
But he also stressed that Myanmar must demonstrate its willingness to work with ASEAN, and that the grouping had yet to reach the stage of resuming normal political engagement.
Nearly six years after the February 2021 military coup, more than 100,000 people have been killed in the conflict between the military and armed opposition groups, with millions displaced, according to the United Nations.
Fighting continues despite ASEAN’s Five-Point Consensus, agreed in April 2021, which calls for an immediate end to violence, dialogue among all parties, humanitarian assistance, mediation by a special envoy, and a visit by the envoy to meet all parties concerned.
On Nov 19, the International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya minority during a military crackdown in 2017. It also ordered the nation to compensate victims and facilitate the safe return of displaced Rohingya. In response, Myanmar’s military-backed government expressed “great disappointment” over the ruling.
ASEAN has also maintained restrictions on Myanmar’s political representation at its highest-level meetings.
Kao said the grouping remained focused on three priorities: Reducing violence and restoring stability, delivering humanitarian aid without discrimination, and pursuing an inclusive political process led and owned by Myanmar.
ASEAN envoy to lead humanitarian mission to Myanmar
ASEAN peace plan for Myanmar lacks ‘clear-cut strategy’ for implementation: Thai foreign minister
Beyond security challenges, Kao identified the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA) as a major priority for Singapore’s chairmanship.
Signed at the November summit in Manila, the agreement aims to deepen digital trade and economic integration across the 11-member grouping, including by bringing together countries with differing regulations and levels of digital readiness.
Kao said the next priority would be ratification and implementation, with member states working towards a 180-day ratification timeframe.
He acknowledged that some countries would need more time to develop digital infrastructure and align their regulations, but said these differences should not hold back regional progress.
“Those who are ready to move forward can move forward fast. Those who need more time, they can come on board later on,” he said.
The agreement could particularly benefit micro, small and medium-sized enterprises by creating more opportunities to participate in the regional digital economy, he added.
Kao also identified energy security and the ASEAN Power Grid, which seeks to strengthen cross-border electricity trade and connectivity, as priorities requiring sustained regional cooperation.
Singapore’s chairmanship will coincide with the second year of implementation of ASEAN 2045: Our Shared Future, the grouping’s 20-year vision for a more integrated, resilient and prosperous regional community.
S'pore to seek expanded ASEAN trade ties as chair in 2027
Why ASEAN has struggled to tackle haze, and what a new task force could change
Kao said he expected Singapore to build on the momentum of 2026 and accelerate the implementation of the vision.
Describing Singapore’s chairmanship theme of “Deeper Integration, Wider Partnerships” as “very bold, very succinct and very clear”, he said it reflected the need to strengthen integration within ASEAN while deepening engagement with its external partners.
With unresolved regional conflicts and major economic initiatives on Singapore’s agenda, Kao expressed hope that ASEAN’s 60th anniversary would be an opportunity to advance peace and cooperation.
He said 2027 should be “a year of peace, stability, cooperation, and a year of a lot of hope for ASEAN and for ASEAN people”.
Hariz Baharudin is Indonesia correspondent at The Straits Times. He has an interest in Indonesia and the wider currents shaping South-east Asia.

title: The President Is Acting Like He Works for China
zh_title: 总统的表现就像他在为中国工作一样
summary: 更新于下午 6:06美国东部时间 2026 年 11 月 23 日美国人在过去几天学到了一些东西。最新消息是，黄仁勋在因与一名据称与中国情报机构有关的女性发生婚外情而遭受一纳秒的耻辱后，又重新控制了英伟达，这家制造世界上最先进人工智能芯片的巨头公司。另一个原因是中国共产党政权已经掌握了芯片。像往常一样，市场再次确认他们更喜欢利润而不是政治：黄仁勋回归的消息传出后，英伟达的股价上涨了 30% 以上。但大多数我
content:
更新于下午 6:06美国东部时间 2026 年 11 月 23 日美国人在过去几天学到了一些东西。最新消息是，黄仁勋在因与一名据称与中国情报机构有关的女性发生婚外情而遭受一纳秒的耻辱后，又重新控制了英伟达，这家制造世界上最先进人工智能芯片的巨头公司。另一个原因是中国共产党政权已经掌握了芯片。像往常一样，市场再次确认他们更喜欢利润而不是政治：黄仁勋回归的消息传出后，英伟达的股价上涨了 30% 以上。但最重要的是，美国人再次认识到他们的总统并不关心美国的国家安全。事实上，他如此强烈地抵制任何安全概念，以至于他的行为几乎与敌对外国特工的行为没有区别。退后一步，考虑一下这一系列事件。这位已婚的英伟达老板被发现与一位名叫爱丽丝·黄(Alice Huang)的女子发生性关系。 （她与 Jensen 没有关系，但我将在这里使用名字以避免混淆）。在此事件期间，爱丽丝在新加坡的 Megaspeed 公司工作。 Megaspeed 购买了 Nvidia 芯片，然后不顾美国的出口管制，想方设法将其运往中国。据报道，她在与詹森交往的同时，还与中国情报机构国家安全部保持着联系。
（一些报道称爱丽丝为“特工”或“间谍”，另一些则称她为“资产”。这种区别在詹森的案例中没有什么实际区别。受雇于情报机构、接受过专业培训、可能以虚假身份行事的人就是一名官员。特工和资产是从组织外部的私人生活中招募的人，他们与这样的机构有不同程度的合作关系，但实际上并没有被雇佣为间谍。无论如何，詹森实际上是一名官员。与据报道与中国情报人员上床的人上床。） [乔什·泰兰吉尔：黄仁勋复活的三种理论] 所有这一切看起来确实很糟糕。情况变得更糟。美国情报部门警告包括特朗普总统在内的美国政府，爱丽丝与北京有纠葛。事实上，特朗普在七个月内两次收到警告，其中一次是在五月份特朗普前往中国进行国事访问时，马可·卢比奥在空军一号上发表简报时发出的。这肯定很尴尬，因为不久之后，黄仁勋登上了空军一号，与美国代表团一起开始了中国之行。特朗普忽视了这些警告——或者更准确地说，以典型的特朗普风格，他假装不知道这些问题。 “我当然会向情报人员核实，”他在最近一次访问中国之前说道。 “他们本可以被提及。当然，这对我影响不大。”显然不是。
这些警告也没有打动商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克，他的前公司 Cantor Fitzgerald 与英伟达有着密切的联系，包括为一些购买其芯片的公司提供资金。该公司现在由卢特尼克的儿子经营。特朗普对这一切有何反应？当詹森被发现并不得不离开他的公司时，特朗普立即开始工作，试图让他重新坐回英伟达的大椅子上。 “我很高兴看到詹森获得第二次机会。你知道，我们是一个充满第二次机会的国家。”英伟达没有这样做：该公司的内部消息人士明确表示

【原文 English Original】
Updated at 6:06 p.m. ET on November 23, 2026 Americans learned several things over the past few days. The most recent news is that Jensen Huang, after a nanosecond of disgrace for an affair with a woman allegedly connected to Chinese intelligence , is back in control of Nvidia, the giant corporation that makes some of the world’s most advanced AI chips. Another is that China’s Communist regime has gotten its hands on the chips. The markets, as usual, have reconfirmed that they prefer profit to politics: Nvidia’s stock price jumped more than 30 percent on the news of Huang’s return. But most important, Americans learned—yet again—that their president does not care about the national security of the United States. In fact, he is so aggressively resistant to any notion of security that his actions have become almost indistinguishable from those of a hostile foreign agent. Step back for a moment and consider this sequence of events. The married Nvidia boss was caught in a sexual relationship with a woman named Alice Huang. (She is not related to Jensen, but I will use first names here to avoid confusion). Alice, during this affair, worked for Megaspeed, a company in Singapore. Megaspeed bought Nvidia chips, and then found ways to get them to China, despite U.S. export controls. She also reportedly maintained contacts with the Ministry of State Security, the Chinese intelligence agency, while carrying on with Jensen. (Some reports call Alice an “agent” or a “spy,” others refer to her as an “asset.” The distinction makes little practical difference in Jensen’s case. Someone who is employed by an intelligence agency, has professional training, and may be acting under a false identity, is an officer . Agents and assets are people recruited from private life, outside of the organization, who have a cooperative relationship, in varying degrees, with such an agency but aren’t actually employed as spooks. Either way, Jensen was literally in bed with someone who was reportedly in bed with Chinese intelligence.) [ Josh Tyrangiel: Three theories of Jensen Huang’s resurrection ] All of this certainly looks bad. It gets worse. The United States government, including President Trump, was warned by American intelligence that Alice was entangled with Beijing. In fact, Trump was warned twice in seven months, including once during a briefing by Marco Rubio aboard Air Force One in May as Trump was headed to China for a state visit. This must have been awkward, because shortly afterward, Jensen Huang boarded Air Force One and joined the U.S. delegation for the trip to China. Trump ignored these warnings—or more accurately, in classic Trump style, he pretended not to know about these issues. “I’d certainly check with the intelligence people,” he said, just before his most recent visit to China. “They could have been mentioned. Certainly, it didn’t make much of an impact on me.” Clearly not. Nor did these warnings move Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick, whose former company, Cantor Fitzgerald, has significant ties to Nvidia , including financing some of the firms that were buying its chips. The company is now run by Lutnick’s son. Trump’s reaction to all this? When Jensen was discovered and had to leave his company, Trump got right to work trying to put him back in the big chair at Nvidia. “I would love to see Jensen be given a second chance. You know, we’re a country of second chances.” Nvidia wasn’t having it : Internal sources at the company made clear to reporters that Jensen Huang would not be reinstated. So what changed in a matter of days? Nothing, except that the president apparently brought the American intelligence community into the fray to give Jensen a clean bill of health. At least that’s how it sounds from the Nvidia board’s public statement: “In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk.” The national-security process is slow and deliberative for a reason; people with even modest clearances who have been accused of minor infractions have had to wait months, sometimes even going to court, before being allowed back to work. An executive working with some of America’s most exotic technology commits adultery with a foreign citizen who has ties to a hostile government, and is credibly accused of funneling highly restricted American technology to a hostile intelligence service—and the U.S. security mandarins give the guy a thumbs up after a week ? Trump likes Jensen, he likes money, he likes the markets, and he likes Lutnick and his family. So perhaps he told the American spooks to sound the all-clear so that Jensen could get back to work. Trump indicated as much today when he told CNBC that he spoke with Nvidia’s board members. “I spoke to them, let me put it that way. And I convinced them.” In a statement on Truth Social, Trump said: “The Attorney General of the United States has confirmed that the U.S. Government does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct.” That means exactly nothing. Saying that Todd Blanche does not “possess evidence” is an artful formulation meaning that Blanche does not have a file in front of him from the intelligence community detailing Jensen’s acts, some of which might have been dangerous even if they were not “unlawful.” (As any government employee can tell you, any number of “lawful” activities, including carrying lots of debt or having emotional problems, can sink a clearance and a job.) And because of Trump’s pressure to clear Jensen, it’s unlikely he ever will. Not only did Trump celebrate the Nvidia decision, but he noted that the board’s action possibly averted a worse outcome: Jensen Huang working for China. If Jensen was “mad” enough, Trump said during an interview today , he might have accepted an offer to lead a Chinese company, because the Nvidia boss has some of their “blood in him.” In other words, the United States just vouched for a man the president said might have defected to China if he hadn’t been given his job back. [ Jonathan Chait: Trump’s backing of Huang is not superintelligent ] To recap: After a top industrialist got caught in an affair with a woman who might have been using the affair to slip American technology to a U.S. enemy, the president declared that his own spies had cleared his pal, waved off the national-security damage, and left everyone, ostensibly, happy. And by “everyone,” I mean Jensen Huang, Howard Lutnick, Nvidia stockholders, and Communist China. Trump solved this problem in a way that would make a foreign spy or a lobbyist for a foreign government both impressed and envious. Enemy spooks, their agents, and their assets spend their lives trying to do what Trump did in a week. Jensen’s off the hook, and the stock has bounced back. (And the Chinese should give Alice a medal.) This whole terrible situation shows in galling detail that Trump just doesn’t think very much about the interests of the United States. (It also suggests that he couldn’t care less about the recent election, in which corruption was a top issue for many voters). He makes no secret of his preference for his own relationships over America’s safety: When asked if Russian President Vladimir Putin was a “friend to America,” Trump shrugged and said, “I can’t speak to America. ” That’s because Trump, for all his flag-hugging nonsense, doesn’t think in terms of “America” or “China” or “Russia.” He is a globalist, in the very worst sense of the word: a man who cares nothing for states or peoples or ideologies, because he sees the world as just an interconnected group of companies and banks. Some of those companies are run by his friends, and those are the only peers who matter. Everyone else is just raw material or collateral damage; the masses are just ciphers who either obey him or obey someone else. It is perhaps an insult to foreign agents to say that Trump is acting like them. Foreign agents work for countries, and care about them. They do what they do out of patriotism, however misguided they may be about the regimes they might serve. Trump has no such ideals. Trump’s business is Trump’s business, and everything else—including “national interest” and “national security”—are just meaningless phrases used by chumps and saps. This article was updated to clarify the words agent , officer , and asset .

title: In Pictures: Time-honoured Hong Kong saucemaker to close, ceding land to Northern Metropolis megaproject
zh_title: 图片中：香港历史悠久的酱料制造商将关闭，将土地割让给北都大型项目
summary: 在被称为“鹅颈桥”的铜锣湾立交桥一侧，在“坏人打人”的节奏喧嚣声中，顾客们涌入当地一家调味品制造商的商店，该商店位于北部乡村的工厂被清理干净，其所在的土地现已割让给一个庞大的开发项目。 2026 年 10 月 28 日，桂利酱和果脯的铜锣湾店面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。购物车里装满了老抽、黑醋和甜豆酱，所有这些都自豪地被吹捧为本地制造，而工人们则将啤酒厂剩余的库存从后面运进啤酒厂。
content:
在被称为“鹅颈桥”的铜锣湾立交桥一侧，在“坏人打人”的节奏喧嚣声中，顾客们涌入当地一家调味品制造商的商店，该商店位于北部乡村的工厂被清理干净，其所在的土地现已割让给一个庞大的开发项目。 2026 年 10 月 28 日，桂利酱和果脯的铜锣湾店面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。购物车里装满了老抽、黑醋和甜酱油，所有这些都被自豪地标榜为本地制造，而工人们则从后面将啤酒厂剩余的库存推入车内，顾客与白发苍苍的店主亲切地交谈着。继位于香港新界北部的桂利酱和果脯厂址被驱逐和清理后，这家拥有 90 年历史的酱料制造商正在倒计时，直到出售剩余库存并永远关闭铜锣湾店面。 2026 年 10 月 28 日，桂利酱和果脯的铜锣湾店面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。该公司现已关闭的工厂位于古洞，这是新界的一个农村地区，是北方都市大型项目下开发的地区，该项目旨在实现香港乡村边疆的现代化，并加深与中国大陆的融合。 1936 年开业的工厂关闭，结束了这家酱料制造商的“香港制造”传统。
乔安妮·陈 (Joanne Chan) 是一位忠实顾客，她在商店关门前来到这家商店储备酱汁，对她来说，啤酒厂的倒闭象征着开发项目的损失，从村民的流离失所到对新科技中心需求的怀疑。2026 年 10 月 28 日，桂利酱和果脯的铜锣湾店面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “这些传统品牌已经经营了几十年，但政府没有计划让他们继续经营。相反，他们被迫关闭，”她说。该工厂在上个月的驱逐行动后现已被封锁，位于古洞北新发展区，占地 447 公顷，将为公共和私人住宅开发、商业设施和新地铁站让路。 2026 年 10 月 28 日，桂利酱和果脯的铜锣湾店面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。这家酱料制造商的工厂距离香港和邻近的中国城市深圳之间最近的边境管制站仅 15 分钟车程。整个北都城项目旨在拉近香港与内地的距离，将约 300 平方公里（约占该市土地的三分之一）转变为创新科技中心。 2026 年 10 月 28 日，桂利酱和果脯的铜锣湾店面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
陈氏家族九十年的经营经历跨越了三代人，他们于 1940 年代在九龙城开设了第一家酿酒厂，当时是当地酿酒商的中心。 1960 年代的城市重建迫使李氏和其他调味品制造商进入新界，该酿酒厂一直留在新界，直到上个月被驱逐。 2026 年 10 月 28 日，桂利酱和果脯的铜锣湾店面。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。事实证明，农村环境对调味品制造商来说是一个福音，因为大片土地使他们能够继续使用传统的露天方法在阳光下发酵和氧化大豆。但大部分酱厂从香港市中心迁往北部腹地

【原文 English Original】
Off to the side of the Causeway Bay flyover known as Goose Neck Bridge, over the polyrhythmic din of “villain hitting,” customers crowded into a local condiment maker’s shop after its factory in the rural north was cleared, the land it stood on now ceded to a gargantuan development project. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Shopping trolleys were filled with dark soy sauce, black vinegar, and sweet soybean paste, all proudly touted as locally made, while workers carted in what remained of the brewer’s stock through the back and customers exchanged friendly words with grey-haired shopkeepers. Following the eviction and clearance of Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s factory site in Hong Kong’s northern New Territories, the 90-year-old saucemaker is counting down the days until it sells off its remaining inventory and closes its Causeway Bay storefront for good. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Its now-shuttered factory was in Kwu Tung, a rural area in the New Territories tapped for development under the Northern Metropolis megaproject, which aims to modernise Hong Kong’s rustic frontier and deepen its integration with mainland China. The closure of the factory, opened in 1936, brings the saucemaker’s “Made in Hong Kong” legacy to an end. For Joanne Chan, a loyal customer who came by the shop to stock up on sauces ahead of its closure, the brewer’s end is emblematic of the development project’s toll, from the displacement of villagers to doubts over the demand for a new tech hub. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “These traditional brands have operated for decades, but the government has no plan to let them keep going. Instead, they’re being forced to close,” she said. The factory, now sealed off after an eviction operation last month, falls within the Kwu Tung North New Development Area, which spans 447 hectares and will make way for both public and private residential developments, as well as commercial facilities and a new MTR station. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The saucemaker’s factory was just a 15-minute drive from the closest border control point between Hong Kong and the neighbouring Chinese city of Shenzhen. The entire Northern Metropolis project is meant to draw Hong Kong closer to the mainland, transforming about 300 square kilometres — roughly a third of the city’s land — into an innovation and technology hub. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Kui Lee’s nine decades in business have spanned three generations of the Chan family, who opened their first brewing yard in the 1940s in Kowloon City, then a hub for local brewers. Urban redevelopment in the 1960s forced Kui Lee, along with other condiment makers, into the New Territories, where the brewer remained until last month’s eviction. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The rural surroundings proved to be a boon for condiment makers, as the large swathes of land allowed them to keep using traditional open-air methods to ferment and oxidise soybeans under sunlight. But most of the sauce factories that moved from Hong Kong’s urban core to its northern hinterland in the mid-20th century are now facing eviction for the Northern Metropolis. One saucemaker, Koon Chun, is fortunate enough to continue operating after the megaproject clears out its current site. Moving to its new facility, however, will take about a decade. Yuet Wo Soy Sauce, Kui Lee’s neighbour in Kwu Tung, is looking for a new site in a Tsuen Wan industrial building to stay in business. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Rural villages, sawmills, and carp farms are also on their way out — with some already evicted — as deadlines loom for the Northern Metropolis project. With the October clearance operation, the family also moved out of their homes on the Kwu Tung site, according to a South China Morning Post report, which noted that power was cut off and water pipes were severed two days ahead of the clearance deadline. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Joanne Chan spoke of her own experience of being evicted from a village house in Tuen Mun some two decades ago to make way for a railway line. “I understand the pain that land resumption and eviction causes; I’m strongly opposed to it,” she said. “You could grow your own fruit trees in your own yard, but after the eviction, all you get is a few hundred square feet,” she said, referring to government resettlement policies. “Those university towns and tech parks aren’t what we need as ordinary citizens.” Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Go ahead, ask her,” she said, pointing to another middle-aged customer browsing the store’s wares. “Do you think she wants [artificial intelligence]?” Other customers also lamented the store’s impending closure, including a new mother buying ingredients for pork knuckle and ginger stew, a traditional postpartum dish made with sweetened black vinegar. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “I don’t know where I’m going to find soy sauce when they close, especially dark soy sauce,” said another customer, Tsang, who works nearby. The condiment – darker and less salty than its counterparts and mainly used to give dishes a deeper colour – is among Kui Lee’s most well-known products. Kui Lee Sauce and Preserved Fruit’s Causeway Bay storefront, on October 28, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Shops like these are getting harder to come by these days. Once one of them closes, there won’t be another to take its place. Of course, it’s a pity, but in this day and age, there’s nothing that can be done,” she said.

title: Copper price sinks into bear market, erasing 2026 gains in worst week of the year
zh_title: 铜价陷入熊市，抹去2026年涨幅，为今年最糟糕的一周
summary: 铜价周五再次暴跌，在创下历史新高仅十周后，铜价就进入熊市，因为对人工智能热潮的押注解除、强势美元和美国关税前景的黯淡继续掩盖了中国严重短缺的证据。纽约最活跃合约 Comex 12 月交割铜价一度下跌 3.4%，至每磅 5.4405 美元（每吨 11,994 美元），为 3 月底以来的最低水平，午盘左右回升至 5.4995 美元，跌幅 2.4%。这比 9 月 9 日达成的创纪录的 6.8885 美元结算价低 20.2%。收盘价低于 5 美元。
content:
铜价周五再次暴跌，在创下历史新高仅十周后，铜价就进入熊市，因为对人工智能热潮的押注解除、强势美元和美国关税前景的黯淡继续掩盖了中国严重短缺的证据。纽约最活跃合约 Comex 12 月交割铜价一度下跌 3.4%，至每磅 5.4405 美元（每吨 11,994 美元），为 3 月底以来的最低水平，午盘左右回升至 5.4995 美元，跌幅 2.4%。这比 9 月 9 日创下的 6.8885 美元的创纪录结算价低 20.2%。收盘价低于 5.51 美元将符合熊市的常见定义，即较最近的峰值下跌 20% 或更多。该合约已连续七个交易日下跌，自上周五以来已下跌超过 9%，为 2026 年迄今为止最大单周跌幅。9 月份迄今为止的涨幅为 22%，目前已下跌 2%，而铜价到 11 月底预计将下跌约 15%。据路透社报道，伦敦金属交易所三个月期铜在官方交易中下跌 2.3%，至每吨 12,235 美元，此前触及 12,020 美元，为 3 月 24 日以来的最低水平。该基准指数本周下跌约 9%，这是自 2025 年 4 月初美国总统唐纳德·特朗普公布全球关税以来的最大单周跌幅。伦敦铜价比 9 月 10 日峰值 14,875 美元低 18%，并且必须跌破 11,900 美元才能与纽约市一样进入熊市。
据彭博社报道，在上海，期货创下 15 年来最糟糕的一周表现。下一站，3 月份的低点，跌破 5.63 美元（2025 年铜价结束时的价格），消除了盛宝银行 (Saxo Bank) 的 Ole Hansen 在周三暴跌期间标记的两个图表支撑中的第一个。第二个价格为 5.32 美元，略低于 2026 年的最低收盘价：3 月 20 日的 5.34 美元，当时伊朗战争期间油价飙升和交易所库存膨胀导致金属跌至三个月低点。目前铜价比该水平高出不到 3%。 Capital.com 高级金融市场分析师凯尔·罗达 (Kyle Rodda) 向路透社表示，越来越多的证据表明，人工智能投资热潮正在减弱，美联储将不得不更加积极地控制通胀，并补充说，美元走强也给黄金带来压力。该通讯社称，周五 AI 股价继续下跌，Anthropic 上市后股价较周四收盘价下跌约 9%。 Benchmark Mineral Intelligence 的铜分析师 Albert Mackenzie 告诉彭博社：“只要人工智能一直在推动价格上涨，我们就一直在说，这可能有点过分了。”中国需求疲软、美国关税和美元前景黯淡也在发挥作用，本周的损失与大流行初期和特朗普宣布解放日之后的暴跌相差不远。伦敦铜正面临 2022 年以来最大幅度的月度跌幅。
金属流向中国 期货抛售仍在继续，同时中国对实物金属的争夺仍在继续。 据路透社报道，周五，进口铜到中国所支付的洋山溢价从周四创纪录的每吨 500 美元下滑至 495 美元。周三价格为 360 美元，9 月份还不到 100 美元。上海期货交易所库存本周增加 3,204 吨至 30,846 吨，仍低于中国一天的消费量。这种紧张可能是导致期货下跌的部分原因。这些水平的溢价使得将金属运出美国变得有利可图，过去一年美国库存激增

【原文 English Original】
Copper slumped again on Friday, tipping the metal into a bear market just ten weeks after it set an all-time high, as the unwinding of bets on the artificial intelligence boom, a strong dollar and fading US tariff prospects continued to swamp evidence of acute shortage in China. Comex copper for December delivery, the most active contract in New York, dropped as much as 3.4% to $5.4405 a pound ($11,994 a tonne), the lowest since the end of March, before recovering to $5.4995 around midday, down 2.4%. That is 20.2% below the record settlement of $6.8885 reached on September 9. A close under $5.51 would meet the common definition of a bear market, a fall of 20% or more from the most recent peak. The contract has fallen for seven sessions in a row and is down more than 9% since last Friday, by far its steepest weekly loss of 2026. A year-to-date gain that stood at 22% in September has turned into a loss of 2%, and copper is on course to end November about 15% lower. On the London Metal Exchange, three-month copper fell 2.3% to $12,235 a tonne in official trading after touching $12,020, the lowest since March 24, Reuters reports. The benchmark is down about 9% on the week, its biggest weekly fall since early April 2025, when US President Donald Trump unveiled his global tariffs. London copper is 18% below its September 10 peak of $14,875 and would have to drop under $11,900 to join New York in a bear market. In Shanghai, futures racked up their worst week in 15 years, according to Bloomberg. Next stop, the March low The break below $5.63, where copper ended 2025, removes the first of two chart supports that Saxo Bank’s Ole Hansen flagged during Wednesday’s rout . The second is $5.32, which sits just beneath the lowest close of 2026: $5.34 on March 20, when surging oil prices during the Iran war and swelling exchange inventories sent the metal to a three-month trough. Copper is now less than 3% above that level. Evidence is mounting that the AI investment boom is waning and that the Federal Reserve will have to get more aggressive to control inflation, Kyle Rodda, senior financial market analyst at Capital.com, told Reuters, adding that a strengthening dollar is also weighing on the metal. AI shares continued to sag on Friday, with Anthropic trading about 9% below Thursday’s close after its market debut, the news agency said. “We have been saying for as long as AI has been driving the price that this might be a bit over-egged,” Albert Mackenzie, copper analyst at Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, told Bloomberg. Weak Chinese demand, the dimming prospect of US tariffs and the dollar are also at work, and the week’s losses are not far off the slumps seen in the early stages of the pandemic and after Trump’s Liberation Day announcement. London copper is heading for its steepest monthly decline since 2022 . Metal heads to China The selloff in futures is still running alongside a scramble for physical metal in China. The Yangshan premium paid to import copper into the country slipped to $495 a tonne on Friday from Thursday’s record $500, Reuters reports. It was $360 on Wednesday and less than $100 in September. Shanghai Futures Exchange stocks rose by 3,204 tonnes this week to 30,846 tonnes, which is still less than a day’s worth of Chinese consumption. That tightness may be part of what is pushing futures down. Premiums at these levels have made it profitable to move metal out of the United States, where stockpiles ballooned over the past year on tariff bets, and traders have begun shipping copper from the US to China , with tens of thousands of tonnes due to arrive in January. Codelco is meanwhile offering Chinese buyers 2027 cathode at $250 to $280 a tonne , less than it charged this year. The flow looks set to continue. China’s refined copper imports are poised to climb in 2027 after a rare drop this year, according to a Reuters poll of 15 analysts and traders, because shortages of concentrate and scrap are holding back domestic smelter output while demand keeps growing. Imports fell 16% to 2.37 million tonnes in the first ten months of 2026, the lowest for the period since at least 2015. “The gravitational pull of refined copper is now towards China,” said Nicholas Snowdon, head of metals and mining research at Mercuria, although Argus expects a moderate recovery rather than a surge. In London the squeeze has eased: cash copper was at only a slight premium to the three-month contract on Friday after flipping into a discount earlier in the week. $127 billion in a week Copper stocks were sold again in New York. Eleven of the largest copper-exposed miners have lost a combined $127 billion, or 15% of their market value, since last Friday, and $208 billion, or 23%, over the past month. Their combined worth has dropped to $696 billion from $769 billion on Wednesday morning. Freeport-McMoRan fell another 5.4%, taking its loss for the week to 22% and cutting its market value to $67 billion, from close to $100 billion a month ago. Southern Copper gave up 4.3% to $116 billion and has shed 32% in a month, a slide that has pushed the stock into the red for 2026 after it was up 41% in mid-October. BHP was little changed at $177 billion but is down 14% on the week, and Rio Tinto eased 1.3% to $127 billion. Glencore, at $71 billion, has lost a fifth of its value in a month. Teck Resources dropped 3.6% to $24 billion, Antofagasta 4.8% and First Quantum Minerals 3.7%, and Lundin Mining’s 2.3% decline left it 19% lower since last Friday. Only BHP, Glencore, Teck and Anglo American are still showing gains for the year, and Anglo’s is down to 1%. Ivanhoe Mines has lost 60% in 2026. (With files from Reuters and Bloomberg)

title: Compact and Covert
zh_title: 紧凑、隐蔽
summary: 法国土伦——法国海军的潜艇码头位于巴黎最大海军基地的有顶干船坞内和厚厚的混凝土墙后面。这个戒备森严的设施是核攻击潜艇中队最强大、最现代化的攻击艇的所在地，不被窥探。上个月，USNI News 参观了法国海军的一艘 Suffren 级核攻击潜艇 FS Duguay-Trouin (S636)，当时该潜艇正在进行维护。这艘核攻击潜艇于 2023 年服役，是海军 Suffren 级的第二艘，将成为法国海军的支柱。
content:
法国土伦——法国海军的潜艇码头位于巴黎最大海军基地的有顶干船坞内和厚厚的混凝土墙后面。这个戒备森严的设施是核攻击潜艇中队最强大、最现代化的攻击艇的所在地，不被窥探。上个月，USNI News 参观了法国海军的一艘 Suffren 级核攻击潜艇 FS Duguay-Trouin (S636)，当时该潜艇正在进行维护。这艘核攻击潜艇于 2023 年服役，是法国海军 Suffren 级的第二艘核潜艇，将成为未来几十年法国水下战争的支柱。 “对我们来说，冷战从未真正结束，”一位退役的法国海军潜艇指挥官在参观期间谈到他从 20 世纪 90 年代到 2010 年代的服役时光时说道。法国与北大西洋公约组织伙伴英国、德国和美国一起，一直在与俄罗斯海军进行水下对峙。从北大西洋的GIUK海峡到地中海沿岸，法国潜艇在日益恶化的安全局势中坚守岗位。随着俄罗斯对欧洲的威胁重新抬头，以及对法国在印度太平洋地区领土的新担忧，巴黎的攻击艇比以往任何时候都更加重要。这艘重 4,765 吨的潜艇停泊在有顶棚的干船坞内，让人们得以一睹法国海军旨在解决的能力和任务。
与现代中国、俄罗斯和美国的核攻击艇相比，紧凑型“苏弗伦”号的船员数量约为一半，排水量也显着减轻。紧凑型船员总数为 70 人，其中包括 15 名军官和 55 名士官，他们可以在鱼雷室后面的食堂享用面包店的新鲜法棍面包和配给的葡萄酒。 Duguay-Trouin 号的高度自动化特性可以从其武器舱中看出，攻击艇的执行官声称武器舱可由两名男子操作。与上一代红宝石级潜艇相比，萨弗伦级潜艇现在可以发射远程巡航导弹打击，承载专门的特种部队行动，并支持欧洲战区以外的扩展部署。从捍卫威慑到新的常规任务 2026 年 10 月 7 日，一艘拥有 38 年船龄的 FS Améthyste (S605) 核攻击艇在倾盆大雨中驶入土伦海军基地。USNI 新闻照片 灰色的阴天被土伦湾的倾盆大雨所取代。雨中出现了一艘潜艇的轮廓，指挥塔上挤满了模糊的人影。小船护送缓慢移动的 FS Améthyste (S605) 进入海湾。这艘冷战时期的攻击艇是法国红宝石级的最后一艘，也是法国海军服役的苏弗伦级之前的第一艘核攻击潜艇。与 Duguay-Trouin 相比，Améthyste 的排水量仅为 2,400 吨，并且是为不同时代而设计的。
与当时的西方和东方同类潜艇相比，红宝石级潜艇在武器装备和排水量上都明显较轻。这种设计理念反映了法国海军最初涉足核攻击艇及其在北大西洋和地中海的作战重点区域。冷战期间，法国海军的前线潜艇部队依赖于十几艘达芙妮级和阿戈斯塔级柴电推进攻击艇。 2026 年 10 月 6 日，SNLE Le Vigilant 首次发射 51.3 导弹。DGA 照片 核心任务之一

【原文 English Original】
TOULON, France — The French Navy’s submarine quay resides within covered dry docks and behind thick concrete walls at Paris’ largest naval base. Concealed from prying eyes, this closely guarded facility is home to the Squadron of Nuclear Attack Submarines’ most capable and modern attack boats. Last month, USNI News visited one of the French Navy’s Suffren-class nuclear attack submarines, FS Duguay-Trouin (S636), while the boat was undergoing maintenance. Commissioned in 2023, the nuclear attack submarine is the second of the sea service’s Suffren class and will form the backbone of French undersea warfare in the coming decades. “For us, the Cold War never really ended,” a retired French Navy submarine commander remarked during the tour about his time serving from the 1990s to 2010s. France, alongside North Atlantic Treaty Organization partners Britain, Germany and the U.S., has been engaged in a constant underwater standoff against the Russian Navy. From the North Atlantic waters of GIUK gap to the littorals of the Mediterranean, French submarines have stood guard amid an increasingly deteriorating security situation. With the resurgence of Russian threats to Europe and new concerns regarding French possessions in the Indo-Pacific, Paris’ attack boats are more relevant than ever. Resting within a covered dry dock, the 4,765-ton submarine provided a glimpse at the capabilities and missions that the French Navy aims to address. Compared to modern Chinese, Russian and American nuclear attack boats, the compact Suffren’s have roughly half the crew and displace considerably less weight. The compact crew complement of 70 personnel, divided between 15 officers and 55 petty officers, can enjoy their fresh baguettes from the bakery and wine ration at the mess behind the torpedo room. Duguay-Trouin’s highly automated nature can be seen within its weapons bay, which the attack boat’s executive officer claimed can be operated by two men. Compared to the previous generation of Rubis-class boats, the Suffren class can now launch long-range cruise missile strikes, host dedicated special forces operations and support extended-deployments beyond the European theater. From Defending the Deterrent to New Conventional Missions The 38-year-old FS Améthyste (S605) nuclear attack boat pulls into Toulon Naval Base under a torrential downpour on Oct. 7, 2026. USNI News photo A gray overcast sky gave way to a torrential downpour across Toulon Bay. A submarine silhouette emerged from the rain with hazy figures crowding the conning tower. Small boats escorted the slow moving FS Améthyste (S605) into the bay. The Cold War-era attack boat is the last of France’s Rubis-class, which was also the first class of nuclear attack submarines in French Navy service before the Suffren class. In contrast to Duguay-Trouin , Améthyste displaced only 2,400-tons and was created for a different era. Compared to its Western and Eastern counterparts at the time, Rubis-class submarines were notably lighter in both armament and displacement. This design philosophy reflected the French Navy’s initial foray into nuclear attack boats and its operational focus areas in the North Atlantic and Mediterranean. During the Cold War, the French Navy’s frontline submarine force relied on more than a dozen diesel-electric propelled attack boats from the Daphné and Agosta classes. The first firing of a 51.3 missile from the SNLE Le Vigilant on Oct. 6, 2026. DGA photo One of the core missions for the Rubis, and now Suffren class, was the escort of the French sea-based nuclear deterrent. Today, the French Navy operates four Triomphant-class submarines, each equipped with 16 M51 submarine-launched ballistic missiles. Alongside air-launched supersonic missiles carried by French Air Force and Navy Rafale fighters, the submarines form the pillars of Paris’ nuclear deterrent. France previously operated a full nuclear triad, but decommissioned its ground-based silos in the 1990s. On the morning of USNI News’ tour of Duguay-Trouin , France held its first at-sea test of a SLBM from FS Le Vigilant (S618) in the Atlantic Ocean. A M51.3 missile soared over the Atlantic in an event presided over by President Emmanuel Macron on a nearby frigate. French defense, military and industry leadership repeatedly highlighted this capability as Europe’s “only sovereign deterrent.” Aside from defending the country’s SSBNs, the Suffren-class brings new capabilities for French undersea warfare. At the front of the attack boat within its highly automated weapons room, the Suffren-class can deploy France’s first-ever submarine-launched cruise missiles. The domestic Naval Cruise Missile program’s roots can be traced to Paris’ failed attempt to procure Tomahawk cruise missiles from the U.S. in the early 2000s. Since 2017, the domestic long-range cruise missiles have enabled French frigates and submarines to strike targets out to 1,000 to 1,400 kilometers. Duguay-Trouin launches the cruise missiles from its four 533mm torpedo tubes. While French Navy frigates debuted the Naval Cruise Missile in combat during a joint operation with the U.S. and U.K. in 2018 against Syrian chemical weapon facilities, a Suffren-class sub first fired the cruise missile in a 2020 test. The FREMM Aquitaine and an SSN simultaneously fired an MdCN missile, shared in April of 2024. French Navy photo The initial production run of the Naval Cruise Missile only assembled 200 munitions, of which only 50 could be fired from the Suffren-class boats. However, the French military announced a new order for the latest variant of the cruise missile earlier this month at Euronaval 2026. This procurement comes amid a new focus by the French military in long-range precision fires influenced by lessons in the Ukraine conflict. Beyond conventional deep strike potential, the submarines also bring a new deployment method for French Navy special forces and the service’s growing hybrid fleet concept. A complement of Commando Marines can deploy from the submarine while submerged via a dry deck shelter module that can be attached for certain missions. The Suffren-class boats can also support swimmer delivery vehicles for these clandestine operations. Within the command center, 10 multi-functional display consoles flank an elevated captain’s seat and central tactical planning table. Each of these displays can be configured for different roles, a capability that can be useful depending on the mission tasked to Duguay-Trouin . French government-controlled shipbuilder Naval Group hopes to use submarines from the Suffren class and their command and control capabilities to support drone mesh networks in a hybrid fleet concept. At a demonstration at a nearby Naval Group facility, the shipbuilder showcased the potential benefits of operating extra-large unmanned underwater vehicles and aerial drones from the same consoles seen aboard Duguay-Trouin . The French Navy has already experimented with the deployment of UUVs, including a Spring 2026 test that saw the launch and recovery of a U.S. Navy Razorback UUV. In contrast to the highly autonomous vision of unmanned systems integration by fleets aboard, France is taking a more conservative force enabler approach in its hybrid fleet concept. French defense and industry officials want their drones to extend the surveillance reach of their manned assets. During the demonstration, the concept helped a French submarine detect targets in the Red Sea to enable an enhanced picture for a commander.

title: Hong Kong court orders activist Eddie Tse to pay gov’t legal fees over dropped San Tin Technopole challenge
zh_title: 香港法院命令活动人士谢伟业因新田科技城挑战被撤销而支付政府律师费
summary: 香港一家法院下令环保活动人士谢伟业支付律师费，此前他放弃了对政府在香港与中国大陆边境附近建设大型科技中心的决定的质疑。 2024 年 11 月 11 日，Eddie Tse 在香港高等法院前。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。据《证人报》报道，高等法院周二作出判决，责令谢支付环境保护署和土木工程拓展署的法律费用，该署在司法复核被驳回之前已为诉讼程序做好了准备。高的
content:
香港一家法院下令环保活动人士谢伟业支付律师费，此前他放弃了对政府在香港与中国大陆边境附近建设大型科技中心的决定的质疑。 2024 年 11 月 11 日，Eddie Tse 在香港高等法院前。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。据《证人报》报道，高等法院周二作出判决，责令谢支付环境保护署和土木工程拓展署的法律费用，该署在司法复核被驳回之前已为诉讼程序做好了准备。高等法院法官拉塞尔·科尔曼在判决中表示，两个政府部门为此案聘请了六名大律师，称其“明显荒谬”，因此只判谢谢支付两名大律师的费用。社会工作者、环保组织拯救大屿山联盟召集人谢先生于2024年8月对环保部门兴建新田科技城的决定提出法律质疑。同年8月，法院批准司法复核，谢先生申请法律援助。然而，当年11月，法院批评政府拖延处理法律援助申请。去年1月，谢被指控向当局作出虚假陈述以获取老人津贴和公共住房，并因涉嫌欺诈被捕。后来，他因挑战政府而被拒绝提供法律援助。
新田。资料图片：香港政府一站通。去年四月，谢决定退出法律挑战，理由是他和他的家人受到骚扰和恐吓。法院驳回前区议员陈黛比接手司法覆核的申请，质疑因而被驳回。司法复核的受访者申请了法律费用，而谢则以公共利益为由寻求豁免。法官拉塞尔·科尔曼周二表示，由于司法审查在任何法律原则得以澄清之前就已终止，因此不属于公共利益诉讼费用减免的范围。牌照被吊销 去年7月，谢因在福利计划中诈骗政府16,780港元而被判处120小时社区服务。谢现年 69 岁，自 1993 年以来一直是注册社会工作者。在欺诈定罪后，社会工作者注册委员会（SWRB）吊销了他的社会工作者执照三年。

【原文 English Original】
A Hong Kong court has ordered environmental activist Eddie Tse to pay legal fees after he dropped a challenge against the government’s decision to build a huge technology hub near the city’s border with mainland China. Eddie Tse in front of Hong Kong’s High Court on November 11, 2024. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The High Court handed down judgment on Tuesday ordering Tse to pay the legal costs of the Environmental Protection Department and the Civil Engineering and Development Department, which had prepared for the proceedings before the judicial review was dismissed, The Witness reported. High Court judge Russell Coleman said in the judgment that the two government departments had engaged six barristers for the case, calling it “plainly absurd,” and therefore only granted costs for two barristers to be paid by Tse. Tse, a social worker and convenor of the environmental group Save Lantau Alliance, lodged a legal challenge against environmental authorities’ decision to build the San Tin Technopole in August 2024. The court granted leave for judicial review in August that year, and Tse applied for legal aid. However, in November that year, the court criticised the government over its delay in processing the legal aid application. In January last year, Tse was arrested on suspicion of fraud after being accused of making false statements to authorities to obtain an elderly allowance and public housing. He was later denied legal aid for his challenge against the government. San Tin. File photo: GovHK. In April last year, Tse decided to withdraw from the legal challenge, citing harassment and intimidation directed at him and his family. The court denied former district councillor Debby Chan’s application to take over the judicial review, and the challenge was consequently dismissed. The respondents to the judicial review applied for legal costs, while Tse sought a waiver on public interest grounds. Judge Russell Coleman said on Tuesday that because the judicial review was discontinued before any legal principles could be clarified, it fell outside the scope of public interest litigation cost waivers. Licence suspended In July last year, Tse was sentenced to 120 hours of community service for defrauding the government of HK$16,780 in welfare schemes. Tse, 69, had been a registered social worker since 1993. Following the fraud conviction, the Social Workers Registration Board (SWRB) suspended his social worker licence for three years.

title: Why Trump Rescued Jensen Huang
zh_title: 特朗普为何拯救黄仁勋
summary: 一个按照正常道德规则甚至自我保护来运作的总统将忙于与英伟达丑闻的影响保持距离。昨晚，《纽约时报》报道称，一名与英伟达曾经和未来的首席执行官黄仁勋有染的中国女子与中国间谍机构经常保持联系。这位名叫爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）的女士可能影响了英伟达首席执行官将先进芯片出售给将其转移到中国的公司的决定。唐纳德·特朗普反而推动恢复黄仁勋担任公司首席执行官，甚至甚至拨通了电话。
content:
一个按照正常道德规则甚至自我保护来运作的总统将忙于与英伟达丑闻的影响保持距离。昨晚，《纽约时报》报道称，一名与英伟达曾经和未来的首席执行官黄仁勋有染的中国女子与中国间谍机构经常保持联系。这位名叫爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）的女士可能影响了英伟达首席执行官将先进芯片出售给将其转移到中国的公司的决定。唐纳德·特朗普反而推动恢复黄仁勋担任公司首席执行官，甚至拨通公司董事会会议推动黄仁勋回归，公司无法拒绝这一要求。正如一位学者可能会说的那样，特朗普的决定是由特朗普的几条戒律决定的。总统认为，原则上，有权有势的男性不应因不当性行为而受到惩罚。他还对腐败采取相对主义观点，认为腐败只是一种正常的经营方式。这种心态使他经常将任何对手污蔑为腐败（每个人都这样做，对吧？），同时自己也进行公然腐败（毕竟，每个人都这样做）。但也许特朗普最重要的特质是他对国家利益的漠视。英伟达允许其先进芯片落入中国人手中。
这可能违反了美国法律，而该法律有一个关键目的：阻止美国最强大的全球竞争对手获得可能使其获得经济和军事主导地位的尖端技术。[阅读：5.7万亿美元的面子]保守派共和党人往往是对中国最鹰派的政客，他们对此感到愤怒，这很可能对全球领导力的进程产生决定性影响。可以预见的是，美国因美国商人的贪婪或性欲而在人工智能竞赛中输给中国的前景应该会让他们感到愤怒。然而，特朗普似乎根本不在乎。尽管他偶尔会对中国进行煽动，但他似乎对与中国竞争没什么兴趣。他宣称，他对独裁者习近平的钦佩超过了除俄罗斯独裁者弗拉基米尔·普京之外的任何其他世界领导人。上周与这两个伙伴进行了象征性但毫无成果的会晤后，特朗普轻率地发布了一些表情包，将这三驾马车描绘成类似于罗斯福、斯大林和丘吉尔的全球领导人。特朗普不希望中国发挥全球主导地位，但他似乎并不担心中国的野心。他上周告诉记者，他与习近平谈到了黄：“我很高兴看到詹森获得第二次机会。你知道，我们是一个充满第二次机会的国家，我很高兴能够看到他拥有第二次机会——这对我们来说是一家非常重要的公司。”
他让我们处于比其他公司领先 10 年的位置，我确实与习主席讨论过这一点，他说，哦，太棒了，太棒了。”换句话说，特朗普似乎在说，他向涉嫌对黄进行“美人计”行动的中国国家主席询问特朗普是否应该带回英伟达首席执行官。然后，特朗普会让我们相信，中国国家主席同意恢复这位中国担心拥有影响力的高管将是一个好主意。特朗普将这项协议视为一个令人鼓舞的迹象。 [阅读：人工智能战争中中国的情报政变]

【原文 English Original】
A presidency that operated by normal rules of ethics or even self-preservation would be scrambling to distance itself from the repercussions of the Nvidia scandal. Last night, The New York Times reported that a Chinese woman who had an affair with Jensen Huang, Nvidia’s once and future chief executive, was in regular contact with China’s spy agency . The woman, Alice Huang, may have influenced the Nvidia CEO’s decision to sell advanced chips to companies that transferred them to China. Donald Trump instead pushed to reinstate Jensen Huang as the company’s CEO, even going so far as to dial in to the company’s board meeting to push for Huang’s return, a demand the company was in no position to turn down. Trump’s decision is overdetermined, as an academic might put it, by several Trumpian precepts. The president believes as a matter of principle that powerful men should not face repercussions for sexual misconduct. He also takes a relativistic view of corruption, seeing it as simply a normal way to do business. This mindset allows him to routinely smear any opponent as corrupt (everybody does it, right?) while simultaneously engaging in flagrant corruption himself (after all, everybody does it). But perhaps the most significant Trumpian attribute at play is his disregard for the national interest . Nvidia was permitting its advanced chips to fall into Chinese hands. This may have violated American law, and the law serves a critical purpose: to prevent America’s most powerful global rival from gaining access to cutting-edge technology that might enable it to obtain economic and military dominance. [ Read: A $5.7 trillion face-plant ] Conservative Republicans, who tend to be the most hawkish politicians on China, are outraged by this, which may well turn out to have a decisive effect on the course of global leadership. The prospect of the U.S. losing the artificial-intelligence race to China out of an American businessman’s greed or libidinousness should leave them predictably furious. Trump, however, does not seem to care whatsoever. Despite his occasional demagoguery against China, he seems to have little interest in competing against it. He proclaims his admiration of its dictator, Xi Jinping, more than any other world leader save Vladimir Putin, the Russian dictator. After a symbolic but fruitless meeting with the two partners last week, Trump giddily posted memes depicting the troika as global leaders akin to Roosevelt, Stalin, and Churchill. Trump does not want China to exert global dominance, but he does not seem to view its ambitions with any concern. He told reporters last week that he talked about Huang with Xi: “I would love to see Jensen be given a second chance. You know, we’re a country of second chances and I’d love to be able to see him have—that’s a very important company to us. And he put us in a position where we are literally 10 years advanced over other companies, and I did discuss that with President Xi, and he said, Oh, brilliant, brilliant .” In other words, Trump seems to be saying that he asked the president of China, the country that is suspected of running the honey-trap operation on Huang, whether Trump should bring back the CEO of Nvidia. Then, Trump would have us believe, the Chinese president agreed that reinstating the executive over which China is feared to have leverage would be a good idea. And Trump presented this agreement as an encouraging sign. [ Read: China’s intelligence coup in the AI war ] In a normal administration, the mere fact that the president is telling a private company whom to install as CEO would itself constitute an enormous scandal. In the current atmosphere, this is simply a background detail. The most benign explanation for Huang’s restoration is that Trump cares more about keeping the stock market soaring than any American national-security interest. Less benign interpretations include the possibility that Trump’s inner circle has profited from Nvidia circumventing export controls. Determining what in fact took place will likely consume months of reporting and Watergate-style oversight hearings from a Congress that, as of January, will no longer be controlled by the president’s lackeys. Going into damage-control mode would be rational. Instead Trump apparently believes that he can train his supporters to align their instincts with his and define his behavior as good and correct, as he did with the Russia hoax, or the perfect phone call with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, or the stolen 2020 election. “I have gotten to know Jensen, and he is a Great Patriot and National Treasure,” Trump wrote on Truth Social this morning. He followed this up by sharing a depiction of the 2024 attempted assassination of himself in Butler, Pennsylvania, but with Huang in his place, bloodied and holding aloft a red bra. As long as the stock market goes up, Jensen Huang can sleep with all the Chinese spies he wants.

title: KEEN SWORD 27: 3rd EOD Company and Japan Ground Self-Defense Force EOD conducts live fire
zh_title: KEEN SWORD 27：第3排爆连与日本陆上自卫队排爆进行实弹射击
summary: 日本冲绳 - 日本冲绳 - 2026 年 10 月 23 日，美国海军陆战队与第三爆炸物处理连、第 9 工兵支援营、第 3 海军陆战队后勤大队在日本冲绳举行的双边实弹地面响应训练中与日本陆上自卫队成员一起接受训练。在训练期间，海军陆战队和日本陆上自卫队人员练习了靶场安全程序、设备准备和地面响应技术，同时协调各自的人员在受控环境中的行动。此次训练为双方部队提供了观摩对方程序和交流的机会
content:
日本冲绳——

日本冲绳 — 2026 年 10 月 23 日，美国海军陆战队第 3 爆炸物处理连、第 9 工兵支援营、第 3 海军陆战队后勤大队与日本陆上自卫队成员一起在日本冲绳举行双边实弹地面反应训练。

在训练期间，海军陆战队和日本陆上自卫队人员练习了靶场安全程序、设备准备和地面响应技术，同时在受控环境中协调行动。这次训练为双方部队提供了观察彼此程序并交流与正确排爆操作相关知识的机会。

双边实弹地面反应训练包括涉及铝热手榴弹、M112爆破块、导爆索、水弹和无人机等爆炸材料和设备的技术演示。美国和日本的排爆人员观察并进行了这些演示，以便在移动到安全距离进行受控爆炸之前分享知识。

美国海军陆战队准尉洛根·马尔（Logan Maar）是第三排爆炸物连队的排爆潜水员军官，他解释说：“通过共同培训，我们更好地了解了各自的操作方式，并识别了我们程序之间的差异和挑战。”
美国和日本的排爆人员一起执行这些拆除行动，能够运用学到的协调和沟通技巧。 “在课堂上讨论程序是​​一回事，在这种演变之前我们与日本人就这样做过，但在现场培训环境中一起执行它们是另一回事，”马尔说。

中士。第三排爆连排爆技术员丹尼尔·阿罗约强调了交流爆炸物处理知识的重要性。 “这种培训很重要，因为它不仅可以与我们的合作伙伴建立凝聚力，还可以让他们了解我们拥有哪些工具以及我们如何使用它们。”

阿罗约还讨论了铝热剂的使用以及选择适当方法的重要性，这些方法可以减少任务所需的爆炸材料的数量，同时减轻爆炸期间对周围区域的潜在损害。

对于参加培训的日本人员来说，他们了解了美国同行如何进行作战决策。

“我们第一次弄清楚如何一起工作不应该是在现实世界的危机期间，因此像这样的一起培训很重要，”马尔说。 “我了解到日本人有很多与我们相似的能力，而且他们的很多训练都是以同样的方式进行的。”
此次训练演进是“利剑27”演习的一部分。“利剑27”演习是一项由多国参与的两年一次的例行双边野战训练演习，旨在提高美军和日本自卫队之间的战备状态和互操作性，同时加强铁定的美日同盟。

【原文 English Original】
OKINAWA, Japan --

OKINAWA, Japan – U.S. Marines with 3rd Explosive Ordnance Disposal Company, 9th Engineer Support Battalion, 3rd Marine Logistics Group, trained alongside Japan Ground Self-Defense Force members during a bilateral live-fire ground response training on Okinawa, Japan, Oct. 23, 2026.

During the training, Marines and JGSDF personnel practiced range safety procedures, equipment preparation and ground response techniques while coordinating their actions in a controlled environment. This training provided an opportunity for both forces to observe each other’s procedures and exchange knowledge related to proper EOD operations.

The bilateral live-fire ground response training included technical demonstrations involving explosive materials and equipment such as thermite grenades, M112 demolition blocks, detonating cord, water charges and drones. U.S. and Japanese EOD personnel observed and conducted these demonstrations to share knowledge before moving to safe distances for controlled detonations.

U.S. Marine Corps Warrant Officer Logan Maar, an EOD diver officer with 3rd EOD Company, explained, “By training together, we develop a better understanding of how we each operate and identify the differences and challenges between our procedures.”

U.S. and Japanese EOD personnel conducting these demolition operations together were able to apply learned coordination and communication skills. "It’s one thing to discuss procedures in a classroom, which we did with the Japanese prior to this evolution, but it’s another to execute them together in a live training environment,” said Maar.

Sgt. Daniel Arroyo, an EOD technician with 3rd EOD Company, emphasized the importance of exchanging explosive ordnance disposal knowledge. “This training is important because not only does it build cohesion with our partner force, but it also allows them to see what tools we have and how we employ them.”

Arroyo also discussed the use of thermite and the importance of selecting appropriate methods that can reduce the amount of explosive materials needed for tasks while alleviating potential damage to surrounding areas during detonation.

For Japanese personnel who participated in the training, they learned how their U.S. counterparts’ approach making operational decisions.

“The first time we figure out how to work together should not be during a real-world crisis, so training together like this is important,” said Maar. “I’ve learned the Japanese have a lot of similar capabilities that we have, and a lot of their training is done the same way.”

This training evolution was part of exercise Keen Sword 27. Keen Sword is a routine, biennial bilateral field training exercise with multinational participation, designed to increase readiness and interoperability between the U.S. military and Japan Self-Defense Forces while strengthening the ironclad U.S.-Japan alliance.

title: Hong Kong stocks fall for sixth day, losing over 1,500 points
zh_title: 港股连续六日下跌 跌逾1,500点
summary: 港股连续六日下跌 跌逾1,500点 |中国劳工布告栏 星期二, 2026 年 11 月 24 日·香港 香港及中国劳工英文新闻 港股连续第六天下跌，跌逾 1,500 点 香港恒生指数 11 月 24 日跌 164 点至 22,219 点，连续第六日下跌，累计跌幅逾 1,500 点。科技指数跌至两年低点，人工智能股表现不一。港股 11 月 24 日震荡下跌，恒指收报 22,219 点，跌 164 点
content:
港股连续六日下跌 跌逾1,500点 |中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 24 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
港股连续六日下跌 跌逾1,500点
香港恒生指数11月24日下跌164点至22,219点，连续第六个交易日下跌，累计跌幅超过1,500点。科技指数跌至两年低点，人工智能股表现不一。
11 月 24 日，港股震荡下跌，恒生指数收报 22,219 点，跌 164 点或 0.73%。当天早些时候，该指数曾上涨超过 260 点至 22,647 点，随后跌至午后低点 22,183 点，跌幅高达 200 点。收市创 18 个月新低，成交额突破 2,126 亿港元。
目前该股指已经连续六个交易日下跌，累计跌幅超过1500点。科技指数曾短暂升至3,600点上方，最终收于3,466点，下跌41点或1.17%，为两年多以来的最低水平。
阿里巴巴、腾讯、美团、小米和京东等所谓 ATMXJ 集团的股价均下跌。小米和美团跌幅均超过3%。
人工智能相关股票的表现参差不齐。 MINIMAX和智普AI分别下跌近3%和超过6%。中芯国际、华虹硅业和联想集团股价上涨0.5%至近4%。光通信股也上涨。
黄金相关股普遍走低，而资源股则承压。太古公司以8%的折扣出售国泰航空股票，导致国泰航空股价下跌约2%；太古股份A股和B股分别上涨近0.4%和超过1%。
上市首日，仙通药业收盘价较发行价低23%，成为首家以无纸化形式发行的新股。

Hong Kong stocks fall for sixth day, losing over 1,500 points | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 24 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong stocks fall for sixth day, losing over 1,500 points
Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index fell 164 points to 22,219 on 24 November, marking a sixth consecutive daily decline and a cumulative loss of over 1,500 points. The technology index dropped to a two-year low, while AI stocks showed mixed performance.
Hong Kong stocks ended a volatile session lower on 24 November, with the Hang Seng Index closing at 22,219 points, down 164 points or 0.73 per cent. Earlier in the day, the index had risen more than 260 points to 22,647 before sliding to an afternoon low of 22,183, a drop of up to 200 points. The close was a fresh 18-month low, with turnover exceeding HK$212.6 billion.
The benchmark has now fallen for six consecutive trading days, losing more than 1,500 points in total. The technology index, which briefly rose above 3,600 points, ended the day at 3,466, down 41 points or 1.17 per cent, its lowest level in over two years.
Shares in the so-called ATMXJ group—Alibaba, Tencent, Meituan, Xiaomi and JD.com—all declined. Xiaomi and Meituan each fell more than 3 per cent.
Performance among artificial-intelligence related stocks was mixed. MINIMAX and Zhipu AI dropped nearly 3 per cent and more than 6 per cent respectively. SMIC, Hua Hong Silicon and Lenovo Group rose between 0.5 per cent and nearly 4 per cent. Optical communication stocks also gained.
Gold-related shares were broadly lower, while resource stocks came under pressure. Swire Pacific sold Cathay Pacific shares at an 8 per cent discount, sending Cathay Pacific down about 2 per cent; Swire Pacific's A and B shares rose nearly 0.4 per cent and more than 1 per cent respectively.
On its first day of trading, Xiantong Pharmaceutical closed 23 per cent below its initial public offering price, becoming the first new listing issued in scripless form.

Murtha（LPD-26）已驶入新加坡三巴旺。马金岛号和约翰·P·穆萨号与两栖运输船坞舰安克雷奇号 (LPD-23) 和已上船的第 13 海军陆战队远征部队组成了马金岛两栖待命大队。安克雷奇仍停靠在日本横须贺司令舰队活动中心。 2026 年 11 月 14 日，美国海军水手长三等大副马修·普里米蒂沃（左）和水手长二等大副杰伦·斯罗克莫顿在新加坡海上抛锚期间将千斤顶杆固定在独立型濒海战斗舰塔尔萨号（LCS-16）上。美国海军照片濒海战斗舰塔尔萨号（LCS-16）驶入新加坡周六出发，周一出发。塔尔萨隶属于第七驱逐舰中队（DESRON），该中队部署在东南亚前沿，是东南亚行动区指定舰艇的主要战术和作战指挥官。

在菲律宾海 中国人民解放军海军辽宁舰仍部署在菲律宾海。该打击群最后一次被目击是在10月份，包括航母辽宁号（16）、巡洋舰鞍山号（101）和无锡号（104）以及驱逐舰淮南号（123）。此后随行船只可能发生了变化。在釜山，韩国皇家海军近海巡逻舰 HMS Spey (P234) 于 2026 年 11 月 16 日抵达韩国釜山进行港口访问。英国皇家海军照片 英国皇家海军近海巡逻舰 HMS Spey (P234) 周一抵达釜山进行港口访问。斯佩号和姊妹舰添马舰 (P233) 正在前沿部署

content:
美国芯片限制不会影响马来西亚与中国的关系海峡时报
安瓦尔：美国芯片限制不会影响马来西亚与中国的关系
立即注册：深入了解马来西亚最大的故事
马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣表示，该国不倾向于中国或美国，尽管他发现与北京打交道总体上更容易。
发表于 2026 年 11 月 24 日 1:55
更新于 2026 年 11 月 24 日 03:53
据《南华早报》报道，马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣表示，美国针对中国的芯片限制不会改变马来西亚与北京的关系。
安瓦尔表示，马来西亚不会站在中国或美国一边，它将继续与中国公司合作，同时关注美国公司向中国出口芯片。
马来西亚还将向需要帮助保护供应链的外国投资者寻求付款，正如安瓦尔所说：“你付钱。我们作为一个企业正在变得聪明。”
吉隆坡——根据 11 月 24 日发表的采访，马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣表示，美国对先进人工智能芯片的出口限制旨在限制中国使用这些芯片，但这不会阻止马来西亚与北京和中国企业合作。
安瓦尔告诉《南华早报》，马来西亚既不倾向于中国也不倾向于美国，尽管他发现由于现有的文化和地区联系，与北京打交道通常更容易。
安瓦尔在接受采访时表示，中国没有对吉隆坡与美国的关系或其与华盛顿的技术安排提出任何担忧。
“与中国拥有良好的关系并不妨碍我们继续与美国接触。中国人似乎也理解这一点。人们倾向于认为我有点偏向中国。事实并非如此，”他说。
《南华早报》表示，此次采访是在安瓦尔于 11 月深圳 APEC 峰会期间与中国国家主席习近平会面之前进行的。
美国新规定限制向马来西亚、新加坡和泰国等东南亚国家运送先进芯片，中国公司利用这些芯片来获取计算能力来训练人工智能模型。
安瓦尔表示，马来西亚将监控是否有任何与美国有联系的公司向中国运送芯片，就像监控需要按照北京制定的规则运营的中国公司一样。
“如果你对（美国）公司施加一个不能向中国出口的条件，这是公平的。我们会遵守这一点，因为这是你与你的公司达成的协议，”他说。
“但这并不妨碍我们决定与中国人合作、与中国投资以及与中国公司一起做出自己的决定。”
安瓦尔表示，马来西亚还将向寻求政府援助的外国投资者寻求融资，以保护其供应链。
“你需要我们的帮助吗？是的。你付钱。作为一家企业，我们正在变得越来越聪明，”他说。路透社

US chip curbs will not impact Malaysia’s China ties: Anwar
Sign up now: Get insights on the biggest stories in Malaysia
Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said that the country was not leaning to either China or the US, though he found it generally easier to deal with Beijing.
Published Nov 24, 2026, 01:55 PM
Updated Nov 24, 2026, 03:53 PM
US chip curbs aimed at China will not change Malaysia’s ties with Beijing, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said, according to the South China Morning Post.
Anwar said Malaysia is not siding with China or the United States, and it will keep working with Chinese firms while watching US company chip exports to China.
Malaysia will also seek payment from foreign investors needing help to protect supply chains, as Anwar said: “You pay. We are getting smart as a business.”
KUALA LUMPUR – US export curbs on advanced AI chips aimed at restricting their use by China will not deter Malaysia from working with Beijing and Chinese firms, Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said, according to an interview published on Nov 24.
Anwar told the South China Morning Post that Malaysia was not leaning to either China or the United States, though he found it generally easier to deal with Beijing, due to existing cultural and regional ties.
China has not raised any concerns over Kuala Lumpur’s relationship with the United States or its technology arrangements with Washington, Anwar said in the interview.
“Having excellent relations with China does not preclude us from continuing to engage with the United States. And the Chinese seem to understand. People tend to suggest that I’m tilting a bit towards China. It’s not true,” he said.
SCMP said the interview was conducted before Anwar’s meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping during the APEC summit in Shenzhen in November.
The new US rule restricts shipments of advanced chips to South-east Asian countries such as Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand, which Chinese companies have used to access computing power to train AI models.
Anwar said Malaysia would monitor if any US-linked companies were shipping chips to China, just as it would monitor Chinese firms required to operate under rules set by Beijing.
“If you impose a condition on the (US) company that it cannot export to China, fair. We will observe that because that is the agreement you have with your company,” he was quoted as saying.
“But that will not preclude our decision to work with the Chinese, with Chinese investments and with Chinese companies making their own decisions.”
Malaysia would also seek financing from foreign investors seeking government assistance to safeguard its supply chain, Anwar said.
“You want our help? Yes. You pay. We are getting smart as a business,” he said. REUTERS

content:
中国制造商高途创新推出了一款离网电动汽车（EV）充电系统，旨在解决与澳大利亚农村和内陆地区相关的“独特挑战”。高图表示，一体化 GT-EV16-PB-FD 充电器集成了可折叠光伏阵列，可提供最大 1,600 W 的太阳能输入功率和 2.5 kWh 磷酸铁锂电池组。该制造商表示，该系统能够提供长达 80 公里的每日行驶里程，完全独立于电网，并且是澳大利亚“电动汽车车主的游戏规则改变者”。该公司表示：“许多澳大利亚电动汽车车主在偏远地区旅行或露营时面临充电缺口。” “我们的屋顶安装太阳能电动汽车充电器使驾驶员能够直接从阳光中获取能量，而无需依赖公共充电站。” GT-EV16-PB-FD系统配备双独立MPPT跟踪器，高图表示支持最大800W×2的光伏输入，MPPT效率高达99.9%，而太阳能电池板的电池级转换效率为25%。该太阳能电池组配有内置 2.5 kWh 电池组，可充当重要的缓冲器，吸收传入的能量峰值并将调节后的交流电直接输送到车辆入口。通过蓝牙和 Wi-Fi 的智能 APP 控制可实现远程充电管理。
高图表示，这款可折叠太阳能电池板专为车顶安装而设计，采用IP68级外壳，其空气动力学设计可承受高达160公里/小时的风速。太阳能电池板的展开尺寸为3,350厘米×2,310厘米。该系统的工作温度范围为 ‑20 °C 至 +55 °C，第一年功率衰减约为 1%，随后几年每年最大功率衰减为 0.4%。该产品享有五年工艺保修和两年电源性能保修。高图表示，除了电动汽车充电之外，该装置还可以充当离网UPS电源。该公司表示：“当市电功率下降时，10毫秒内的无缝切换保证了持续的功率输出。”高图表示，除了为当地经销商提供完整的产品外，它还为澳大利亚合作伙伴提供完整的OEM和ODM定制服务。这家中国初创公司提供可折叠离网太阳能电动汽车充电器，首次出现在《全球光伏》杂志上。

【原文 English Original】
Chinese manufacturer Gaotu Innovation has unveiled an off-grid electric vehicle (EV) charging system designed to address the “unique challenges” associated with Australia’s rural and outback regions. Gaotu said the all-in-one GT‑EV16‑PB‑FD charger integrates a foldable PV array that delivers a maximum solar input power of 1,600 W with a 2.5 kWh lithium‑iron‑phosphate battery pack. The manufacturer said the system is capable of providing up to 80 kilometres of daily driving range, completely independent of the grid, and is “a game-changer for EV owners” in Australia. “Many Australian EV owners face charging gaps when travelling in remote areas or going camping,” the company said. “Our roof‑mount solar EV charger allows drivers to harvest energy directly from sunlight, independent of public charging stations.” The GT‑EV16‑PB‑FD system is equipped with dual independent MPPT trackers that Gaotu said support a maximum PV input of 800 W ×2, with MPPT efficiency up to 99.9 % while the solar panels deliver a cell‑level conversion efficiency of 25%. The solar is paired with a built‑in 2.5 kWh battery pack that acts as an essential buffer, absorbing incoming energy spikes and delivering regulated AC power straight into the vehicle inlet. Smart APP control via Bluetooth and Wi‑Fi enables remote charging management. Designed for vehicle‑roof installation, Gaotu said the foldable solar array is housed in an IP68 -rated enclosure while the aerodynamic design to withstand wind speeds up to 160 kph. The unfolded dimension of the solar array is 3,350 cm × 2,310 cm. The system’s operating temperature ranges from ‑20 °C to +55 °C, and the first‑year power degradation is about 1%, followed by maximum 0.4% annual degradation in subsequent years. The product comes with a five‑year workmanship warranty and a two‑year power‑performance warranty. In addition to EV charging, Gaotu said the unit can also act as an off‑grid UPS power supply. “When mains power drops, seamless switch‑over within 10 ms guarantees continuous power output,” the company said. Besides complete units for local distributors, Gaotu said it also offers full OEM and ODM customisation for Australian partners. To fight a $500 billion scam industry, break its supply chain
The authorities must disrupt the entire criminal chain to combat this modern crime
Chinese nationals accused of running an online scam ring are escorted out of a news conference in Jakarta last November following their arrest by Indonesian authorities. | REUTERS
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
Victims of financial fraud lost almost $500 billion last year, based on surveys in 42 countries. Yet the staggering sums aren’t the most alarming part. Fraud is becoming more sophisticated and global, turning what was once a collection of isolated scams into a sprawling cross-border business.
In Southeast Asia, criminal activities are highly centralized: A scam compound in the Mekong region — in Myanmar or on the Thai-Cambodia border — can hunt for marks in more than 100 countries.
Recruitment itself is a form of cross-border trafficking. Poor, unemployed people are lured overseas with promises of legitimate work, only to be trapped in compounds and forced to defraud strangers online. According to the U.N. Human Rights Office, at least 120,000 people in Myanmar — and roughly 100,000 in Cambodia — have been held for that purpose. Families have to pay ransoms for their release; often employees must recruit their own replacements.

香港海关突袭打击通讯应用群中的假冒产品销售中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 24 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港海关突袭打击通讯应用群销售假冒产品
香港海关于11月17日拘捕一名39岁女子，涉嫌通过即时通讯应用群组售卖冒牌货品。突击行动覆盖尖沙咀一间办事处以及火炭和元朗的仓库，检获怀疑假冒物品。调查仍在继续。
2026 年 11 月 24 日 18:15 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 24 日 18:18 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
香港海关在一项打击通过即时通讯应用群组售卖冒牌货品的特别行动中拘捕一名39岁女子。此次执法行动于 11 月 17 日采取，此前公众提出了投诉，并在商标持有人的协助下进行了调查。
海关人员先搜查尖沙咀东部一商业大厦单位，拘捕嫌疑人，并检获一批怀疑冒牌物品。同日晚些时候，人员在火炭及元朗两间据信与案件有关的货仓进行搜查，并发现更多怀疑冒牌货品。
被捕女子现已保释候查。海关表示，调查仍在进行中，不排除进一步逮捕的可能性。
海关提醒消费者应光顾信誉良好的商户或网上商店，避免与可疑商户进行交易。任何人对商品真伪有疑问，应首先向相关商标持有人或其授权代理人查询。
根据《商品说明条例》，出售或管有冒牌物品供出售即属犯罪。一经定罪，违法者最高可被罚款50万港元及最高五年监禁。
海关表示，定期巡查实体市场和网上平台，并利用大数据系统进行风险评估和分析，确保网上商店遵守《条例》，从而加强电商消费者保障。
市民可致电海关24小时热线182 8080、专用电邮帐户[email protected]或网上表格eform.cefs.gov.hk/form/ced002举报怀疑冒牌货品活动。

Hong Kong Customs raid targets counterfeit sales on messaging app groups | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 24 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong Customs raid targets counterfeit sales on messaging app groups
Hong Kong Customs arrested a 39-year-old woman on 17 November for allegedly selling counterfeit goods via instant messaging app groups. The raids, covering a Tsim Sha Tsui office and warehouses in Fo Tan and Yuen Long, seized suspected fake items. Investigations continue.
24 Nov 2026 at 18:15 HKT · updated 24 Nov, 18:18 · 1 min read
Hong Kong Customs have arrested a 39-year-old woman in a special operation targeting the sale of counterfeit goods through instant messaging application groups. The enforcement action, taken on 17 November, followed public complaints and an investigation with assistance from trademark holders.
Customs officers first searched a commercial building unit in Tsim Sha Tsui East, where they detained the suspect and seized a batch of suspected counterfeit items. Later the same day, officers conducted searches at two warehouses in Fo Tan and Yuen Long believed to be linked to the case, where further suspected counterfeit goods were found.
The arrested woman has been released on bail pending further inquiries. Customs said the investigation is ongoing and did not rule out further arrests.
Customs reminded consumers to patronise reputable shops or online stores and avoid dealing with suspicious merchants. Anyone with doubts about the authenticity of goods should first check with the relevant trademark holder or their authorised agent.
According to the Trade Descriptions Ordinance, selling or possessing counterfeit items for sale is an offence. Upon conviction, offenders face a maximum fine of HK$500,000 and up to five years in prison.
Customs said it regularly patrols physical markets and online platforms, and uses a big-data system for risk assessment and analysis to ensure online shops comply with the ordinance, thereby strengthening consumer protection in e-commerce.
Members of the public can report suspected counterfeit activity via Customs' 24-hour hotline 182 8080, the dedicated email account [email protected], or the online form at eform.cefs.gov.hk/form/ced002.

保诚香港与爱尔眼科医院合作直接计费 |中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 24 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
保诚香港与爱尔眼科医院合作直接计费
保诚香港与爱尔眼科医院合作，提供眼科服务直接计费服务，成为香港首家这样做的保险公司。此次合作扩大了大湾区的专科护理范围，使客户无需预付款即可获得治疗
保诚香港周二宣布与爱尔眼科医院合作，提供眼科服务直接计费服务，成为香港第一家与爱尔眼科医院合作的保险公司。此举扩大了该保险公司在大湾区 (GBA) 的专业护理服务范围。
保险公司表示，通过该协议，保诚客户可以在爱尔眼科指定医疗机构进行眼科手术和住院治疗的直接计费安排，无需预先支付费用。在治疗前，客户可以从医院获得成本估算并向保诚提交预先批准请求。获得批准后，保险公司将根据承保条款直接与医疗服务提供者结算符合条件的费用。
香港保诚集团行政总裁林志刚表示：“随着爱尔眼作为首家大型专科眼科医疗集团加入我们的跨境医疗费用直付服务网络，我们将继续汇聚领先的医疗合作伙伴和资源，打造更加全面、多元化的医疗增值服务网络。”他补充道：“医疗保健保护的未来不应由地理界限来定义。相反，它应该使客户能够在需要时更轻松地获取优质医疗资源。”
爱尔眼科医院副院长张永梅表示，随着大湾区一体化的深入，跨境医疗服务需求快速增长。她补充道：“与保诚香港的直接计费合作伙伴关系，同时将我们在大湾区的 11 家医院纳入网络，标志着我们直接计费生态系统的又一次重大扩张，也是深化我们区域足迹的关键一步。”

Prudential Hong Kong partners Aier Eye Hospital for direct billing | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 24 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Prudential Hong Kong partners Aier Eye Hospital for direct billing
Prudential Hong Kong has partnered with Aier Eye Hospital to offer direct billing for ophthalmology services, becoming the first insurer in the city to do so. The collaboration expands specialist care access across the Greater Bay Area, allowing customers to receive treatment without upfront payment
Prudential Hong Kong on Tuesday announced a partnership with Aier Eye Hospital to offer direct billing for ophthalmology services, making it the first insurer in the city to collaborate with the hospital. The move expands the insurer's specialist care offerings across the Greater Bay Area (GBA).
Through the agreement, Prudential customers can access direct billing arrangements for ophthalmic surgeries and inpatient treatment at Aier Eye's designated medical institutions, eliminating the need to pay expenses upfront, the insurer said. Before treatment, customers can obtain a cost estimate from the hospital and submit a pre-approval request to Prudential. Upon approval, the insurer will settle eligible expenses directly with the medical provider, subject to coverage terms.
Lawrence Lam Chi-kong, chief executive of Prudential Hong Kong, said: 'With Aier Eye joining our cross-border Medical Expenses Direct Billing Service network as the first large-scale specialist ophthalmic healthcare group, we will continue to bring together leading healthcare partners and resources to build a more comprehensive and diversified network of medical value-added services.' He added: 'The future of healthcare protection should not be defined by geographical boundaries. Instead, it should empower customers to access quality healthcare resources more easily, whenever they need them.'
Zhang Yongmei, vice president of Aier Eye Hospital, said demand for cross-border healthcare services is rising rapidly as GBA integration deepens. 'This direct billing partnership with Prudential Hong Kong—simultaneously incorporating 11 of our hospitals across the GBA into the network—marks another major expansion of our direct billing ecosystem and a key step in deepening our regional footprint,' she added.

title: Tai Po fire: Wang Fuk Court residents who sold titles excluded from third owners’ meeting next month
zh_title: 大埔火警：宏福苑卖业居民下月第三次业主会议被排除
summary: 政府指定的遭受火灾的宏福苑管理员已宣布下个月举行第三次业主会议，但已出售业权的居民除外。 2026 年 8 月 20 日，宏福苑周边地区仍被警方封锁。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。合安管理公司周一宣布，宏福苑自去年11月致命大火以来的第三次业主大会将于12月6日在大埔社区中心举行。这场大火造成 168 人死亡，数千人流离失所，成为香港数十年来最致命的火灾之一。与过去两次见面不同
content:
政府指定的遭受火灾的宏福苑管理员已宣布下个月举行第三次业主会议，但已出售业权的居民除外。 2026 年 8 月 20 日，宏福苑周边地区仍被警方封锁。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。合安管理公司周一宣布，宏福苑自去年11月致命大火以来的第三次业主大会将于12月6日在大埔社区中心举行。这场大火造成 168 人死亡，数千人流离失所，成为香港数十年来最致命的火灾之一。与过去的两次会议不同的是，下个月的会议将在一个地点举行，这表明合安预计出席人数将会减少。过去两次会议是在四个场地进行转播，以容纳大量前宏福苑居民。消息公布后，一些根据政府回购计划出售公寓的居民被告知，他们将不再有资格参加业主会议。 HKFP看到，在通过在线系统发出的通知中，Hop On表示，未在土地注册处记录中列为公寓注册业主的居民将无法报名参加下个月的会议。政府表示，宏福苑共有1,984户业主，其中99.3%表示愿意根据回购计划出售业权，只有13户拒绝出售。
当局表示，他们计划最早于明年立法收购所有未售出的业权。2026 年 7 月 19 日，宏福苑居民参加在大埔社区中心举行的业主会议。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。居民正在签署正式销售协议，将其产权转让给政府，一些居民已经开始根据换屋安排选择新的政府补贴单位。但据一位吴姓居民表示，一些尚未正式转让产权的居民或许可以参加下个月的会议。吴周一告诉《香港新闻社》，她的家人原计划在本月底签署正式合同，但现在要等到下个月的会议之后。合安表示，会议议程将包括宏福苑财务状况报告、任命2026财年审计师的决定，以及可能出现的任何其他事务。

【原文 English Original】
The government-appointed administrator of fire-hit Wang Fuk Court has announced a third owners’ meeting next month, excluding residents who have sold their titles. The area surrounding Wang Fuk Court remains blocked by police force on August 20, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Hop On Management announced on Monday that the third Wang Fuk Court owners’ meeting since last November’s deadly blaze will be held on December 6 at the Tai Po Community Centre. The blaze killed 168 people and displaced thousands, making it one of Hong Kong’s deadliest fires in decades. In a departure from the past two meetings — which were broadcast across four venues to accommodate a large turnout of former Wang Fuk Court residents — next month’s meeting will take place at a single venue, signalling that Hop On anticipates lower attendance. Following the announcement, some residents who had sold their flats under a government buyback scheme were told they would no longer be eligible to attend the owners’ meeting. In a notice issued via an online system and seen by HKFP, Hop On said residents not listed as a flat’s registered owner in Land Registry records would be unable to sign up for next month’s meeting. The government has said 99.3 per cent of all 1,984 Wang Fuk Court homeowners have indicated they are willing to sell their titles under the buyback scheme, leaving only 13 households refusing to sell. Authorities have said they plan to introduce legislation as early as next year to acquire any unsold titles. Wang Fuk Court residents attend a flat owners meeting at Tai Po Community Centre on July 19, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Residents are in the process of signing formal sales agreements to transfer their titles to the government, and some have begun selecting new government-subsidised units under a flat-swap arrangement. But some residents who have yet to formalise their title transfer may be able to attend next month’s meeting, according to one resident surnamed Woo. Woo told HKFP on Monday that her family had planned to sign the formal contract at the end of this month, but would now wait until after next month’s meeting. Hop On said the meeting agenda will include a report on Wang Fuk Court’s financial status, a decision on the appointment of an auditor for the 2026 financial year, and any other business that may arise.
