11月24日，河内一家火锅店发生爆炸，造成3人死亡、10多人受伤。警方怀疑煤气泄漏，调查仍在进行中。
爆炸震碎了窗户、墙壁破裂并损坏了附近的房屋。救援队正在寻找幸存者，一些居民已从不安全的建筑中转移出来。
超过 14 人被送往医院，其中一人脑部受伤。目击者 Lan Phuong 说，阳台门突然打开后，她和姐姐感到“害怕”。
河内—11月24日，河内一家火锅店发生爆炸，疑似煤气泄漏，造成三人死亡、十几人受伤，附近房屋受损。
在线新闻媒体 VnExpress 称，清晨的爆炸震碎了窗户，墙壁破裂，金属百叶窗从框架上撕下，波纹屋顶和遮阳篷倒塌。
报告称，爆炸损坏了附近的房屋，并震动了邻近的公寓楼，碎片散落在街道上。
报告称，警方正在使用探测设备搜寻幸存者，并使用液压机械抬起混凝土板，因为担心爆炸发生时餐馆挤满了人，可能会有更多人被困在废墟下。
报告称，当局还从被认为结构不安全的邻近建筑物中转移了居民。
河内警方表示，调查仍在进行中，但初步调查结果表明，部分建筑因瓦斯爆炸而倒塌。
报告称，已有超过 14 人住院治疗，其中包括一名脑外伤患者。
26 岁的 Lan Phuong 告诉 VnExpress，爆炸将她和妹妹惊醒，阳台门被炸飞了约 3m。
“幸运的是，我们当时都盖着毯子，没有受重伤。但我们很害怕，只能尖叫，”她说。美联社

The scene after an explosion at a hotpot eatery in Hanoi on Nov 24.
Published Nov 24, 2026, 05:18 PM
Updated Nov 24, 2026, 05:18 PM
An explosion at a Hanoi hotpot eatery on Nov 24 killed three people and injured more than a dozen. Police suspect a gas leak, and investigations are still ongoing.
The blast shattered windows, cracked walls and damaged nearby houses. Rescue teams are searching for survivors, and some residents have been moved from unsafe buildings.
More than 14 people were taken to hospital, including one with a traumatic brain injury. Witness Lan Phuong said she and her sister were “terrified” after their balcony door flew open.
HANOI – An explosion at a hotpot eatery in Hanoi on Nov 24, suspected to have been caused by a gas leak, killed three people, injured more than a dozen others and damaged nearby houses.
VnExpress, an online news outlet, said the early morning blast shattered windows, cracked walls and tore metal shutters from their frames, while corrugated roofs and awnings collapsed.
The report said the blast damaged nearby houses and shook neighbouring apartment buildings, with debris scattered across the street.
Police are using detection equipment to search for survivors and hydraulic machinery to lift concrete slabs, amid concerns that more people may be trapped under the rubble as the eatery was packed when the blast struck, the report said.
Authorities have also relocated residents from neighbouring buildings deemed structurally unsafe, it said.
Hanoi police were cited as saying investigations were ongoing but preliminary findings pointed to a gas explosion that brought down part of the building.
More than 14 people, including one with a traumatic brain injury, have been hospitalised, the report said.
Lan Phuong, 26, told VnExpress that the blast jolted her and her younger sister awake, sending their balcony door flying about 3m.
“Luckily, we were both covered by blankets at the time and were not seriously injured. But we were terrified and could only scream,” she said. AP

英伟达间谍丑闻后，美国将 Megaspeed 列入黑名单
11月10日，数据中心公司Megaspeed International在新加坡海洋金融中心办公室的标志|法新社-即时

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)政府将Megaspeed International列入美国贸易黑名单，禁止其购买先进的人工智能芯片，目标是一家位于新加坡的公司，该公司是丑闻的核心，该丑闻曾一度导致黄仁勋(Jensen Huang)在英伟达公司(Nvidia Corp.)丢掉饭碗。
在周一提交的文件中，美国商务部正式将中国间谍嫌疑人黄爱丽创立的公司列入其所谓的实体名单，这一指定将限制该公司在未经美国政府许可的情况下购买人工智能芯片和其他先进技术。此次上市还提到了阿里巴巴集团控股公司位于新加坡的一家子公司，这促使这家由电子商务巨头转型为人工智能开发商的公司否认曾转移受限制的半导体。
本月有关黄仁勋与 Alice Huang 的恋情的曝光，让有关 Megaspeed 可能将 Nvidia 的人工智能芯片走私到中国的指控再次成为人们关注的焦点。这一事件引发了人们的疑问，即商务部是否一直在严格执行旨在防止敏感技术落入对手手中的美国出口管制。

U.S. blacklists Megaspeed after Nvidia spy scandal
The logo of data center company Megaspeed International at its office in the Ocean Financial Center in Singapore on Nov. 10 | AFP-JIJI

The administration of U.S. President Donald Trump put Megaspeed International on a U.S. trade blacklist that bars it from buying advanced artificial intelligence chips, targeting a Singapore-based firm at the heart of the scandal that briefly cost Jensen Huang his job at Nvidia Corp.
In a filing Monday, the Commerce Department moved to formally add the company established by Chinese spy suspect Alice Huang to its so-called entity list, a designation that would restrict the company from buying AI chips and other advanced technology without a U.S. government license. The listing also named a Singapore-based unit of Alibaba Group Holding, prompting the e-commerce giant-turned AI developer to deny it had ever diverted restricted semiconductors.
Revelations this month about Jensen Huang’s affair with Alice Huang put a fresh spotlight on allegations that Megaspeed may have been smuggling Nvidia’s artificial intelligence chips into China. The episode spurred questions about whether Commerce had been rigorously enforcing U.S. export controls designed to keep sensitive technology from falling into adversaries’ hands.

【看中国2026年11月24日讯】（看中国记者辛静综合报导）随着台湾正式迈入超高龄社会，无自有住宅的高龄者面临租屋困难、居住安全及长期照护等问题，逐渐受到关注。内政部国土管理署11月24日表示，政府将持续推动住宅三箭政策，透过兴办社会住宅、社会住宅包租代管及租金补贴，协助不同族群解决居住需求，并将直接兴办社宅及包租代管的供给目标，朝2032年各达25万户推进。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
中央社11月24日报导，针对近期媒体关注无自有住宅高龄者租屋不易，以及居住支持不足等问题，国土署指出，随着台湾人口结构快速老化，高龄者对住宅的需求已不再只是有地方居住，还包括居家安全、长期照护及日常生活支持。除了卫福部持续强化独居老人关怀服务、扩大访查及居家安全措施，内政部也将透过住宅政策提供更多协助，并预计明年1月举办住宅政策研讨会。
在社会住宅包租代管方面，国土署表示，截至今年10月底，全国有效契约数已达11万8923户，其中照顾中低收入户、育有未成年子女2名及65岁以上长者，包括独居老人等13类弱势族群，共计4万8180户，占比达40.5%，符合《住宅法》规定，社会住宅至少应提供40%优先照顾经济或社会弱势家户的要求。
此外，政府也持续推动换居专案，协助高龄者及行动不便等特殊族群改善居住环境，让有特殊需求的民众能够找到更符合自身生活条件的住宅。
至于直接兴办社会住宅，目前全国已兴办约12.8万户。截至今年6月30日，在3万922户社会住宅承租户中，经济或社会弱势住户共有1万4859户，占整体48.1%。租金补贴方面，目前已照顾约75万户租屋家庭，其中65岁以上长者达6万6205户，借此减轻高龄租屋族的经济压力。
国土署进一步指出，社会住宅不只是提供居住空间，也将结合长期照护及社会福利资源。依照《住宅法》第33条规定，社宅将保留一定空间，提供长照、身心障碍服务、托育、青年创业及高龄友善照护等公共设施与服务。
目前，包租代管社会住宅也已与卫福部建立弱势关怀通报机制，业者若发现房客有长照需求，可协助通报1966长照专线，并提供关怀访视及社福资源媒合，让住宅服务从单纯租屋，进一步延伸至日常生活照顾。
国土署最后强调，政府将持续推进住宅三箭政策，直接兴办社会住宅及包租代管，分别朝2032年各提供25万户的目标迈进，并搭配租金补贴，预计透过多元住宅政策照顾百万租屋家庭，减轻不同族群的居住负担。
除了租金负担，高龄者面临的另一个难题，是即使有经济能力，也不一定能顺利找到合适的房子。联合报11月21日报导，崔妈妈基金会执行长吕秉怡指出，台湾进入超高龄社会后，无房、独居及身体逐渐退化的老人越来越需要长期稳定的居住环境，但目前住宅政策与社会福利资源仍存在衔接不足的问题。
他建议，政府应扩大提供社会住宅房源，推动非营利组织承租、民间友善二房东等模式，并结合社福及长照服务，让高龄者能够在熟悉的社区安老。此外，也应检讨社会住宅租期限制，避免老人居住多年后，因为租约到期而被迫搬迁，进一步陷入无房可租的困境。

title: A Shameless Valley
zh_title: 无耻山谷
summary: 本月的 11 天里，硅谷给人的印象是，尽管困难重重，它最终还是要经历真正的耻辱时刻。首先，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认，他与一名涉嫌间谍的中国女商人欺骗了他的妻子，这让他的公司、它所支撑的人工智能行业以及国家安全面临风险。他深表歉意。随后有报道称，黄仁勋还与英伟达的一名高管有染，随后他辞职了。硅谷的一位巨头似乎正面临清算。但昨晚深夜，唐纳德·特朗普发布了
content:
本月的 11 天里，硅谷给人的印象是，尽管困难重重，它最终还是要经历真正的耻辱时刻。首先，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋承认，他与一名涉嫌间谍的中国女商人欺骗了他的妻子，这让他的公司、它所支撑的人工智能行业以及国家安全面临风险。他深表歉意。随后有报道称，黄仁勋还与英伟达的一名高管有染，随后他辞职了。硅谷的一位巨头似乎正面临清算。但昨晚深夜，唐纳德·特朗普在 Truth Social 上发帖称，“我希望英伟达董事会重新聘用黄仁勋。”总统写道，这一结果“对于公司以及美国来说都是最好的事情”。这句话显然既是命令，又是愿望。今天上午，英伟达董事会宣布一致投票决定恢复黄仁勋担任首席执行官。总统随后发布了一个表情包，即使对他来说也是怪诞的：一张看似人工智能生成的黄的图像，脸上受伤流血，举起拳头握紧红色胸罩，背景中飘扬着英伟达的旗帜——当然，这是模仿特朗普第一次暗杀企图后不久拍摄的照片。真是太羞耻了。 [阅读：A] 价值 5.7 万亿美元的面部植物 值得强调的是，黄的丑闻有多么严重。
他承认与一名中国女商人有关系，该女商人涉嫌将英伟达芯片走私到中国，从而规避美国的出口管制，同时他还在不知疲倦地游说放松限制，以防止美国芯片落入中国竞争者之手。对于像英伟达这样的公司来说，这是一个惊天动地的启示：英伟达基本上垄断了用于训练最先进人工智能模型的芯片。这使得该公司变得异常富有——今年早些时候，其估值达到创纪录的 5.7 万亿美元。反过来，黄仁勋利用这笔财富来支持人工智能经济的大部分，为各种数据中心和初创企业提供资金，作为一种财务支持。黄先生辞职后，华尔街经历了近期记忆中最糟糕的一周之一。自他辞职以来，有关第三次婚外情和滥用管理风格的进一步报道只会让黄的处境变得更糟。几乎任何其他行业发生类似丑闻都会导致普遍的政治谴责，并且该公司及其同行都试图与这位名誉扫地的前高管保持距离。但这里恰恰相反。据《纽约时报》报道，特朗普和副总统万斯周末敦促英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋的职位。
今天早上宣布这一消息后，特朗普几乎立即在《真相社交》上发帖，庆祝恢复“伟大爱国者和国宝”黄蜂的“正确和恰当”决定。硅谷的气氛十分热烈：消息传出后，该公司股价上涨了 30% 以上，投资者和科技高管爆发出热烈的掌声。对冲基金经理比尔·阿克曼 (Bill Ackman) 在 X 上写道：“大众的智慧占了上风。”黄的直言不讳的支持者埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 补充道：“错误已被纠正。”硅谷许多最有权势的人物似乎都被证明是正确的——毕竟，他们淡化并认为黄的愚蠢行为只是简单的错误和失常。事实上，整个事情——鲁莽和丑闻以及随后的有罪不罚——是科技界的常态。硅谷

【原文 English Original】
For 11 days this month, Silicon Valley gave the impression that it would finally, against all odds, subject itself to a genuine moment of shame. First, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to having cheated on his wife with a Chinese businesswoman suspected of being a spy, putting his company, the AI industry it undergirds, and the nation’s security at risk. He apologized profusely. Then it was reported that Huang had had another affair, this one with an Nvidia executive, and he resigned. It seemed that one of Silicon Valley’s titans was facing a reckoning. But late last night, Donald Trump posted on Truth Social, “I hope the Board of Nvidia rehires Jensen Huang.” This outcome, the president wrote , “would be the best thing for the Company, and also, for the U.S.A.” Those words were evidently as much a command as they were a wish. This morning, Nvidia’s board of directors announced that it had unanimously voted to reinstate Huang as CEO. The president then posted a meme that, even for him, was grotesque: a seemingly AI-generated image of Huang, face bloodied from a wound, raising a fist clenching a red brassiere with an Nvidia flag waving in the background—modeled, of course, on the photo taken just after the first assassination attempt on Trump. So much for shame. [ Read:A ] $5.7 Trillion Face-Plant It’s worth underscoring just how damning Huang’s scandals were. He admitted to having a relationship with a Chinese businesswoman tied to a company that was suspected of smuggling Nvidia chips to China—thereby sidestepping U.S. export controls—at the same time that he was lobbying tirelessly to ease restrictions meant to keep American chips out of the hands of Chinese competition. For a company in Nvidia’s position, it was an earth-shattering revelation: Nvidia essentially has a monopoly on the chips used to train the most advanced AI models. That has made the firm spectacularly wealthy—earlier this year, it was valued at a record $5.7 trillion. Huang, in turn, used that wealth to underwrite much of the AI economy, funding all manner of data centers and start-ups as a sort of financial backstop. Huang’s resignation was followed by one of the worst weeks on Wall Street in recent memory. Further reports since his resignation—of a third affair and an abusive management style—only made Huang come off worse. A similar scandal in almost any other industry would result in universal political condemnation and an attempt, by both the company and its peers, to distance themselves from the disgraced former executive. But it’s just the opposite here. The New York Times has reported that Trump and Vice President Vance spent the weekend pushing Nvidia’s board to reinstate Huang. Almost immediately after this morning’s announcement, Trump posted on Truth Social to celebrate “the correct and proper” decision to restore Huang, a “Great Patriot and National Treasure.” The mood in Silicon Valley is ebullient: The company’s stock jumped by more than 30 percent on the news, and investors and tech executives have erupted in an ovation. “The wisdom of the crowd prevails,” the hedge-fund manager Bill Ackman wrote on X. Elon Musk, a vocal Huang supporter, added : “The mistake has been corrected.” Many of Silicon Valley’s most powerful characters seem vindicated—after all, they downplayed and dismissed Huang’s follies as simple mistakes and aberrations. In fact, the whole thing—recklessness and scandal followed by impunity—is the norm in the tech world. Silicon Valley has developed a reputation for generosity and forgiveness when it comes to its own sins. Musk has appeared to endorse racist and xenophobic conspiracy theories but sits on a multitrillion-dollar empire of businesses. Meta has been credibly accused of fueling ethnic violence, enabling the spread of misinformation, and harming children through addictive product design—the latter for which it agreed to a major settlement this summer—but remains among the largest companies in the world, and is structured such that Mark Zuckerberg basically cannot be fired. Almost exactly three years ago, Sam Altman was fired from OpenAI for being “not consistently candid” with the firm’s board of directors, only to be reinstated within days after Microsoft and other major investors rallied behind him. Now the entire AI industry is rushing headlong to build products that are jeopardizing the internet as we know it and, per AI executives’ own warnings, could destroy the planet. Meanwhile, Anthropic employees, post–public offering, are estimated to be worth more than the bottom third of U.S. households. Over the past week and a half, legions of tech CEOs came out in support of Huang. “America needs to have more Jensens,” Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas said last Monday. This morning, the investor Chamath Palihapitiya wrote on X that Nvidia’s decision “prevented a massive economic own goal.” Just business as usual for some of the wealthiest companies in the world. (Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.) Altman, asked last week about whether he thought Huang should return, demurred but said he felt “personal strong empathy” for his (soon-to-be) fellow ex-ex-CEO. This morning, Altman posted a single word: “Jensen!” Huang’s return underscores the most important and perhaps singular value driving Silicon Valley: winning. Today that means more chips and data centers, more powerful AI models, greater revenues, soaring stock prices and valuations. Integrity, candor, atonement, and consequences seem like secondary concerns. The repercussions of the industry’s failures—wild swings in the stock market, technologies that wreak havoc on other industries and individual lives, a corrosion of cultural decency—are for everyone else to manage. Personal victory also happens to be one of the president’s major motivations. Trump has aligned himself with every tech CEO he deems successful—Altman, Apple’s Tim Cook, and most of all Huang, who is once again arguably the most influential CEO in the world. Earlier this year, in a now infamous interview, Huang said that “you’re not talking to somebody who woke up a loser.” Today, Silicon Valley decided to embrace its once and future king, whatever mistakes he made. After just 11 days of losing, Huang woke up winning once again.

title: Research schooner Tara sets sail from Hong Kong on 18-month mission to unlock coral resilience secrets
zh_title: 研究纵帆船 Tara 从香港起航，执行为期 18 个月的任务，解开珊瑚恢复力的秘密

content:
本月早些时候，在香港天际线的辉光下，停泊在中环十号码头的“塔拉”号科考船呈现出令人难以置信的景象。它的圆形铝制船体能够承受极地冰的压碎压力，像拇指和食指捏着的橄榄核一样突然弹出，然后随着背包漂流，直到变暖的气温松开它冰冷的抓地力。 2026 年 11 月 4 日停泊在中环 10 号码头的科学帆船塔拉号。照片：Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP。相反，这艘两桅帆船在维多利亚港仍然温暖的海水中煎熬。 “这不是很舒服，”塔拉海洋公司的宣传官员马丁·亚历山德里尼（Martin Alessandrini）在没有窗户、木板镶板的沙龙里承认道，沙龙就位于船的嘶嘶作响的发动机顶上。塔拉号于 1989 年被命名为南极洲，在这里就像一条离开水的鱼。但11月初在香港的短暂停留在很多方面都只是热身。在停泊在海滨后，塔拉号起航前往被称为“海洋亚马逊”的全球海洋生物多样性热点地区。它涵盖印度尼西亚、马来西亚、巴布亚新几内亚、所罗门群岛、东帝汶和菲律宾周围的热带水域，拥有世界三分之一的珊瑚礁和约四分之三的已知珊瑚物种——与近年来经历大规模珊瑚死亡和白化事件的其他地区不同，它以某种方式经受住了气候变化和污染的风暴。
船舱内悬挂着一张描绘塔拉珊瑚探险队路线的图表。照片：Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP。尽管全球范围内的珊瑚礁不断萎缩，而且日益频繁的海洋热浪使珊瑚礁恢复的时间越来越少，但珊瑚三角区仍然保持着弹性。在过去的四十年里，世界上多达一半的珊瑚礁已经消失，但三角洲的珊瑚覆盖率在同一时期内保持稳定。塔拉的使命是找出原因，并弄清楚这些知识如何帮助其他地方的珊瑚保护和恢复工作。 18个月，26次中途停留，6个国家 在18个月的时间里，16名船员将在6个国家进行26次中途停留，总行程约5万公里。一路上，他们还将从当地合作机构招募数十名科学家，对珊瑚样本进行实验。通过将碎片暴露在不同的温度下并测试它们的耐热应激能力，研究小组希望检测出更能抵抗白化的珊瑚生物标志物。这些信息可以用来支持世界各地的珊瑚恢复项目，帮助自然资源保护主义者确定如何重建珊瑚礁以更好地抵御气候压力。法国驻香港及澳门副总领事Benjamin Hubin及agnès b.全球首席运营官 Étienne Bourgois 在 Tara 的甲板上欢迎访客。照片：Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP。
法国蔚蓝海岸大学科学主任保拉·福拉 (Paola Furla) 表示：“与之前在全球或盆地规模进行的研究不同，塔拉珊瑚关注的是唯一一个主要珊瑚礁区域，尽管气候变暖趋势强劲，硬珊瑚覆盖率仍保持相对稳定。”“这为确定复原力机制提供了一个非凡的天然实验室。”塔拉珊瑚探险的规模雄心勃勃。在接下来的一年半里，来自该地区 40 多个合作机构的 70 名科学家将加入该团队。十位驻场艺术家也将登上

【原文 English Original】
Docked at Central Pier No. 10, under the glow of the Hong Kong skyline, the research ship Tara presented an unlikely sight earlier this month. Its round aluminium hull was built to withstand the crushing pressure of polar ice, popping up like an olive pit pinched between thumb and forefinger then drifting with the pack until the warming temperatures loosened its icy grip. The scientific schooner Tara at Central Pier No. 10 on November 4, 2026. Photo: Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP. Instead, the two-masted schooner stewed in the still-warm waters of Victoria Harbour. “It’s not very comfortable,” conceded Tara Ocean advocacy officer Martin Alessandrini in the windowless, wood-panelled saloon perched directly atop the ship’s sizzling engine. Laid down in 1989 as the Antarctica , the Tara is something of a fish out of water here. But its brief stopover in Hong Kong in early November was just a warm-up, in more ways than one. After slipping its harbourfront moorings, the Tara set sail for the global marine biodiversity hotspot known as the “Amazon of the Ocean.” Encompassing the tropical waters around Indonesia, Malaysia, Papua New Guinea, the Solomon Islands, Timor-Leste and the Philippines, it harbours one-third of the world’s coral reefs and about three-quarters of all known coral species – and unlike other regions that have experienced mass coral death and bleaching events in recent years, it has somehow weathered the storms of climate change and pollution. A chart depicting the Tara Coral expedition’s course hangs in the ship’s saloon cabin. Photo: Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP. Even as reefs have been shrinking worldwide, and increasingly frequent marine heatwaves have left them with less time to recover, the Coral Triangle has remained resilient. As much as half of the world’s coral reefs have been lost over the past four decades, but coral cover in the Triangle has held steady over the same period. Tara’s mission is to find out why – and figure out how that knowledge can help coral conservation and restoration efforts elsewhere. 18 months, 26 stopovers, 6 countries Over 18 months, the crew of 16 will make 26 stopovers across six countries, covering a total distance of around 50,000 kilometres. Along the way, they will also pick up dozens of scientists from local partner institutions and conduct experiments on coral samples. By exposing the fragments to different temperatures and testing their heat stress resistance, the team hopes to detect biomarkers of corals that are more resistant to bleaching. This information can then be used to bolster coral restoration projects around the world, helping conservationists determine how to rebuild reefs to better withstand climatic pressures. Benjamin Hubin, Deputy Consul General of France in Hong Kong and Macau, and agnès b. Global COO Étienne Bourgois welcome visitors on Tara’s deck. Photo: Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP. “Unlike previous studies conducted at the global or basin scale, Tara Coral focuses on the only major reef region where hard coral cover has remained relatively stable despite strong warming trends,” said Paola Furla, Scientific Director at France’s Université Côte d’Azur. “This provides an extraordinary natural laboratory for identifying the mechanisms of resilience.” The scale of the Tara Coral expedition is ambitious. Over the next year and a half, the crew will be joined by 70 scientists from over 40 partner institutions around the region. Ten artists-in-residence will also step aboard in what Alessandrini calls “a very multidisciplinary approach.” Companionway on the Tara leading below deck. Photo: Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP. They have vast swathes of ocean to cover, but they are in no hurry to do so. Experts with the Tara Ocean Foundation, backed for over 20 years by French fashion house agnès b., say the expedition’s slow pace is another factor that will make its contributions unique and valuable. Unlike earlier expeditions that have swooped in to collect samples then sailed on, Tara will stay at each of its sampling sites for a month and a half, giving the team time to experiment in the aft-deck’s “wet lab,” where target coral species will be exposed to various water temperatures. Coral at Hong Kong’s Sharp Island. Photo: GovHK. “Maybe [the coral] has been pre-selected by previous heatwaves,” Alessandrini said. The second theory explaining their resilience “is that corals in the region have a different genetic biodiversity,” he added, while “the third option [is] maybe corals in the region have been changing the algae they have inside their bodies and have thus adapted to the heat stress.” Genetic analysis will also be carried out on four target coral species to determine whether there are genes in the region that provide coral with greater resistance potential. Tara at dusk on the Central Harbourfront. Photo: Ryan Ho Kilpatrick/HKFP. “Their past exposure to thermal stress, the effect of internal waves, their genetics, their algal symbionts, their microbiome, their diversity, and the way they organise themselves: these are all avenues the expedition will explore to understand what protects the reefs,” said Serge Planes, Research Director at the French National Centre for Scientific Research. Research by the Tara Ocean Foundation has been published in prestigious scientific journals such as Nature and Science , but the group is also committed to making its findings open-source. When the expedition finally concludes, its datasets will be available online for all. As efforts to protect the ocean’s endangered coral and rebuild lost reefs and communities continue – including in Hong Kong – it is hoped that the Tara Coral expedition’s findings can shore up coral conservation and restoration work far beyond the waters of the Coral Triangle. With even rebuilt and recovering coral populations inevitably exposed to the same dangers posed by warming seas and worsening pollution, Alessandrini said, researchers can work on developing “new criteria on how to build these projects and better enhance their resilience.”

title: Michael Taylor returns to Hong Kong to lead Anchors Academy's K-12 expansion
zh_title: Michael Taylor 重返香港领导 Anchors Academy 的 K-12 扩建
summary: Michael Taylor 重返香港领导 Anchors Academy 的 K-12 扩建 |中国劳工公告 2026 年 11 月 24 日星期二 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 Michael Taylor 重返香港领导 Anchors Academy 的 K-12 扩建项目 UIA 东京国际学校前校长 Michael Taylor 已返回香港，担任 Anchors Academy 中小学指定校长。他将负责学校 K-12 的“直通车”课程，包括新的初中课程以及计划中的第六名迈克尔·泰勒 (Michael Taylor) 已返回香港
content:
Michael Taylor 重返香港领导 Anchors Academy 的 K-12 扩建 |中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 24 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
Michael Taylor 重返香港领导 Anchors Academy 的 K-12 扩建
东京 UIA 国际学校前校长 Michael Taylor 已返回香港，担任 Anchors Academy 中小学指定校长。他将监督学校的 K-12“直通车”路径，包括一个新的初中课程和计划中的第六个课程
从事国际教育二十多年的迈克尔·泰勒 (Michael Taylor) 回到香港，出任有“香港版剑桥”之称的 Anchors Academy 中小学指定校长。泰勒曾任 UIA 东京国际学校校长，他将负责学校小学部及其新推出的初中课程的持续发展。
在东京任职之前，泰勒曾担任京都国际学校校长，并在香港学院和新加坡 ISS 国际学校担任领导职务。他还是剑桥国际教育的学校社区委员会成员和 Faria Education Group 的客户顾问委员会成员。
泰勒说，第一个月学生的热情和老师的投入给他留下了深刻的印象。他说：“从东京到香港，我可以再次把对教育的热情带到这里，我坚信学校有光明的未来。”他补充说，他的办公室门始终敞开，学生们经常过来打招呼。
新学年标志着 Anchors Academy 的一个里程碑，第一批 7 至 9 年级的学生将于 9 月在元朗校区开始上课。泰勒说，跨年龄段的工作，从幼儿到青少年，是吸引力的一部分，与初中生的随意交谈是学习的重要组成部分。他还强调了与家长沟通的重要性，讨论通常集中在支持、包容、成长心态以及学校不同部门之间的更紧密融合。
学校面临的主要挑战之一是将香港本地课程与英国体系的元素相结合，同时保持其所描述的“本地-国际”模式。泰勒表示，学校正在密切合作，以确保其课程符合教育局的要求。
作为其K-12计划的一部分，Anchors Academy与英国St Bees School合作，在西九龙建立香港St Bees (Anchors) Sixth Form College Hong Kong，完成高中阶段的衔接课程。该学院计划于 2027 年 9 月开业，待教育局批准和注册后，将提供包括 IGCSE 和 A-Level 课程在内的高中衔接课程。剑桥大学前副校长戴维·卡德威尔教授被任命为该学院的创始联合主席。
泰勒表示，卡德威尔在东亚的学术背景、网络和经验将有助于支持学校的发展，但他强调，首要任务是确保两个机构的教学标准保持一致。他指出，虽然学校可以提供设施、师资和学术支持，但大学录取最终还是取决于学生自己的努力。他说，他向学生传达的更广泛的信息更简单：“做一个好人”

【原文 English Original】
Michael Taylor returns to Hong Kong to lead Anchors Academy's K-12 expansion | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 24 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Michael Taylor returns to Hong Kong to lead Anchors Academy's K-12 expansion
Michael Taylor, former principal of UIA International School of Tokyo, has returned to Hong Kong as Designated Head of School for Primary and Junior Secondary at Anchors Academy. He will oversee the school's K-12 'through-train' pathway, including a new junior secondary programme and a planned sixth
Michael Taylor has returned to Hong Kong after more than two decades in international education to take up the role of Designated Head of School for Primary and Junior Secondary at Anchors Academy, a school known as the 'Hong Kong version of Cambridge'. Taylor, formerly principal of UIA International School of Tokyo, will oversee the continued development of the school's primary division and its newly launched junior secondary programme.
Before his tenure in Tokyo, Taylor served as head of Kyoto International School and held leadership roles at Hong Kong Academy and ISS International School Singapore. He is also a School Community Board Member of Cambridge International Education and a Client Advisory Board Member at Faria Education Group.
Taylor said he was impressed by the enthusiasm of students and commitment of teachers during his first month. 'From Tokyo to Hong Kong, I can bring my passion for education here again, and I firmly believe the school has a bright future,' he said, adding that his office door was always open and that students often stopped by for a quick hello.
The new academic year marks a milestone for Anchors Academy, with its first Year 7 to 9 students beginning classes at the Yuen Long campus in September. Taylor said working across age groups, from young children to teenagers, was part of the appeal, and that casual conversations with junior secondary students were a vital part of learning. He also emphasised the importance of communication with parents, with discussions often centering on support, inclusion, a growth mindset and closer integration across different parts of the school.
One of the school's main challenges is combining Hong Kong's local curriculum with elements of the British system while maintaining what it describes as a 'local-international' model. Taylor said the school was working closely to ensure its curriculum remained aligned with Education Bureau requirements.
As part of its K-12 plan, Anchors Academy has partnered with St Bees School in the United Kingdom to establish St Bees (Anchors) Sixth Form College Hong Kong in West Kowloon, completing the senior secondary stage of the pathway. The college is planned to open in September 2027, subject to Education Bureau approval and registration, and will offer senior secondary pathways including IGCSE and A-Level programs. Former University of Cambridge pro-vice-chancellor Professor David Cardwell has been named founding co-chair of the college.
Taylor said Cardwell's academic background, networks and experience in East Asia would help support the school's development, but stressed that the priority was ensuring consistent teaching standards across the two institutions. He noted that while the school could provide facilities, teachers and academic support, university admission would ultimately depend on students' own efforts. His broader message to students, he said, was simpler: 'Be a good person.'

title: Hong Kong cinema takes spotlight at Taiwan’s Golden Horse film awards
zh_title: 香港电影在台湾金马奖上备受瞩目
summary: 周日，两部受香港民主运动启发的电影在台湾金马奖上获奖，其中一部获奖感言献给了“监狱里的人”。 2026 年 11 月 22 日，在台北举行的第 63 届台湾金马奖颁奖典礼上，香港女演员袁咏仪凭借电影《余韵》获得最佳女主角奖后摆姿势拍照。照片：I-Hwa Cheng/法新社。 《三只小猪》是一部黑色幽默电影，讲述了香港两个青少年偷猪头的故事，在这场被誉为华语电影的盛会上获得了最佳真人短片奖。
content:
周日，两部受香港民主运动启发的电影在台湾金马奖上获奖，其中一部获奖感言献给了“监狱里的人”。 2026 年 11 月 22 日，在台北举行的第 63 届台湾金马奖颁奖典礼上，香港女演员袁咏仪凭借电影《余韵》获得最佳女主角奖后摆姿势拍照。照片：I-Hwa Cheng/法新社。 《三只小猪》是一部黑色幽默电影，讲述了香港两名青少年偷猪头的故事，在这场被誉为华语奥斯卡的盛会上获得了最佳真人短片奖。 《出发的场景》探讨了一位香港电影制片人和他关系疏远的父亲之间的关系，该片赢得了最佳纪录片奖。故事背景是 2019 年该市发生大规模、有时甚至是暴力的民主抗议活动。次年，北京实施了一项国家安全法，批评者称该法压制了异议。香港随后于 2024 年颁布了一项本土法规，用于审判活动人士和抗议领袖。 《三只小猪》的代表罗安迪周日在台上代表导演锺锦尼和其他剧组人员发表获奖感言时表示：“也许我们的作品会在一瞬间被监狱里的人看到，成为他们心中微小而坚定的光芒，成为真正的陪伴。” “我想把这个奖项献给每一位曾经或仍在监狱里的‘小猪’。
我们将来还会见面的。”另一部香港电影《生来就好》（讲述了一名前囚犯在城里遇见了一位苦苦挣扎的年轻演员的故事）获得了最佳影片和最佳原创剧本奖。台湾导演徐震杰凭借《双喜》击败了日本资深导演田中宏之（专业名称为“萨布”），夺得最佳导演奖。自从一名台湾导演在 2018 年的获奖感言中表示支持台湾独立以来，“非常自豪”的中国导演和一线明星基本上回避了金马奖。北京声称自治民主的台湾是其领土的一部分，在两地政治紧张局势加剧之际，2019 年禁止演艺人员参加金马奖。尽管如此，许多香港明星还是出现在今年台北颁奖典礼的红地毯上。另请参阅：香港电影无视警告，在台湾金马奖上强势亮相 凭借《余韵》中的表演获得最佳女主角的袁安琪表示，她“非常自豪”能够成为“众多获奖的香港电影人之一”。台湾刘冠廷凭借《双喜》获得最佳男主角奖。香港演员兼男子组合成员江业生凭借《我们什么都不是》中的角色获得最佳男配角奖。台湾演员、两届金马奖得主舒淇凭借《女孩》获得最佳新人导演奖，这是她受自己童年启发的导演处女作。
首次担任颁奖典礼主持人的香港演员威尔·柯表示：“今年入围的影片来自各地……金马奖真是汇聚了各地的华语电影。”好莱坞明星赞达亚、杰森·莫玛惊喜现身，与《沙丘》搭档、金马主席张震一起通过视频亮相，共同颁奖。

【原文 English Original】
Two films inspired by Hong Kong’s pro-democracy movement won gongs at Taiwan’s Golden Horse Awards on Sunday, with one acceptance speech dedicated to “those in prison”. Hong Kong actress Angela Yuen poses for photos after winning Best Leading Actress for the movie Afterpiece at Taiwan’s 63rd Golden Horse film awards ceremony, in Taipei on November 22, 2026. Photo: I-Hwa Cheng/AFP. “Three Little Pigs”, a dark-humour film about two teenagers in Hong Kong on a mission to steal a pig’s head, picked up the prize for best live action short film at the prestigious event, dubbed the Chinese-language Oscars. “Scenes from Departure”, which explores the relationship between a Hong Kong filmmaker and his estranged father, won best documentary feature. It is set against the backdrop of the city’s huge and sometimes violent pro-democracy protests in 2019. The following year, Beijing imposed a national security law that critics say has quelled dissent. Hong Kong then enacted a homegrown code in 2024, with both used to try activists and protest leaders. Andy Law, a representative for “Three Little Pigs” delivering an acceptance speech on behalf of director Chung Kam-nei and other crew members, said on stage on Sunday: “Maybe in one instant our work will be seen by those in prison, becoming a small yet unwavering light for them, and genuine companionship.” “I want to dedicate this award to every ‘little pig’ who has been or is still in prison. We’ll see each other in the future.” Another Hong Kong film, “We Are Born Good” — about a former prisoner who meets a struggling young actor in the city — won best film and best original screenplay. Taiwanese director Joseph Hsu Chen-chieh bagged the best director award for “Double Happiness”, beating veteran Japanese director Hiroyuki Tanaka, known professionally as Sabu. ‘Very proud’ Chinese directors and A-listers have largely shunned the Golden Horse Awards since a Taiwanese director voiced support for the island’s independence in an acceptance speech in 2018. Beijing, which claims self-ruled democratic Taiwan as part of its territory, banned entertainers from attending the event in 2019 at a time of rising political tensions between the two sides. Still, many Hong Kong stars were spotted on the red carpet for this year’s ceremony in Taipei. See also: Hong Kong films defy warnings with strong presence at Taiwan’s Golden Horse awards Angela Yuen, who won best leading actress for her performance in “Afterpiece”, said she was “very proud” to be among “many Hong Kong filmmakers who won awards”. Taiwan’s Liu Kuan-ting won best leading actor for “Double Happiness”. Hong Kong actor and boy band member Anson Kong Ip-sang picked up the prize for best supporting actor for his role in “We’re Nothing at All”. Taiwanese actor and two-time Golden Horse winner Shu Qi won best new director for “Girl”, her directorial debut inspired by her own childhood. “This year quite a lot of the nominated films come from everywhere… the Golden Horse Awards really bring together Chinese-language films from different places,” said Hong Kong actor Will Or, who made his debut as host of the ceremony. In a surprise appearance, Hollywood stars Zendaya and Jason Momoa joined via video to jointly present an award with their “Dune” co-star and Golden Horse chairman Chang Chen.

title: AI影像真假难辨 台教育部推查证教案(图)
summary: 台湾教育部委讬专家撰写“AI时代的影像生成与辨识”教学方案，推广“先怀疑、再观察、后查证”，让学子理解技术的限制，培养独立思考能力。（示意图来源：7IMJAGO/stock.adobe.com） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。 【看中国2026年11月24日讯】（看中国记者李净瑶综合报导）如今，网络数位科技日趋普及，各类讯息和新闻传播速度快且真假难辨。台湾教育部委讬专家撰写“AI时代的影像生成与辨识”教学方案，推广“先怀疑、再观察、后查证”，让学子理解技术
content:
台湾教育部委讬专家撰写“AI时代的影像生成与辨识”教学方案，推广“先怀疑、再观察、后查证”，让学子理解技术的限制，培养独立思考能力。（示意图来源：7IMJAGO/stock.adobe.com） 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
【看中国2026年11月24日讯】（看中国记者李净瑶综合报导）如今，网络数位科技日趋普及，各类讯息和新闻传播速度快且真假难辨。台湾教育部委讬专家撰写“AI时代的影像生成与辨识”教学方案，推广“先怀疑、再观察、后查证”，让学子理解技术的限制，培养独立思考能力。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
台湾教育部24日发布新闻稿指出，为支持大专校院教师发展符合数位时代需求的课程设计，教育部邀请台湾事实查核教育基金会教育专员张育腾撰写“AI时代的影像生成与辨识”教案，从AI影像生成原理、辨识方式到查证流程，带领学生理解技术的可能性与限制，培养面对数位资讯时的查证能力。
教育部指出，该教案以社群平台流传的“美国五角大厦爆炸”假照片为例，当时引发股市市场短暂波动；后续查证发现，该影像并非真实照片，而是AI生成图片。教案内容指出，生成式AI可依据文字指令产生，常见的影像变造类型包括修图、剪辑、移花接木、换脸、合成声音及完全由AI生成的影像，不同类型需要不同的查证方法，使用者应先初步判断影像可能的变造方式，再选择适合的工具进行检视，且AI影像侦测工具的结果并非百分之百准确，仍须结合人工观察、来源查证与多方资讯进行综合判断。
在影像查证方面，教案整理出几项基本原则，包括检查影像来源是否可信，并留意是否伪装成新闻媒体或官方单位的帐号，另检视影像内容是否合乎逻辑，包括人物、物件、背景、光影与地景等细节。若影像涉及特定事件，也应向当事人、相关单位或可信赖的独立资讯来源求证，避免仅依赖单一消息来源。建议大众面对AI生成影像，应掌握“先怀疑、再观察、后查证”的习惯，持续培养独立思考与资讯查证能力。
教育部表示，该教案结合案例分析、工具操作与情境练习，引导学生理解生成式AI的基本原理，练习辨识可疑影像，并思考如何负责任地使用AI。透过媒体素养教案，可协助教师将AI影像生成与辨识议题带入教学现场，支持大专校院教师发展符合数位时代需求的课程设计。完整教案与相关教学资源，请至教育部“媒体素养教育资源网”查询。
台湾近期涉及AI的假讯息案件，主要集中在选举深伪抹黑、灾情造假及健康诈骗三大领域。
据《自由时报》11月11日报导，AI深伪（Deepfake）影音影响选情的案件层出不穷，刑事局统计截至11月中旬已受理超过250件选举假讯息案。
其中，民进党竹北市长候选人曾圣凯日前遭不实性影像攻击。相关不实影像最初出现在海外社群平台，随后迅速传入台湾的社群媒体及候选人LINE群组，对曾圣凯个人造成名誉损害，也对其妻子和家人造成伤害。
此外，不久前网络社群平台Threads流传一则以极度仿真的声音影射沈伯洋自称吸毒、利用黑熊学院在美国军购案收受回扣的深伪视频。检方已依违反《公职人员选举罢免法》，对一名涉及传播该深伪视频的男子提起公诉，并求处有期徒刑1年。
公视新闻10月24日报导，今年10月台风期间，有民众在网络散布以AI合成的台中速食店招牌掉落照片。警方循线通知6名涉案人到案，并依违反《灾害防救法》等罪嫌函送或开罚。
此外，近年也流行“AI假医生”影片，这些AI假医生不仅误导民众，更可能涉及诈骗与造成健康风险。
《自由时报》9月2日报导，检警侦结一起大型诈骗案，男子黄建豪与妻子许湘琦自2022年起成立“假交友、真诈骗”爱情诈欺集团，利用工程师开发的即时AI变声软件扮演“甜美女友”诈骗逾2万人、金额近9亿元。台北地检署侦结并起诉57名被告，首脑夫妻分别被求处25年、18年徒刑。
此外，诈骗集团也频繁结合AI换脸技术伪造名人投资广告与视讯验证画面诱骗转帐。

content:
香港最高法官将出席在新加坡举行的2026年全球法治会议 |中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 24 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港首席法官将出席在新加坡举行的2026年全球法治会议
香港首席大法官张家明将于 11 月 25 日前往新加坡出席 2026 年全球法治会议，并与来自加拿大、牙买加、马来西亚和新西兰的首席大法官进行高层对话，会议由新加坡首席大法官孙达雷什·梅农 (Sundaresh Menon) 主持。
香港政府11月24日宣布，香港终审法院首席法官张居能将于11月25日离港，出席在新加坡举行的2026年全球法治会议。
政府表示，这次会议汇集了司法领导人、学者和法律专业人士，讨论法治如何促进国际合作与发展，增强社会凝聚力，帮助社会应对快速变化的全球环境。
会议期间，张将与加拿大、牙买加、马来西亚和新西兰首席大法官进行高层对话，由新加坡首席大法官孙达雷什·梅农 (Sundaresh Menon) 主持。公告称，讨论将集中于不同司法管辖区目前面临的法治挑战。
张还将出席与会议同时举行的新加坡司法系统二百周年纪念仪式。
终审法院首席法官预计于11月29日返回香港。在他缺席期间，常任法官李家豪将代理终审法院首席法官的职务。

Tuesday, 24 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong top judge to attend 2026 Global Rule of Law Conference in Singapore
Hong Kong's Chief Justice Andrew Cheung will travel to Singapore on 25 November for the 2026 Global Rule of Law Conference, where he will join a high-level dialogue with chief justices from Canada, Jamaica, Malaysia and New Zealand, moderated by Singapore's Chief Justice Sundaresh Menon.
Hong Kong's Chief Justice Andrew Cheung Kui-nung will leave the city on 25 November to attend the 2026 Global Rule of Law Conference in Singapore, the Hong Kong government announced on 24 November.
The conference brings together judicial leaders, academics and legal professionals to discuss how the rule of law can promote international cooperation and development, strengthen social cohesion, and help societies respond to a rapidly changing global environment, the government said.
During the conference, Cheung will take part in a high-level dialogue with the chief justices of Canada, Jamaica, Malaysia and New Zealand, moderated by Singapore's Chief Justice Sundaresh Menon. The discussion will focus on rule-of-law challenges currently facing different jurisdictions, according to the announcement.
Cheung will also attend a ceremony marking the bicentenary of Singapore's judicial system, which will be held alongside the conference.
The Chief Justice is scheduled to return to Hong Kong on 29 November. During his absence, Permanent Judge Johnson Lee will serve as acting Chief Justice of the Court of Final Appeal.

工总代表团访问泰国签署三份谅解备忘录以促进金属和机械联系 |中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 24 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
工总代表团访问泰国签署三份谅解备忘录以加强金属及机械联系
香港工业总会代表团于11月17日至21日访问泰国，与当地商会和企业签署三份谅解备忘录，以加强金属和机械行业、供应链弹性和东盟市场准入。
香港工业总会（工总）第七组（香港金属及机械协会）17人代表团结束对泰国曼谷和春武里府为期五天的访问，与当地商会和企业签署三份谅解备忘录。
根据工总的一份声明，谅解备忘录旨在促进香港和泰国金属和机械行业的发展，增强区域供应链的弹性，并挖掘整个东盟市场的商机。
代表团由工总总干事陈深如及第七集团副主席孙俊杰率领，成员包括来自金属及机械、模具、汽车零部件、自动化科技及金融服务等行业的企业代表。
访问期间，代表团出席了香港驻曼谷经济贸易办事处（驻曼谷经济贸易办事处）和泰港贸易协会（THKTA）合办的联谊晚宴。工总与THKTA续签谅解备忘录，深化双边经贸交流。
陈先生表示：“通过工总的‘全球通’平台，我们将泰国成熟的金属产业链与香港在国际金融、贸易和专业服务方面的优势紧密联系起来，帮助企业抓住区域经济合作机遇。”

Tuesday, 24 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
FHKI delegation signs three MoUs on Thailand visit to boost metal and machinery ties
A delegation from the Federation of Hong Kong Industries visited Thailand from 17 to 21 November, signing three memoranda of understanding with local chambers and firms to strengthen metal and machinery industries, supply chain resilience and ASEAN market access.
A 17-member delegation from Group 7 (Hong Kong Metal and Machinery Council) of the Federation of Hong Kong Industries (FHKI) has returned from a five-day visit to Bangkok and Chonburi Province, Thailand, where it signed three Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with local business chambers and enterprises.
The MoUs aim to advance development of the metal and machinery industries in Hong Kong and Thailand, enhance regional supply chain resilience, and tap business opportunities across the ASEAN market, according to a statement from the FHKI.
The delegation, led by FHKI Director-General Bonnie Chan Shum-yue and Group 7 Vice-Chairman Alexis Suen, included corporate representatives from sectors such as metal and machinery, moulds and dies, automotive components, automation technology and financial services.
During the trip, the delegation attended a networking dinner co-organised by the Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office in Bangkok (HKETO Bangkok) and the Thai-Hong Kong Trade Association (THKTA). The FHKI renewed its MoU with the THKTA to deepen bilateral economic and trade exchanges.
“Through FHKI's 'Global Connect' platform, we help businesses seize regional economic cooperation opportunities by closely linking Thailand’s mature metal industry chain with Hong Kong’s strengths in international finance, trade, and professional services,” Chan said.
